result.description: Fires on the plural 's' right after the acronym DAW (digital audio workstation), and on the next word after "DAWs" (now, offer). Silent on 's' after other words, such as possessives, decades and ordinary plurals.
result.label: Plural 's' after DAW

result.description: Fires on the pieces 'ent' and 'ive' inside the word "attentive" (att-ent-ive), especially in "attentive listening". It is silent on 'ent' in "attentiveness" and in "intelligent", so it needs this specific word.
result.label: Word pieces of "attentive"

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'arian', 'ary', 'ari' completing "Hungarian"/"Hungary" (after the Hung- piece), especially in text about Hungary's borders and population. Silent on 'arian' in other words like Battarian.
result.label: Hung-arian / Hung-ary suffix

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'ue' in dialogue, 'acy' in diplomacy, 'ate' in negotiate, in communication and negotiation text. Silent on 'ue' in other contexts such as monologue or a standalone 'ue'.
result.label: Dialogue/diplomacy/negotiate word endings

result.description: Fires on the word pieces completing "hierarchy" or "hierarchical" (arch, ar, hierarchy) and on nouns like structure/systems right after "hierarchical". Quiet on "structure" without a preceding hierarchy context, such as data structure.
result.label: Hierarchy word and following noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'und' inside "mundane" (after 'm'), and weakly in similar split words like "gerund". It's an attention circuit built from detectors of 'und' and of other word-start pieces like 'm'+'ood'/'old'.
result.label: 'und' in "mundane"

result.description: Fires on " Revolution" (also " Method"/" method") right after "Scientific", as in "Scientific Revolution" or "Scientific Method". It stays silent on "Industrial Revolution", so it needs the preceding "Scientific".
result.label: Scientific Revolution / Method

result.description: Fires on the 'zone' piece in 'ozone' (the atmospheric gas / ozone layer), after the 'o' piece. Members are mostly detectors of 'zone' in that word. Weak on ' layer' and later mentions of ozone.
result.label: 'zone' inside ozone

result.description: Fires on the ' $' token that opens a new inline math variable or dollar amount after "and" or a comma in a list (e.g. "$a$ and $b$"). Silent on plain prose logic text without a dollar sign.
result.label: Dollar sign opening second math item

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ar' as a mid-word fragment, most strongly in 'Stell|ar', and weaker in 'sh|ar|per', 'Li|ar' and 'non-plan|ar'. Silent on ordinary text lacking this piece.
result.label: 'ar' word piece, as in Stellar

result.description: Fires on tokens in the clause right after "ensures"/"ensure" (e.g. "that", "each", "a", "levels", "will"), tracked by members detecting "ensures" and "ens". Silent on some "that" after ensure in other contexts, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Tokens following "ensures"

result.description: Fires on ' Indian' and the following words in phrases like "Indian Number System" or "Indian Mathematics" (' Number', ' number', ' Mathemat'). It stays silent on similar Greek mathematics text, so it seems to need the Indian context.
result.label: Indian number system / mathematics

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'et' when it is a split-off fragment inside a longer word, mainly 'Gen-et-ics', also 'Param-et-ric' and 'app-et-izer'. It stays quiet on 'et' in other words like 'phylogenetically' or 'codetermination'.
result.label: 'et' piece inside Genetics-type words

result.description: Fires mainly on ' fixed' (also 'rate(s)' and '-') in finance/economics text, such as fixed costs, fixed vs floating rates and fixed exchange rates. Members are mostly ' fixed' detectors plus finance terms like derivatives and futures.
result.label: 'fixed' in finance/economics contexts

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ending' completing the word "comprehending" (compreh+ending), in text about understanding or comprehension. It stays silent on other contexts. Members detect 'end'/'ending' pieces and understanding/comprehension words.
result.label: 'ending' in "comprehending"
"its" piece in "traits"
result.description: Fires on the final piece "its" when it completes the word "traits" (tra|its), in genetics and biology text about heritable or phenotypic traits. It stays silent on "its" in other words such as "inherits".
Fires on the token "down" when it completes a compound or phrasal verb, most strongly "breakdown" and also "shutdown" and "break down". It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "down" in breakdown/shutdown

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "maintaining". It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs such as attracting, targeting or refactoring. Members detect 'maintain' and 'ing' pieces.
result.label: 'ing' in "maintaining"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'asm' ending "sarcasm" (after sarc-/arc), also seen in "plasmids". Members detect 'asm' and the preceding 'arc'/'sarc' piece; silent on other humor words like irony or satire.
result.label: 'asm' in sarcasm

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'agine' (from "Imagine"), usually at the start of a sentence or document where "Im" precedes it. It stays silent when 'agine' follows a sentence-ending full stop.
result.label: 'agine' piece of "Imagine"

result.description: Fires on the token " pole", mainly in "north pole" / "south pole" in magnetic or geographic text. It is quiet on general magnetic-field text without the word pole. Members detect "pole" and "north".
result.label: " pole" after north/south

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ject"/"jective"/"ives" inside the word "adjective(s)" in grammar-lesson text, e.g. "demonstrative adjectives", "possessive adjectives". It stays silent on other grammar text that lacks this word-piece.
result.label: Pieces of "adjective" in grammar text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (ction, conjug, cells, group, process, wall) in bacteria/microbiology text, often right after "bacterial" or in bacterial-conjugation passages. Silent on "ction" in reproduction/transduction. Members are bacter- piece detectors.
result.label: Bacteria-context noun/word pieces

result.description: Fires on varied content words in text about writing systems, scripts and languages (' scripts', ' South', ' Mal', ' character', ' expansion'). Members detect 'script', alphabet, cuneiform and language words. It is silent on one 'scripts' example, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Writing systems and scripts topic

result.description: Fires on the token ' convey' (verb), especially when conveying emotions, meaning, or messages through art, symbols, or language. Members are mostly ' convey' detectors plus expression/communication context words such as gesture, body language, and Picasso.
result.label: ' convey' verb token

result.description: Fires on 'elt' in 'melt' (meltwater, snowmelt) and on 'water' after 'melt', in glacier and ice-melt contexts. Weakly fires on 'Celt'. Silent on general ice and water text lacking the melt word piece.
result.label: melt word piece in glacier text

result.description: Fires on " Media"/" media" (also broadcast, content) especially as the heading word starting a list item like "Media Law." or "Media Policy." in outline-style course/topic lists. Silent on neighbouring marketing headings such as "Public Relations".
result.label: Media as list-heading word

result.description: Fires on the 'al' piece completing "focal" (foc+al), mostly in photography/optics text like "focal length/points"; weaker on "foc" in "focusing". Silent on 'al' in other words (instrumental, dispersal).
result.label: 'al' in "focal"

result.description: Fires on words following "vinyl" in music-format contexts (vinyl records, cassettes, quality, production, consumption). Driven by a vinyl-token detector plus music and material members. Silent on plural 's' elsewhere.
result.label: Word after "vinyl" (records, formats)

result.description: Fires on the word right after "paradigm" (e.g. " shift", "ifts", " emphas"), carried by members detecting "parad"/"igm". It stays silent on some "shift" tokens, including ones where "paradigm" appears later or is further back.
result.label: Word following "paradigm"

result.description: Fires on the word " set"/" sets" in mathematical set-theory text, such as "the empty set and the set itself" or "power set". It is weak for other senses ("a set of rules") and silent on "set" in "set theory".
result.label: math 'set' noun token

result.description: Fires on word pieces in corporate governance and board text (govern-ance, strateg-ic, decision-making, board evaluation), when "board" appears earlier in the passage. Silent on "decision-making" in generic ethics or policy contexts without board context.
result.label: Board governance text word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on " having" in participial clauses (", having access to...") and sometimes on "to" after "having X". Weaker on other words in lists or "Being" clauses. Several members detect "having" directly.
result.label: ' having' in participial clauses

result.description: Fires on the 'le' piece of "subtle", most strongly when it is followed by nuances or distortions. It is silent on some "subtle" cases, such as "subtle gestures" or "subtle emotions". Members are mostly 'le' detectors.
result.label: 'le' in "subtle"

result.description: Fires on ' When' as the first word of a document or section, opening a sentence like "When optimizing..." or "When dealing with...". Silent on one contrast case where ' When' followed other sentence text on the previous line.
result.label: Document-initial ' When'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ures' when it completes the word "textures" (after the fragment "text"). It stays silent on 'ures' in other words such as sculptures, gestures and captures.
result.label: 'ures' completing "textures"

result.description: Fires on ' period' when it follows "this" (e.g. "this period (19…"), referring back to a time span. It stays silent on some "this period" cases in other passages, so what separates them is unclear. Members detect period/era/age words and "this/same".
result.label: "this period" time-span reference

result.description: Fires on tokens that follow or complete an adverb-like "-ly" ending (e.g. "ly" itself, the word after "-ly"), plus suffix pieces like "ized". Silent on "ly" inside words like singly or scholarly. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Adverb -ly and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on pieces of the word "deliver" (deliver, delivered, delivery, deliverable) and on the 'ing' or 'able' suffix right after "deliver". It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs such as maintaining or staying.
result.label: deliver word pieces and suffixes

result.description: Fires mainly on " mention" as a verb after "to" (e.g. "important to mention", "forget to mention"), with weaker firing on "of" after the noun "mention". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "to mention" in discourse phrases

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in a document that begins with "Recursive..." (structures, algorithms, Traversal, typically), seemingly tracking the early-document "ursive" token via attention. Silent on ' structures' after "data" in mid-text contexts.
result.label: Recursive-document title carryover

result.description: Fires on the word " flows" (also " flow", " moving") in physical fluid or material-flow contexts, such as turbulent flows, lava flows and ice flows. Members mostly detect flow/fluid tokens in earlier layers.
result.label: ' flows' in fluid dynamics

result.description: Fires on the 'or' piece completing the word "flavor" (also 'ors'), mostly in culinary text about flavor profiles. Members are detectors of the 'or' token and of food/cooking context.
result.label: 'or' in "flavor"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "retail" words, mainly the 'ers' in "retailers" (also 'ail', 'chains', 'stores'). It stays silent on 'ers' in other words such as consumers, immersive and organizers.
result.label: retail(ers) word completion

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'atoes' ending "tomatoes" or "potatoes", mostly in lists of crops or foods. Members detect 'atoes' and ' tom' plus food/cooking context.
result.label: 'atoes' in potatoes/tomatoes

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "eties" completing "societies" (soci|eties), mostly in sociology or anthropology text about human societies. It is silent on nearby civilization or agriculture text without that word.
result.label: "eties" in "societies"

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after a form of "contribute" (contributed to, contribute significantly to). It is silent on some other "contribute to" and "add to" cases, so the condition is not fully explained.
result.label: 'to' after contribute

result.description: Fires on the word "understanding" (also "understand"), mostly after a preposition or verb such as "in" or "to" in explanatory text. Silent on some instances, e.g. text-initial or after "our", so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: "understanding" token detector

result.description: Fires on the 's' of the contraction "it's" (also "it'll"), especially when it opens an evaluative or generalizing statement like "it's often said". Stays silent on 's' after "there", "one", or sentence-initial "It's" in some contexts.
result.label: "it's" contraction 's

result.description: Fires on the word " freedom" (occasionally " liberty" or " free") in abstract discussions of individual rights and political or philosophical liberty. Members are mostly detectors of freedom/liberty tokens plus rights and philosophy context.
result.label: freedom / liberty token detector

result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after "lifeblood" (also the 'od' ending of "lifeblood"). Stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like growth, product, part, structure.
result.label: ' of' after "lifeblood"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'gence' completing "emergence" (after "emer"). It is mostly silent on the same token in other contexts, such as the contrast example, which has "emergence of modernism" in a literary passage.
result.label: 'gence' in "emergence"

result.description: Fires on ' roads' and 'ways' (roadways) in lists of transport infrastructure, such as roads, bridges, railways. Upstream members detect road, transport, infrastructure and route tokens. Silent on non-road infrastructure such as electricity.
result.label: Roads in infrastructure lists

result.description: Fires on 'emission', 'emit' and 'light' in physics/spectroscopy text about atoms or sources emitting light at characteristic wavelengths. Silent in generic atomic-structure text. Predicts emission-related words are not repeated next.
result.label: Light emission in spectroscopy

result.description: Fires on the token ' shell', mainly in atomic/nuclear physics text about electron shells (each shell, these shells). Weaker on food 'hard shell'. Silent on other chemistry text without the word shell.
result.label: ' shell' in electron-shell contexts

result.description: Fires on tokens following the name "Immanuel Kant" (the apostrophe of 's, " is", " and", "Kantian", "Kant" again) in philosophy text about Kant. It stays silent on apostrophes after other philosophers' names.
result.label: Tokens after Immanuel Kant

result.description: Fires on " resources" (also "management") when it follows "water" in hydrology or water-management text, as in "water resources". It stays silent on "resources" after manage, marine, shared or financial.
result.label: water resources in hydrology text

result.description: Fires on a digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly a year such as 18xx in birth–death ranges (e.g. "Vincent van Gogh (188[3]–19"). It stays quiet on some other digits in years, such as the last digit of 1770–1780 or 1908.
result.label: Digits inside 18xx-style years

result.description: Fires on a capitalized word or piece (Middle, Renaissance, Academy, Tem, Dynamic) coming right after the word "High" or a high-/hyphen modifier, as in "High Middle Ages" or "High-Temperature". It stays silent on "the Middle Ages" with no preceding High.
result.label: Word following "High" modifier

result.description: Fires on " era" when it comes right after "The" at the very start of a document (e.g. "The era of..."). It stays silent on "era" later in a text, after a modifier like "Hellenistic", or at a sentence start.
result.label: ' era' right after document-initial "The"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "create/creating/creates" (mostly " an", " a", " the", or a word piece like "decor"), the slot where the object of creating begins. Not consistently active: it stays silent on some "creating an" cases.
result.label: Article after "creating"

result.description: Fires on words and function tokens (could, that, a, made) a few tokens after the verb "knew"/"know", the slot after a knowing verb where a clause begins. Members mainly detect "knew"/"know". Silent on "could" elsewhere.
result.label: Clause slot after "knew"

result.description: Fires on tokens following "truth" near the start of a document (e.g. "truth tables", "truths are", "truth is viewed"), driven by "uth" detectors. It is silent on "tables" after "truth" later in a passage, so it seems to need the early-document position.
result.label: Tokens right after "truth" at start

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces and suffixes (-ors, -ers, ' pair', 'iv', 'ation') mostly in text where the word "contrast" appeared earlier. Members mainly detect the token " contrast" plus assorted word fragments. Evidence is mixed and not consistent.
result.label: Suffix pieces after "contrast" context

result.description: Fires on statistics/regression-analysis vocabulary such as "regression", "independent" (variables), "relationships", "analysis" and "research" in text about regression and statistical modeling. Members detect "regression" and related data-science terms.
result.label: Regression and statistics terms

result.description: Fires on "Committee"/"committee" (and pieces like "itte" in "committees") in corporate-governance lists such as Audit, Compensation, Nominating Committee. Silent on general board text that lacks the word.
result.label: Committee word in governance text

result.description: Fires on the piece 'el' completing the surname Becquerel (Henri/Edmond Becquerel), often before "'s". It stays silent on 'el' ending other surnames like Kossel and Herschel.
result.label: 'el' in Becquerel
' studies' after 'case'
result.description: Fires on ' studies' right after 'case' (case studies) when it is the subject of a clause, e.g. 'case studies offer/show'. Members detect case/studies/research tokens. Silent when 'case studies' is followed by a to/that clause or sits in other slots.

Fires on tokens in the opening of a document that starts with "### ###" heading markers, such as the number, period or first word piece of a numbered or list-style heading. It stays silent on periods elsewhere in running text.
result.label: Early tokens after ### heading start

result.description: Fires on " reality" (occasionally " environments") right after "virtual", as in "virtual reality" at the start of a document or sentence. It stays silent on some "virtual reality" and "augmented reality" cases in other contexts.
result.label: "reality" after "virtual"

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'way' in the name "Hemingway", after "Hem" and "ing" pieces. It stays silent on 'way' in other words, and the contrast case "ing[[way]]" shows it needs the full Hem-ing-way sequence.
result.label: 'way' completing Hemingway

result.description: Fires on the bare verb ' challenge' used as a present-tense main verb after a plural subject (authors, writers, devices challenge traditional beliefs). Silent on the participle 'challenging'.
result.label: Verb 'challenge' after plural subject

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb " does" (also " do", " did", " doesn't") as the main or emphasized verb, including in questions ("Why does...") and "it does what/neither". Members detect does/did tokens.
result.label: auxiliary verb "does"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'os' inside split words like ge-os-ynthetics, Fruct-os-e, log-os. It is silent on 'os' in some geosynthetic contexts in civil-engineering text, so it depends on the surrounding context.
result.label: 'os' word piece in ge-os words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'istic' in "Artistic", mostly in heading-like lists at the start of a document (e.g. "Artistic Styles", "Artistic Creation"). It is weaker for lowercase "artistic" in running prose, and silent in some mid-text and later-heading cases.
result.label: 'istic' in "Artistic" headings

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "important" (e.g. "it's important to note/recognize"), the infinitive after an importance adjective. Weaker on 'important' or 'crucial' itself. Silent on ' to' after other words like "forget to" or "try to".
result.label: "to" after "important"

result.description: Fires on the word "check" and its variants (checks, checking, checkpoint, checksum) in technical text about validation, data integrity or cell-cycle checkpoints. Members are mostly detectors of "check" tokens.
result.label: check/checks word variants

result.description: Fires on pieces of the word "descriptive" (descript, -ive) and on the nouns that follow it (elements, language, words, settings) when "descriptive" appears in the preceding context. Silent on -ive in other words such as selective or cohesive.
result.label: "descriptive" word and its following nouns

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a conjunction right after the word "means" (e.g. "means that the table..."), often at a sentence start. It stays quiet on ' that' after "stated", "ensuring" or a noun like "vision".
result.label: ' that' after "means"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'osis' completing "diagnosis" (occasionally 'ose' in "diagnose"), in medical text after "diagn". Silent on text about disease detection that lacks the word.
result.label: 'osis' ending "diagnosis"

result.description: Fires on the noun right after "recent" (develop(ments), research, efforts, progress), as in "recent developments". Silent on "develop" when it follows other words. Members detect "recent" and "years".
result.label: noun after "recent"

result.description: Fires on the "aving"/"ave" piece after "we" when it spells the word weaving/weave, mostly in textile craft text. It stays silent in "interweaving" and in figurative "weaving them into" uses.
result.label: "we-aving" weaving word piece

result.description: Fires on the verb or word right after the subject "perspective" (e.g. challenges, underscores, highlights, views). Members detect "perspective" and "pect" tokens. It stays silent on "es" when no perspective subject precedes it.
result.label: Verb following "perspective" subject

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after the word "successful" (e.g. "successful isolation of", "successful culture integration"), including 'of' and word pieces. The members are mostly "successful"/"effective" detectors. It stays silent on 'of' after nouns when no "successful" precedes.
result.label: tokens following "successful"

result.description: Fires mainly on the verb " discovered" after a scientist or subject, as in "Ritter discovered that...". It weakly fires on similar verbs (revealed, identified) and on "that"/"this" after them. It stays silent on "discover" in an infinitive.
result.label: past-tense "discovered" in science narrative

result.description: Fires on varied words in text about personification (e.g. "life", "characteristics", "ification", "person") when the document is about personification, such as "breathe life into objects". It stays silent on "life" in other contexts.
result.label: Personification-topic words

result.description: Fires on the word pieces of "facilitate" (facil, it, itate, itated), especially the 'itate'/'it' piece. It stays silent on some 'itate' tokens in other sentences, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: facilitate word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on " his" in biographical text about a man (his parents, his death, his father), with weaker firing on a few other tokens. It stays silent on some " his" cases, such as after verbs like "maintaining" or "began", and the evidence does not show what separates them.
result.label: Biographical " his" possessive

result.description: Fires on the piece 'age'/'aging'/'agement' after 'eng-' in the verb "engage" (also ' engaged'), in marketing/audience-engagement text. Silent in other contexts, such as 'wage'.
result.label: engage word-piece 'age' (audience engagement)

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after "pioneering" or "pioneer" (e.g. "advancements", "efforts by", "scientists", "economists"), carried by upstream pione/ering detectors. It stays silent on "adv" when "pioneering" does not directly precede it in the same way.
result.label: Word following "pioneering"

result.description: Fires on the token " view" (also " views") as a noun meaning opinion or perspective, often before "point" or in "alternative view", in academic or analytical text. Members detect "view" and related words such as perspective and viewers.
result.label: ' view' as perspective noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ieving' in 'Achieving', strongest when 'Ach' starts a sentence or heading at document start; weaker in mid-sentence 'achieving'. Members are detectors of 'ieving' and 'Ach'.
result.label: 'ieving' in Achieving

result.description: Fires mostly on the word " reflected" (also "reflect", "felt", "-ically"), both as light/sound reflection and as "X reflected broader trends". Members detect reflect-forms and passive verbs like "identified".
result.label: " reflected" verb token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' (also 'ative') completing the word "vegetation" after the piece "veget", and weakly on "cover" after vegetative. Silent on 'ation' in other words like alteration, continuation, or "etation" fragments.
result.label: 'ation' ending of vegetation

result.description: Fires on the piece 'lock' when it completes the name 'Sherlock' (Sherlock Holmes, Sherlockian, Sherlock-style). Other 'lock' words like deadlock appear among members, but the peaks are all Sherlock.
result.label: 'lock' in Sherlock

result.description: Fires on the 'ism' ending in "isomerism" (chemistry text on structural isomers), and on 'omer' within isomer. Silent on 'ism' in organism, dichroism, polarism, so it needs the isomer word piece before it.
result.label: 'ism' in isomerism

result.description: Fires on the token ' so', including the 'so' piece at the start of words like soapy, soak, soils and sovereignty, and the conjunction 'so that'. It fires on the word-piece itself in many contexts. Logits are unclear.
result.label: ' so' token and so- word pieces

result.description: Fires on advertising-related word pieces (the 'ising' of "advertising", 'advert', 'ements', 'product', 'eting') in marketing/advertising text. It stays silent on 'ising' in "merchandising", so it needs the advertising word, not just the suffix.
result.label: advertising word pieces in marketing text

result.description: Fires mostly on the document-start token and on newline or period separators in short-line list-like text (schedules, name lists, keyword lists). It is silent on many newlines in similar lists. Members detect separators and name tokens such as David.
result.label: Separators in short-line lists
'itation' in precipitation
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'itation' completing "precip-itation" (rain, weather text). It stays silent on other -ation endings like "transpiration". Members detect 'itation' and ' precip' pieces.

Fires on "religious" and "religion" (weakly on "spiritual" and "relig-" pieces) in academic-style text about religion's role or effects. Upstream members are mostly detectors of religion-related words such as religious, church, faith, divine, Islam and Protestant.
result.label: religious / religion word

result.description: Fires on tokens a few positions into a document that opens with "While" or "Although", landing on varied following tokens (apostrophes, word pieces, hyphens). Members detect the opening "While" and document-start newlines.
result.label: Early tokens after opening "While"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ops' completing the word "workshops" (worksh|ops). It relies on the preceding 'worksh' fragment, and members detect 'ops' and other word-ending pieces.
result.label: 'ops' ending 'workshops'

result.description: Fires on database-related nouns (stores, schema, design, databases, data) in discussions of NoSQL/SQL database types and schema flexibility. Silent in relational normalization text. Members are mostly database/data token detectors.
result.label: Database nouns in NoSQL discussion

result.description: Fires on the piece 'eries' completing the word "galleries" (after "gall"), mostly in art and museum contexts. Members include 'eries' detectors and art/museum topic features.
result.label: 'eries' in "galleries"
' selecting' in process descriptions
result.description: Fires on the word " selecting" (also select/choosing), mostly after "carefully" or "in" in descriptions of a process that involves picking appropriate options or samples. Members detect selection and choice words and "carefully".
Fires on the "falls" piece of "Pitfalls" in titles or headings at the start of a document, such as "Pitfalls and Tips". It stays silent on lowercase "pitfalls" mid-sentence.
result.label: Pitfalls heading at document start

result.description: Fires mostly on " for" right after "essential"/"crucial" (importance adjectives), as in "is essential for X". Silent on some "for" cases, e.g. after "allow" or "planning", so it depends on that construction.
result.label: " for" after essential/crucial

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'icus' ending of "Copernicus" (also weakly on related tokens after Copernicus). Members detect the Cop/ern/icus pieces of the name.
result.label: Copernicus name ending 'icus'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ous' (and 'ard') completing the word "hazardous" after "hazard"/"Haz". It stays silent on 'ous' in other words like "meticulous" or "continuous". Members detect hazard pieces and 'ous' endings.
result.label: 'ous' completing "hazardous"

result.description: Fires on ' like' right after "'s" (it's like...) when introducing an analogy or comparison, often followed by a gerund ("like being on", "like playing"). Silent on "look like" or "appear like", and in some "it's like" contexts.
result.label: "'s like" analogy opener

result.description: Fires on tokens in the slot right after the phrase "The foundation of" at document start (e.g. "of", "structure", "systems", "construction"). Members detect "foundation" and ' of'. It stays silent on ' of' in other phrases.

result.description: Fires on ' industrial' (and following nouns like policies, processes, industry) when it is used as a modern adjective for industry/manufacturing, often at document start. Silent when it is part of 'industrial revolution' or historical-era phrasing.

result.description: Fires on body-part/sense-organ nouns, mainly ' ears' (also eye, skin, windows), when listed alongside other sense organs such as "eyes, ears, nose". Members detect eye, gaze, sensory and ears tokens.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'al' completing the word "disposal" (dispos+al), mostly in waste-management text. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "accidental" or "detrimental".

result.description: Fires on forms of "raise" (raised, raising, raise) and the "row" piece of "eyebrow", often in eyebrow-raising contexts. Weaker on the words following "raise" (e.g. "a child"). Silent in unrelated technical text.

result.description: Fires on preservation/protection verbs (preserve, restore, protected, safeguarding) in art and cultural-heritage conservation text. Silent on "to preserve" in environmental/ecosystem contexts. Members detect museum, art, and conservation words.

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside or just after words beginning with "h" (hatching, hedging, hormone, honeybees, hues), mostly mid-word fragments like 'atch', 'ed', 'orm', and ' h'. Predicts continuations of h-words.
result.label: h-word fragments (hormone, hedging)

result.description: Fires on the word right after "soil" in soil-science and geotechnical text (soil properties, health, strength, sampling, quality). Silent on "properties" after other nouns or fragments like "il". Members detect "soil" and material words.
result.label: Word following "soil" in soil text

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ment' in "govern-ment" (esp. intergovernment/governmental), not on 'ment' in words like "investment". Members detect 'ment' and govern/legislation-type policy words.

result.description: Fires on the token ' structure' as a head noun, especially after a modifier like secondary, tertiary, quaternary, or basic. It is silent on "Phrase Structure Rules", where the word is capitalized and part of a title. Members are mostly detectors of 'structure' and similar words.
result.label: ' structure' after modifier

result.description: Fires on ' with' that follows a comma after a full clause, opening an absolute/elaborating phrase ("..., with each genre..."). It stays silent on instrumental or accompaniment 'with' directly after a noun or verb, as in "plowing fields with a smile".
result.label: Clause-final comma ', with' construction

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ter' completing the word "laughter" (after "laugh"). It stays silent on 'ter' in other words like "butterfly". Weaker activation on "laugh" followed by other tokens.
result.label: 'ter' in laughter
'cre' word-piece at word start
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cre' when it begins a word such as "increasing" or "discrepancies". It stays silent on 'cre' in "co-creation", where the piece follows a hyphen. Members are mostly detectors of 'cre' and similar word-start pieces.
Fires on the suffix 'al' (also 'als', 'rayed') completing "portrayal"/"portrayed" after "portray". Stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "reveal", "focal", "institutional".
result.label: portrayal suffix 'al'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' in "summarization" in NLP/text-processing text, and weakly on ' analysis'. It stays silent on 'ization' in "tokenization" or at document start.
result.label: summarization 'ization' suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ile" (also "il") completing "fert" in "fertile" or "fertilization/fertilizer", mostly in agriculture and early-civilization text. Members detect the fert-/il/ile pieces.
result.label: "fert" + ile/il word completion

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside text about restaurant menus, mainly 'us' in "menus", also ' season' (seasonal) and ' food'-related tokens. Needs a menu/food-and-cooking context; silent in a general text about harmony and environment.
result.label: Menu/seasonal food word pieces

result.description: Fires on tokens right after or within "illustrate/illustrating" (e.g. " how", "ates", "ical", "point") in explanatory academic text. It is driven by detectors of the " illustr" token. It stays silent on " how" after other verbs like discuss or investigating.
result.label: Words following 'illustrate'

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after a number word, especially "three-" (three-dimensional, three-point), where a compound modifier follows. Silent on hyphens after other words such as right-, well-, problem-, and sometimes two-.
result.label: Hyphen after "three" in compounds

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like 'ies', 'ied', 'iment' completing forms of "embody/embodiment" (embod|ies, embod|ied, embod|iment). Silent on 'ies' in unrelated words like "histories"; members detect 'emb'/'od' pieces.
result.label: embod- word endings (ies/ied/iment)

result.description: Fires on the token ' housing' when it repeats earlier mention of housing in an urban-planning text, e.g. "affordable housing" after "urban housing" earlier. Weaker on "housing" in other slots. Silent on contrast text that lacks the word.
result.label: Repeated ' housing' in urban text

result.description: Fires on the word " original" as an adjective in writing/paraphrasing contexts (original ideas, original meaning, original content). Members are mostly detectors of "original" and related words like individual, primary, abstract.
result.label: ' original' adjective token

result.description: Fires on the first word of a list line (' Supp'ly, ' Customer', ' Str') when it repeats the head word of the previous line in a list of topic headings, mostly business terms. It stays silent on repeated ' Media' headings.
result.label: Repeated heading word in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ary" in "diary" (di|ary), predicting a continuation after the "di" prefix. It stays silent on "ary" in other words like customary or Contemporary. Members detect "ary" and "di"/"diph" pieces.
result.label: "ary" in "diary"

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' race' and ' strugg' (also ' batt') in social or literary text, e.g. "gender and race", "internal struggles". Stays silent on the whole word "struggle" in other contexts.
result.label: race / strugg word pieces
' susp' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' susp' (suspension, suspended, suspense), where the word continues in the next token. Weak activation on similar fragments like 'anx' and 'rever'. Silent on the whole word 'silent'.

Fires on the word piece ' fost' (as in foster/fosters), and weakly on similar verbs like ' encourag' and ' facil', when used as a verb of promoting something. Silent on some ' fost' tokens, e.g. after nouns like 'environment' or 'diversity', or at the start of text, so the cause is unclear.
result.label: ' fost' (foster) verb stem
'p' piece in "reduplication"
result.description: Fires mostly on the token 'p' inside "redu-p-lication" (reduplicate/reduplication) in linguistics text. It also fires weakly on a few other word pieces such as ' de', 'crit' and 'al'. Members are mostly detectors of the 'p' token.

Fires on 'cade' in "decade" (also "decades") and on " Image" at the start of a document heading such as "Image Acquisition". Members detect 'cade' and century/period words. The shared role is unclear.
result.label: 'decade' piece and heading 'Image'

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'ence' (and occasionally 'ology') in technical physics/maths text, mainly in "decoherence" after a 'deco'/'her' split. It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as "essence" and "coherence".
result.label: 'ence' ending of decoherence
Plural ending of event nouns
result.description: Fires on the plural suffix ('s', 'als', 'ues') completing event or venue words like concerts, festivals and venues, in text about live events and waste. It stays silent on 'als' in unrelated words such as metals or rivals.

Fires on commas separating items in a running list of bare nouns (materials, commodities, abstract nouns), mid-list before the next item. Silent on commas ending an introductory phrase or clause before a new clause.
result.label: Comma inside noun lists

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces like ' tap' (tap dance, taproot), ' foot' (footwork, footprint) and 'real', where the token starts a compound or longer word. Members mostly detect these same tokens. It also fires weakly on ' caused'.
result.label: tap / foot compound word starts

result.description: Fires on the piece "it" inside longer words split into pieces, such as exc|it|ons, necess|it|ates, aud|it, Ant|it|rust. It is a word-internal fragment, not the pronoun "it".
result.label: "it" fragment inside words

result.description: Fires on the token ' nature' (e.g. "particle nature", "intricate nature", "second nature"), mostly after a modifier. Members are mainly ' nature' detectors in early layers. Strongest in physics-style text about wave-particle duality.
result.label: ' nature' token after modifier

result.description: Fires mostly on the token 'UN' (also ' U', 'nek', 'ăr') when it begins a word or acronym, such as UN or UCLA. It stays silent when 'UN' sits inside a word like CUNEIFORM. Members are mostly generic early-layer token detectors.

result.description: Fires on nouns naming a targeted set of people in marketing text, mainly "audience" after "target", also "groups", "segments", "audiences". Silent when "audience" is a modifier before another noun (audience size, audience demographics).
result.label: Marketing target audience/group nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' brid' (start of bridge/bridging/bridged) when it is split from its suffix, and weakly on 'const' and 'fost'. Predicts suffix pieces like 'ges', 'ged', 'ging'.
result.label: ' brid' word-piece (bridging)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'os' completing "logos" in the rhetoric triad "ethos, pathos, and logos". Silent on 'os' at document start or ending a name like "Atropopoulos". Weaker on ' ag' in agility/agile.
result.label: 'os' ending "logos"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'NG' at the end of capitalized acronyms such as QRNG, RNG and PNG, where the letters before it spell out the acronym. Weak activation on a few other word pieces.

result.description: Fires on the token ' folk' (folk music, culture, traditions, genres) in academic cultural text. Members include ' folk' token detectors and tradition, music and local-culture features.

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iss' inside longer words such as Meissner, fortississimo and permissibility. It weakly fires on a few other mid-word pieces. Members are mostly 'iss' detectors in early layers.

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ics' (or 'ic') completing "mechanics", especially "Quantum Mechanics". It stays quiet on 'ics' in other words such as thermodynamics, electrostatics and basics.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' construct' (as in constructivism, constructive, constructs, theoretical construct), mostly when it starts a word that continues with a suffix. Members are mostly ' construct' token detectors.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' vari' (and sometimes ' Soci'/' soci'), mostly in linguistic or sociolinguistic text about varieties. It pushes toward completions like 'eties', 'ories' and 'etal'. It is silent in statistics text on dispersion.

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ed' in "craft+ed" / "handcraft+ed" (crafted with care, handcrafted features). Silent on 'ed' after other stems like root-ed, convey-ed, adorn-ed, so it needs the craft stem.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ur' at the start of a split word such as urgent, urgency, urinary or urine. Members are mostly detectors of ' ur' and of other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' ur' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ib' in "Fibonacci" (also 'im', ' Rem', 'Math'), early in a multi-piece word after a capitalized first piece. Silent when 'ib' starts the text with no preceding piece.

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'ier' inside the name "Navier" (Navier-Stokes), with weak activity on 'inclus'/'clus' pieces. Members detect ' Nav', 'kes', and 'ier' pieces from earlier layers.

result.description: Fires on the token ' electric' (as in electric propulsion, vehicles, charge, fields), mostly as a modifier before a noun. Members detect 'electric' and related electromagnetic words like magnetic, current and field.

result.description: Fires on the word " expected" (occasionally " returns"), in both "expected value/returns" finance phrasing and "it is expected that" uses. Built from early-layer detectors of "expected"/"expect" tokens plus finance-related context members.

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'els' in "Markov Models", 'folio' (portfolio), and ' crisis' in "financial crisis". It is a mix of tokens in technical or finance text, with some completion of split words (Mod-els, Mod-us).

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' fost' (as in fostering), and also on ' innov', ' team', ' orch' and similar partial word pieces in business or tech prose, where a word is unfinished and about to be completed.

result.description: Fires on word endings (-ating, -ations, -ates) and ' translate' when they continue the word family of "translate/translation/translator". Silent on other -ating words like "incorporating" or "elevating".

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cry' when it begins "crystal"-type words (crystallization, crystal lattice) in physics and chemistry text. It stays silent when ' cry' is at the very start of the document, as in "crystallograph…".

result.description: Fires on the token right after "public" (-ly, -ity, hyphen, " and"), such as "publicly", "publicity", "public-private". Silent on "-ly" after other words like "increasingly" or "solely". Members detect "public" and its common continuations.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ance' (also 'ence') completing a noun like surveillance, reluctance or dominance. It stays quiet on 'ance' in 'finance' and 'enhance', so it needs the noun-suffix use after a word stem.

result.description: Fires on a noun (tool, option, advantages) right after an evaluative adjective such as essential, crucial, advanced, significant, in expository technical text. It is weaker on other nouns in similar slots.

result.description: Fires on words like "combined", "equally", "equal" and "lying" in probability and math explanations (e.g. "equally likely", "combined probability"). Peaks are mixed and the logits are unclear. Members are mostly math and statistics context.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sem' when it begins "semiconductor" in materials/electronics text, after words like n-type, doped, pure, extrinsic. Silent when ' sem' starts the text with no preceding context.

result.description: Fires on the token " Roman" (also Byzantine pieces) in history text about Rome and the Eastern Roman Empire, usually after "the". Silent when " Roman" starts the text. Members are Roman, ancient-history and Greek/Latin detectors.

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing the word "incorporation" (after 'incorpor'). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as experimentation, narration and reevaluation. It weakly fires on 'vulner' in "vulnerability".

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' int' and ' eng' when they begin a word being repeated or continued, as in "intimate int|imate" or "reader eng|agement". Silent when ' int' opens the text. Seems to fire on the repeat of a word just seen.

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ith' inside words like lithium, lithography and megalithic, with weaker hits on 'cop'/'scop' and similar mid-word pieces ('ym' in lymphatic). Silent on the full word 'lithium' later in text.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' arrang' (start of "arrangements") and on 'xt' in "juxtaposition", where the word is incomplete and continues with a suffix. Mostly the first piece of these multi-token words.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ership", mainly at the end of "Leadership" in a heading-like list of leadership styles. Weaker on " leadership" and "speakership". Supported by token detectors for "ership" and leader/leadership words.

result.description: Fires on the word " cost" (also " costs", " trade", " production") mostly as the first part of a compound or noun phrase like "cost control", "cost allocation", "free trade". Members are mostly detectors of " cost"/" costs" in business and finance text.

result.description: Fires on the word " reality", mostly in "augmented reality" and "virtual reality" in tech text. It stays silent when " reality" starts a document or phrase with no preceding "virtual" or "augmented". It also fires weakly on "machine learning".

result.description: Fires on the word ' new' (also novel/innov variants) when it is an adjective before a plural or abstract noun, often after "of", "with", "to" or a verb. Members are mostly ' new' detectors.

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'strateg' (and 'ateg', 'econom', 'forec', 'anticip') in game-theory and economics text, where the word is incomplete and a suffix like -ic or -ies follows. It is silent on some 'strateg' tokens, such as after "dominant" or "non-combat".

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ural' when it completes the word "plural" (after 'pl'), mostly in grammar text. It is much weaker on 'ural' in other words such as "structural" or "cultural", and on a few other word endings.

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' st' when it is a split-off start of a word, mostly in stakeholder-related text (e.g. 'st' + 'akeholders'). It stays silent on ' st' at the very start of a document.

result.description: Fires on the token ' action' (and ' Action'), as in "philosophy of action", "in action", "action potential". Members are mostly detectors of action/actions plus some philosophy-topic context. Silent on text without the word.

result.description: Fires on the 'll' piece inside "syllable(s)" after "sy", in linguistics/phonology text. Silent when 'll' starts the text without the preceding "sy".

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of specific words: 'osh' in Photoshop and ' accept' in acceptance, with weaker hits on 'ust' and 'age' (patronage). Mostly a word-piece detector, with a few unrelated pieces.

result.description: Fires on word pieces like ' analyt' (in "data analytics") and ' scient' after data-related words. It stays silent on ' analyt' after "predictive" or "descriptive", so it seems to need a preceding "data" context.

result.description: Fires on the token ' discuss' (as in "When discussing…" at the start of a document). Members detect discuss/discussion/conversation words and the opening "When it comes". The contrast has no ' discuss' token.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Enc' (start of Encoding/Encryption/Encoded), especially after "One-Hot" or at the start of a heading. Weak on a few other word-start fragments. Silent on unrelated data text.

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ol' when it completes the name "Mongol" (Mongol, Mongolian, Mongolianism). It stays silent on 'ol' in other words such as "rhizolic" or at word start.
result.label: 'ol' in Mongol

result.description: Fires on the word " beyond" (extends/goes/applies beyond X), mostly in abstract or academic text. Upstream members are mainly " beyond" detectors, plus similar words like "outside" and "transcend". The target is silent on text without that word.
result.label: ' beyond' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token "dimensional" in hyphenated compounds like two-dimensional, three-dimensional and infinite-dimensional. Members detect "dimensional" itself plus the preceding hyphen and number prefix. Silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: hyphenated "-dimensional" token

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes such as 'an' (mostly in "Raman"), also 'ly' (jelly), 'ent', 'ful', when they complete a split-up word or name. Silent on 'an' in other words like "Nano" or the article "an".
result.label: Suffix 'an' in Raman

result.description: Fires on math-field nouns (geometry, equations, algebra, mathematics) at the end of a phrase, especially in history-of-mathematics text (Babylonian mathematics, algebra and geometry). Silent on "geometry" in physics or differential-geometry contexts.
result.label: Math field nouns in math history

result.description: Fires on the capital ' Y' piece that starts "Yoga" when it is split into tokens (e.g. "Purpose of Yoga", "Jnana Yoga"). It also fires on a few other word-initial pieces like ' UI' and ' U'. Weak on ' liquid'.
result.label: Y- in split word Yoga

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' enh' (start of enhance, enhancement, enhances), mostly in "to enhance" or "enhancements". Members are mainly detectors of ' enh' and similar prefixes like ' ref'. It is silent on texts about efficiency without that word piece.
result.label: ' enh' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word " hard" (also hard- word starts like hardness, hardened) and weakly on " easy"/" easier"/" difficult". Members detect "hard" and its derivatives, mainly in materials-science contexts.
result.label: ' hard' and easy/difficult adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "oe" inside rare words like onomatopoeia and thermoelectric, with a weaker case on "and" in "Demand". Mostly a within-word piece detector.
result.label: "oe" inside onomatopoeia/thermoelectric

result.description: Fires on the token "line" as a word ending in compounds (frontline, punchline, streakline, headline). Members are mostly "line"/"lines" detectors in early layers. It stays silent on text without such a word piece.
result.label: "line" ending compound words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ysis' after a word stem such as 'Catal' in catalysis, and on plural 's' ending 'Conjunctions'. Silent when 'ysis' starts a document with no stem before it.
result.label: -ysis suffix and plural -s

result.description: Fires on a scattered set of tokens (' integration', ' dynamic', ' enabled', ' vast', 'ew', 'ell') with no shared meaning. Members mostly detect odd word pieces from early layers. Silent on 'seamless integration', so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered word pieces, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' Cla' (as in Clause/Clauses/Clausing) in grammar-related text, with weaker firing on ' normal' (normal forms), ' cer' and 'second'. Mostly a detector of the ' Cla' prefix before 'use'.
result.label: ' Cla' prefix of Clause

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' completing "express|ive" (expressive), mostly after the piece "express". It stays silent on 'ive' in other words like "subjective". Members detect 'ive' endings and 'express' stems.
result.label: 'ive' in "expressive"

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' that begins a four-digit year (e.g. 1958, late 1970s), where the next token is likely '9'. It stays silent on '1' in other positions, such as the third digit of 20[1]0 or 200[1]s.
result.label: Leading '1' of 19xx year

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'land' (also 'lands') when it follows 'g' to spell 'gland', as in 'glandular' or 'gland cells', in endocrine and biology text. Silent on other contexts, including the contrast text about exocrine functions.
result.label: 'land' piece in 'gland'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'ni' (in omnipresent) and 'lic' (in garlic, slicing), plus occasionally ' prof'. Members detect word-start pieces like 'gar', 'om', and 'lic', so it needs the specific partial-word context.
result.label: Word fragments 'ni' and 'lic'

result.description: Fires on ' nas' (nasal) and on fragments of rare multi-byte symbols such as subscript, math, or special characters (Aleph-null, braces, boxes). It also takes Arabic-script token inputs. The peaks are mixed and low in consistency.
result.label: ' nas' and rare symbol bytes
' sensitive' token detector
result.description: Fires on the word ' sensitive' (e.g. sensitive data, sensitive listening, sensitive approach). Members are mostly early-layer detectors of ' sensitive' plus security/vulnerability words. Silent on unrelated text about secure communication that lacks the word.

Fires on the word piece "chan" or " Mechan" in mechanic-/mechanism-type words (Mechanical, biomechanics, mechanisms), at the point where the word is incomplete. Members are detectors of mechan/chan pieces.
result.label: Mechan- word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nan' (or ' Nan') when it begins nano- words such as nanotechnology, nanomaterial, nanoscale, in scientific materials text. Members detect ' nan' and materials/technology context.
result.label: nan- prefix of nano words

result.description: Fires on the word " cost" (rarely " portion") when it starts a compound or modifier, such as "food cost percentage" or "cost-cutting", in restaurant and food-business text. Members are mostly cost/costs detectors plus cooking-topic ones.
result.label: ' cost' in food-cost compounds

result.description: Fires on the abstract noun right after "and" in a coordinated noun pair in organizational or HR-style text (e.g. "compensation and benefits", "management and feedback", "learning and growth"). It stays quiet on the same nouns outside that slot, such as "development" after an adjective.
result.label: Second noun in "X and Y" pair

result.description: Fires on digit tokens (mostly 1, 3, 2) inside slash-separated lists of numbers, such as 3/4/4/11/10/15. It stays silent on digits starting years in prose, like "in 1980".
result.label: Digits in slash-separated number lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ement' ending "Agreement", especially in "North American Free Trade Agreement" in treaty contexts. It stays silent on 'ement' in "refinement" and "confinement".
result.label: 'ement' in Agreement (treaties)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cul' (as in culinary, culminates) in the middle of a sentence. It is silent when ' cul' is the very first token of the text. Members detect ' cul' itself plus cooking and food context.
result.label: ' cul' piece (culinary)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'il', 'ic', 'ol' in the middle of a word, strongest on 'il' in "Soil" at the start of a heading-like line. Silent on 'ic' in other words such as Metabolic or Economic.
result.label: 'il' in Soil, word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on nouns of struggle and opposition (' struggle', ' conflict(s)', 'confront-ations') in analytical or historical/literary prose about ideological, psychological or military clashes. Members detect struggle, conflict, war and difficulty words.
result.label: struggle / conflict nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ion' (also 'er', 'es') when it completes the word "cohesion" or the start of "coherence/coherent" after 'coh'/'cohes'. It stays silent on 'ion' in other words like "prevention".
result.label: Suffix in cohesion/coherence
Capitalized "Language" as list heading
result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Language' when it starts a heading or list item, such as "Language Assessment" or "Language Policy" in a series of topic headings. It is nearly silent on "Languages" as a list item, and only weakly active on lowercase "language".
Fires on mid-word pieces 'icult' in "multicultural(ism)" and 'ational' in "organizational", before the word's ending. Silent on other culture-related words like "cultural" or "linguistic diversity".
result.label: multicult-/organiz-ational word pieces

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'lin' in "pollination" and related words (pollinators, pollinated), after the 'pol' piece. It stays silent when 'lin' starts a word. Weaker on ' vs' and 'loyment'.
result.label: 'lin' in pollination

result.description: Fires on the word "Menu" (or "menu"), especially as a heading at the start of a line or document, such as "Menu Theme." or "Menu Balance." in restaurant menu-design outlines. Members are mostly "Menu" detectors.
result.label: Menu token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' fl' when it starts a longer word such as flour, flute, fluctuations or flourishes. Members are mostly ' fl' token detectors from early layers. Silent on text without this piece.
result.label: ' fl' word-start piece
'vere' in sovereignty
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vere' in "sovereignty" (so|vere|ignty), mostly in political or international-relations text. It fires weakly on ' strict' and 'dis'. Predicts word continuations such as 'ance'.

Fires on the word "cluster" (and the piece "clust" in "clustering") in technical text about star or galaxy clusters and clustering algorithms. Members mostly detect cluster/clust/clustering tokens. Silent on the contrast passage about galaxies.
result.label: cluster / clustering token

result.description: Fires on the word right after "imagine" (mostly " a", also " you", " this", " if"), as in "imagine a world where...". Silent on " a" in other constructions. Members detect "imagine".
result.label: Word after "imagine"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Spe" at the start of a line or heading, where the next piece is "ech" (e.g. "Speech Evaluation", "Speech Topics"). Weakly fires on other word-start fragments. Members are many "Spe" detectors.
result.label: Spe- start of "Speech" headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "itable" completing "equ|itable" (equitable), mostly before nouns like distribution or public transportation. Members detect the "equ" prefix plus "itable"/"ity" pieces. Silent on related fairness text without that word.
result.label: "equitable" suffix piece 'itable'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' bar' when it begins "barriers" (e.g. "high barriers", "barriers to entry"), predicting the continuation "riers". Members are mostly detectors of ' bar' and 'riers'.
result.label: ' bar' start of 'barriers'

result.description: Fires on the second piece of "woodcut"/"woodblock" ('cut', 'block') in printmaking text, after "wood". Weakly fires on other print terms such as silkscreen printing. Members detect 'wood', 'cut', and print/art words.
result.label: woodcut / woodblock printmaking

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of technical terms, mainly 'osph' in phosphate and 'ain' in "Supply Chain", also 'ric' and 'cyt'/'et' in biochemical words. Mostly chemistry/biology word fragments.
result.label: Word fragments: osph, chain

result.description: Fires on " bodies" as the head noun after "water" (water bodies). Weaker on other uses like "these bodies". Members include detectors of bodies/body and water-related words.
result.label: "bodies" after water

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ars' inside 'rehearsal(s)', the middle token of the split word. Members are mostly 'ars' detectors from early layers. Weak activation on a few other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ars' in rehearsal

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' rig' at the start of rigorous, rigidity or rigid, in academic and philosophical text. It also partly fires on the similar piece ' vig' in vigorous. Members detect ' rig' and 'orous'.
result.label: ' rig' in rigorous/rigid

result.description: Fires on the word " Law" in named scientific laws (Kepler's Third Law, Ampere's Law, Hooke's Law, Second Law). Weaker on lowercase "laws". Members are detectors of Law/law tokens.
result.label: Law in named physical laws

result.description: Fires on the 'NN' token in neural-network acronyms like RNN and CNN (R-NN, C-NN), in machine-learning text. Weak activation on a few other word-piece endings.
result.label: NN in RNN/CNN acronyms

result.description: Fires on the equals sign ' =' in mathematical or physics equations and assignments (E = hf, n = k, y' = y). It stays silent when '=' is missing and the equality is written in words.
result.label: Equals sign in equations

result.description: Fires on the word " from" right after a verb or noun of change or movement, such as "shift from", "shifted from", "transitioned from", "moved from". It marks the source in a "from X to Y" transition. It stays silent in text without this construction.
result.label: 'from' after shift/change words

result.description: Fires on ' as' in the "such as" construction, introducing examples after a noun. It stays silent on other uses of ' as', such as "as well as", "emerged as" or the causal "as".
result.label: "as" in "such as"

result.description: Fires on ' Theorem' (also ' Law', ' theorem') ending a named result, e.g. "Stokes' Theorem", "Central Limit Theorem", "Antitrust Law". It needs a preceding name or modifier; the bare word in a summary context stays silent.
result.label: Named Theorem / Law ending

result.description: Fires on the token ' news' (e.g. "consume news", "mobile news applications", "news reporting"), always in media-related text. Weak activation on 'emotion'. Upstream members are mostly ' news' token detectors plus media/information words.
result.label: ' news' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ities' completing the word "opportunities" (after "opportun"), strongest in phrases like "offer/provide opportunities for". Silent on 'ities' in other words such as "humanities".
result.label: 'ities' ending "opportunities"

result.description: Fires on ' directed' (as in directed graph) and on word pieces like 'it' in 'epitaxial' or 'parasitic' and 'ed' endings. Mixed tokens; the ' directed' case is silent when it starts the text.
result.label: 'directed' and 'it'/'ed' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' polar' (as in polarization, polar solvents), mostly in physics and chemistry text. Members are mainly detectors of ' polar' and 'ization' tokens; the output pushes toward word completions such as -ized/-ity.
result.label: ' polar' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ament", mostly in "orn|ament|ation" (ornamentation) and similar words like fundamentals, filament, testament. Members detect "ament", "orn" and related word pieces.
result.label: "ament" piece in ornamentation

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside specific rare proper-name words, mainly 'antine' in Diophantine/Byzantine and 'anner' in Mannerist/Mannerism. It needs the preceding fragment of that word.
result.label: 'antine' / 'anner' word endings

result.description: Fires on the token " van"/" Van" (also the "van" in "vanishing"), typically as a surname particle before names like Gogh or Rijn. Predicts a following name piece. Weaker on a few unrelated words.
result.label: ' van' name particle

result.description: Fires on the token ' aircraft' in aeronautical engineering text (aircraft design, flow, behavior). Members detect aerospace words such as aircraft, space, astronaut and aerospace. Weak activation on ' Sold' is incidental.
result.label: ' aircraft' in aerospace engineering text

result.description: Fires on the token " addition" when used as a noun for the process or operation (e.g. addition polymerization, electrophilic addition, addition rule). Windows are mostly chemistry and math. Members are mostly detectors of " addition".
result.label: ' addition' as process noun

result.description: Fires on begin/start verbs (' begins', ' starts', ' begin', ' Start'), mostly when they introduce a "begin with..." phrase or a first step or stage. Members detect begin/start tokens and "with" after them.
result.label: begin/start verbs

result.description: Fires on the 'bach' piece in the name "Goldbach" (Goldbach's Conjecture), after 'Gold'. Rare weaker firing on other mid-word pieces. Silent on the conjecture text without that name.
result.label: 'bach' in Goldbach

result.description: Fires on a sentence- or heading-ending period (or ").") that closes a short phrase or heading line, often before a newline and a new item. It stays silent on periods inside initials or names like "T." or "W.".
result.label: Sentence-final period after headings

result.description: Fires on the piece "ant" completing "Protestant" (e.g. "Protestant Ethic", "Protestant countries"). Members detect "Protest" and the "ant" token, plus Reformation and Church context. It stays silent on other religious text without that word.
result.label: "ant" in Protestant

result.description: Fires on enabling/facilitating verbs such as "enables", "helps", "helping", "enabling" (also "allows"), typically after a subject or clause and before an object that benefits. Members mostly detect enable/allow/help tokens.
result.label: enable/help verbs

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al'/'als' completing "numeral(s)", mostly in math-history text about Arabic or Indian numeral systems. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "instrumental" and "positional".
result.label: numer-al suffix in numeral

result.description: Fires on a few adjective-like words, mainly " external" and " unexpected", also "ended" (unintended) and " concurrent". Members include detectors for external and unexpected. Peaks are mixed across words, with weaker firing on "external magnetic".
result.label: external / unexpected adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word " number"/" Number" when it ends a technical compound term such as quantum number, Mach Number, Reynolds Number, prime number. Weaker on generic "a number of".
result.label: Technical term-final "number"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'io' inside "ultraviolet" (ultrav-io-let). Members detect 'io' and related mid-word fragments. Weaker firing on other mid-word pieces like "cel" in porcelain.
result.label: 'io' in ultraviolet

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " probabil" (as in probabilistic, probabilities) when split into subword pieces. It is silent on the whole word "probability". Members detect " probabil" and similar word-start fragments such as relativ, lingu and permut.
result.label: ' probabil' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece " posit" at the start of "positivism", "positivists" and "positives", especially after "logical" or "true/false". It is silent on related philosophy text that lacks the piece.
result.label: " posit" word piece (positivism/positives)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words split into pieces, mainly ' coh' (cohomology, coherence), also ' strateg', ' rel' (relays), ' gre'. Fires mid-word, when more pieces are expected next.
result.label: Word-start fragments: coh, strateg, rel

result.description: Fires on the token piece "ios" right after "b" in "bios..." words, mainly "biosensors" and "biosensory". It is silent in other biology text, such as the citric acid cycle text in the contrast.
result.label: "ios" in "bio-" words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' influ' (influences) and ' mus' (musicians), where the next piece completes the word. Weaker on whole-word starts. Silent on plain words in the contrast.
result.label: Word-start pieces influ- / mus-

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' bro' when it begins a longer word (broiler, broadening, broader, broth), anticipating a continuation piece. Members are mostly ' bro' and 'ader' detectors.
result.label: ' bro' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' property' in both senses (ownership/real property and attribute of a substance). Members are detectors of property/properties/material/premises tokens. Weakly fires on ' characteristic' and ' properties'.
result.label: ' property' token detector

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb "has"/"have" (present perfect), including when the forms are mentioned in grammar discussion. Members detect has/have and predict "been", "always", "become" next. Silent on text about tenses that lacks the word.
result.label: Auxiliary has/have (present perfect)

result.description: Fires on the token " questions" (plural), mostly after a modifier such as reflective, rhetorical, philosophical, probing or indirect. Members are mainly detectors of "question(s)" tokens. Silent on contrast text with no such token.
result.label: ' questions' after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ca' inside "concave" (Con-ca-ve, Bicon-ca-ve), the middle piece of the word. Weaker on other mid-word pieces after "con"/"c" prefixes.
result.label: 'ca' in concave

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ien' in words like alienation and audiences, and 'y' in catchy. Members detect word pieces after 'al'/'aud' prefixes (loy, ph, ve, -). Silent on ordinary running text.
result.label: Mid-word 'ien' piece (alienation, audiences)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'duct' inside "superconductor/superconductivity/superconducting". It stays silent on 'duct' in "semiconductor", so it needs the "supercon-" prefix.
result.label: 'duct' in superconductor words
'ers' ending in "followers"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ers' completing the word "followers" (after "follow"). It is much weaker on other -ers/-ants words such as landowners and merchants, and silent on 'ers' in fosters, consumers or "umers".

Fires on the word-piece ' en' when it begins a longer word (enlargement, enriching, enzyme, enabling, encompasses). Members are mostly detectors of ' en' itself; output favors continuations like 'hanced', 'abling', 'velope'.
result.label: ' en' word-initial prefix

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'ots' in "grassroots" (also in knots) and 'es' in "challenges", after the preceding fragments 'grass'/'alleng'. Silent on 'ots' in "green shoots", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: grassroots / challenges word endings

result.description: Fires mostly on " ever" (e.g. "than ever before", "Will X ever", "ever-evolving") and on the "ro" piece at the start of "Electro-" words like electrode, electrolysis. Also weakly on " proportional".
result.label: " ever" and "Electro-" ro

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix (-ts, -als, -ians, -s) completing a person-role noun like experts, professionals, historians, analysts, usually in lists of professions or groups of people.
result.label: Plural agent-noun endings (experts, professionals)

result.description: Fires on the token 'BI' when it completes an acronym after a capital letter, as in "C[BI]" for Content-Based Instruction. It stays silent when 'BI' starts the text, with no preceding letter.
result.label: BI in acronym CBI

result.description: Fires on the word " sentence" (occasionally " paragraph") in grammar and writing-instruction text, e.g. "topic sentence" or "sentence types". It is silent when " sentence" starts the text with no preceding word.
result.label: Grammar term " sentence"

result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: the suffix 'ous' inside words like "warehousing", and the words ' separate', ' distinct' and ' low'. The 'ous' peak is silent in "ambiguous" and "simultaneous". Peaks are mixed and the logits are not informative.
result.label: ous / separate / distinct mixed detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ir" inside "squirrel"/"squirting" (after "squ"). Weaker on other mid-word pieces. Silent on "ir" in other words like "tiosir". Members detect "ir" and "squ" pieces.
result.label: "ir" in "squirrel"

result.description: Fires on ' algorithm(s)' / 'Algorithm' (including 'algorithmic'), especially in art-related text about algorithmic art. Silent on 'learning algorithms' in a machine-learning context, so it seems to need an art or creative-technique context.
result.label: algorithm in art contexts
'vent' piece in "solvent"
result.description: Fires on the token 'vent' when it completes "solvent" (sol|vent), mostly in chemistry or green-chemistry text. It weakly fires on 'vent' in "invention" and on a few other word pieces. Members are mostly 'vent' detectors.

Fires on the word " important" in the construction "it is important to...", where it introduces an infinitive. Weaker on "particularly important". Members are mostly detectors of " important" and similar words such as critical and essential.
result.label: "is important to" adjective

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' as the first digit of a number at or near the start of a document or list item (e.g. "1.10", "10.", "11."). Weaker on '1' beginning years like 1837 or 18th; silent on '1' inside later positions of numbers like 2010 or 21st.
result.label: Leading digit '1' at number start

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside long or rare words, mainly 'th' in "plethora"/"plethysmography" and 'ic' in "Hyperbolic". Silent on 'th' in "20th" or "fostereth". Members detect earlier pieces like "ple", "bol", "bi".
result.label: Mid-word piece in rare words

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "oring" in "Exploring", "ving" in "Delving", and "law" in "flawless", mostly at the start of a document or phrase as the opening of an explore/delve-into style title or sentence. Mixed suffix pieces.
result.label: Explore/delve word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' error', most strongly in "quantum error correction", and weakly on 'errors' elsewhere. Predicts ' correction' next. Members include error-token detectors and quantum-context detectors.
result.label: 'error' in quantum error correction

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing "elasticity" (after "elast"/"astic"), in physics/economics text. It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like scarcity, viscosity, electricity and individuality.
result.label: 'ity' ending "elasticity"

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract or technical head noun (rule of, choreography of, powers of, points of) in academic or math/science text. It stays quieter after quantity or study nouns like 'sum of', 'number of', 'study of'.
result.label: ' of' after abstract head noun

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "replicate" forms (rep-lic-ating, -licated, -lication), mostly in DNA replication text. It stays silent on other "-ating" endings like facilitating or coordinating, so it needs the replic- stem.
result.label: replicating/replicated word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ather" in "Rather" at the start of a sentence (often "Rather than"), also in "Weather" and "gatherers". It stays silent in "feather". Weakly fires on " remain(s)".
result.label: "ather" piece, sentence-initial Rather

result.description: Fires on the token ' typing' in programming-language type-system discussion, as in "strong typing", "dynamic typing" and "static typing". Its inputs include several ' typing' detectors and programming-context members.
result.label: ' typing' in type systems

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' Liter', ' Roc', ' Art'/' art' that begin a topic or subject-list entry (e.g. "Literary ..." in lists of categories), mostly in art/literature heading lists. Silent on the plain "Art." list item.
result.label: Liter/Art word-start in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Real" when it starts a longer word, as in Realism, Realists or Fantasy Realms. It is a word-start piece that needs a suffix to follow. Members mostly detect " Real" itself, plus other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' Real' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word ' large' (size adjective), mostly before nouns like datasets, numbers, or solution spaces in technical or computational text. Members detect large/massive/small/grand size words. Predicts quantity-type nouns next.
result.label: ' large' size adjective

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'ir' (Sap-ir, Stirling, Langmuir) and 'le' in "Role", i.e. word pieces within particular split words. Silent on ordinary text.
result.label: 'ir' and 'le' word pieces

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' achieved'/' achieve', 'ounded' in "Boundedness", 'ery', ' compatibility'. No shared meaning is evident, and the members are scattered word-piece and past-participle detectors.
