result.label: Mixed: achieved, Bounded, -ery pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " nature" as an abstract noun after an adjective (dynamic, intermittent, variable nature), plus a few similar nouns like "ability", "inherent", "dependence". Many members are early-layer detectors of " nature". Silent where no such noun appears.
result.label: Abstract "nature" after adjective

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment " ex" (exerts, exposes, exaggerated, exoplanets), and occasionally on " c", " syn" or "en" in academic text. It predicts a continuation that completes the word, such as "poses" or "changes".
result.label: Word-initial " ex" fragment

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces, such as ' Hel' (Heliobacter, Helmut), ' rib' (ribosome) and ' Ab' (Abugida). It's a word-start piece that needs a continuation, and it stays silent on whole names.
result.label: Word-initial fragments Hel, rib, Ab

result.description: Fires on the token ' s' when it is a word-initial fragment starting a split word (s|yllogism, s|ieve, s|lip, s|aturation), not on 's' as an ordinary word. Predicts continuation pieces of the word.
result.label: Word-initial ' s' fragment
'al' in nasal word
result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' when it completes "nas|al" (nasal, nasalization), in linguistics text. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as reveal, lateral or consonantal.
Fires on the word piece "let" inside multi-piece words, mainly "Ske|let|al" (skeletal, exoskeletons), also wavelet and Ballet. Members are "let" detectors and word-start pieces.
result.label: "let" piece in skeletal

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "ivity" in "conductivity" and "chem" in "electrochemical"/"petrochemicals", within physical-science and chemistry terms. Silent on "ivity" in "connectivity" and "reactivity".
result.label: Conductivity / electrochem word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token " Hand" (also "Hand"), mostly as a word-start piece in Handel, Handbook, Handling or Hand Washing. Weaker on " promise(s)" and " other". Members are mostly detectors of word-initial fragments.
result.label: Hand word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments such as 'ao' (Daoism), 'al' in "Moral" at title starts, ' curv', and ' Sto', where the word is unfinished. The logits are mixed and give no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ao, al, curv

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "period" (e.g., "period of time", "Classical Period of music"). It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "advent", "pulse" or "redefinition".
result.label: " of" after "period"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' encou' (and ' encourag') in forms of "encourage", especially mid-word before "rage", as in "rates encourage borrowing". Predicts the continuation "rage". Also weakly fires on some stray tokens like ' \['.
result.label: encourage word-piece (encou-)

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'chn' and 'chem' inside bio- compounds such as biotechnology and biochemical, after a 'bio' or 'biote' prefix. It stays silent on 'chem' in electrochemistry.
result.label: chn/chem after bio- prefix

result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'ine'/'ines' completing the word "vaccine(s)", after the 'vacc' piece. It stays silent on 'ines' in other words such as "examines". Members detect 'vacc' and 'ine' pieces.
result.label: vaccine(s) word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the word "mathematics" (also "mathematical", "Mathemat-") as the noun naming the field, e.g. "foundations of mathematics", "modern mathematics". Members are token detectors for mathematics and related math terms.
result.label: Word "mathematics"

result.description: Fires on the single letter 'l' (or 'L') as a standalone token, often a mid-word fragment such as phytop|l|ankton, over|l|ays or the quantum number m_l. Members are mostly 'l' token detectors.
result.label: Isolated letter 'l' token

result.description: Fires on stray punctuation-like symbol tokens such as ' _', ' *', and ' \[' in garbled lists, markup or math fragments, often after commas. Members are mostly topic hubs for language and grammar text, plus Arabic piece detectors. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Stray underscore/asterisk symbols in lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'iqu' in "etiquette" and 'opher' in "philosopher", i.e. the middle or end of a specific multi-piece word after an 'et'/'philos' start. Members detect 'et' + piece fragments.
result.label: etiquette / philosopher word pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'as' in persuasive, 'qu' in tranquil, and 'ul'/'bul' in turbulent. These pieces sit inside longer, multi-token words, mainly "persuasive". Upstream members detect 'as' and ' persu'.
result.label: Mid-word piece in persuasive/tranquil

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uct' inside "deductive"/"deducing" (after "ded"), in logic and reasoning text. It stays silent when 'uct' starts the text with no "ded" before it.
result.label: 'uct' in "deductive"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ly' right after 'smooth' (smoothly), especially describing manner of motion. Silent on 'ly' in other words like 'unwittingly' or 'orderly'. Members detect 'smooth' and -ness/-ly suffixes.
result.label: 'ly' in 'smoothly'

result.description: Fires on the 't' token of negative contractions (n't: wasn't, can't, don't, didn't), after the apostrophe. Silent on 't' inside words like fine-tuning. Predicts continuations like "just".
result.label: Contraction n't 't' token

result.description: Fires on the adverb " greatly" (occasionally " significantly") as an intensifier before or after a verb like enhance, improve, contribute or affect. Members are detectors of greatly, significantly, substantial and similar degree adverbs.
result.label: ' greatly' degree adverb

result.description: Fires mostly on " West" (the West / West Germany / West Berlin) and on "MD" in abbreviations like HMDs, with a few stray tokens. Mixed word pieces; the contrast text only has "Western", where it stays silent.
result.label: ' West' and 'MD' token pieces

result.description: Fires on the 'n' piece inside the word "remnants" (rem|n|ants), after the "rem" prefix. It stays silent on 'n' in other words such as supernova or cannibalism. Members detect "rem" word pieces.
result.label: 'n' in "remnants"

result.description: Fires on the copula ' was' (and ' were', weaker ' is') right after a noun-phrase subject, especially a sentence-initial or clause-initial subject like a topic noun. Silent after pronoun 'it' or in some other slots.
result.label: Copula 'was/were' after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'overy' (Discovery, Recovery) and sometimes 'l' in 'bowl', ' term', and similar mid-word fragments. Members mostly detect 'overy' and other word-start fragments.
result.label: 'overy' word-piece in Discovery/Recovery

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like plural 's', 'ing' at the start of grammar/error-themed text (conjunctions, Errors, Correcting). Silent on possessive 's. Members detect error words (mis, incorrect) and grammar terms.
result.label: Plural/suffix pieces in grammar-error text

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ag' (as in Agile, Agenda) when it begins a word, mostly in title-like text. Members are mainly ' Ag' token detectors. It pushes the next token toward suffix pieces like 'ics', 'pl', 'ic'.
result.label: ' Ag' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the nouns ' decision' (decision-making, decision fatigue) and ' independence' (esp. 'linear independence'). Members are detectors of these tokens and their variants. Silent on other linear algebra text.
result.label: ' decision' / ' independence' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' mainly after "eth" (ethical), and weakly on 'able' in "sustainable". It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like philosophical, hierarchical, ecological.
result.label: 'ical' in "ethical"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Tra'/' tra' (start of Traffic, trait, traumatic), most strongly on ' Tra' beginning a line in a list of engineering topics such as "Traffic Safety". Mostly a token detector with an early-layer feel.
result.label: ' Tra' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token "life" when it ends a hyphenated compound, most clearly "half-life", also "work-life" and "wildlife". Silent on unrelated text. Members mostly detect "life" itself at earlier layers.
result.label: "life" in hyphenated compounds (half-life)

result.description: Fires on the 'ass' piece (or 'agr') inside the word "seagrass"/"seagrasses", in marine ecosystem text. It stays silent on 'ass' in other words like "encompass" or "biomass".
result.label: 'ass' in seagrass

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "atable" in "relatable", and weakly on other mid-word fragments like "aint" in "uncertainties", "ations" in "Quotations" and "ie" in "Lucie". It needs the piece to sit inside a longer word.
result.label: "atable" suffix in relatable

result.description: Fires on " also" after a subject or auxiliary verb (is also, should also, can also, may also). Stays silent when "also" follows "while" or "but", or starts a sentence.
result.label: " also" after auxiliary or verb

result.description: Fires on the word piece " fa" when it starts "facial" (as in facial expressions or action units). It predicts continuations like "cial", and the circuit leans on face and expression context plus " fa" detectors.
result.label: " fa" start of "facial"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'gar' in "Edgar" (also avant-garde), and weakly on ' built' and ' dot'. It is silent on 'gar' in "Medgar", so it needs the preceding "Ed" piece.
result.label: 'gar' in Edgar

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' div' (start of divide/divides/dividing), strongest in "cultural divides"; weakly on other split-word pieces like ' cons' and ' dep'. Predicts suffixes such as 'ides'.
result.label: ' div' word-piece before -ides

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "ine" in "decline" and "orient" in "-oriented", plus occasionally " hidden" or " invisible". Mostly a mid-word piece detector, with members detecting "ine" after "decl".
result.label: decl-ine / -orient word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word "demand"/"demanded" in economic contexts, and on the pieces "and" and "ly" completing "Demand and Supply" in a question about economics definitions. Members are mostly "demand" detectors plus economics context.
result.label: Economic "demand" and Demand/Supply

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces 'iation' (differentiation, negotiation, mediation, aviation) and 'y' ending abstract nouns like sovereignty or philosophy. Needs the preceding word stem to complete such a noun.
result.label: Abstract-noun suffix: -iation / -y

result.description: Fires on the token ' concept' (also 'concepts' and the 'concept' piece of 'conceptual/conceptualized'), mostly in academic, linguistic or philosophical text. Members are mainly detectors of 'concept' plus linguistics/philosophy context words.
result.label: ' concept' token detector

result.description: Fires on scattered word fragments and mid-word pieces (ini, ohen, fug, az, boy) that begin or continue rare or multi-token words, with no single token dominating. Members are mostly token-level detectors of odd subword pieces.
result.label: Rare word-fragment pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " matrix" (occasionally " space") in linear algebra text, e.g. "square matrix", "inverse matrix", "vector space". Members are mostly matrix-token detectors plus math-topic context.
result.label: matrix in linear algebra

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix piece "ities" completing "externalities" (and "Securities"), and on " Des" at word start. Members detect "ities"/"ity" endings and the word " external". Weaker on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: "ities" suffix in externalities

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'bad' inside 'troubadour(s)', with weaker firing on ' too' and 'ue' in 'venue'. Members are 'bad' detectors, so it is mainly a word-piece detector for 'troubadour'.
result.label: 'bad' in troubadour

result.description: Fires on the word piece " surv" at the start of survival/survive/surviving, mostly in survival analysis text. It also fires weakly on " capt" in "captiv". Members are detectors of surv and ival.
result.label: ' surv' word-start piece
Word-initial fragments Relig/Ro/Cir
result.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word near the start of a document or title, mainly ' Relig', ' Ro' (as in "The Role of"), and ' Cir'. It seems to predict the word's continuation. Members are mostly generic.

Fires on the capital letter 'Y' as a word piece inside uppercase or split words (ARYABHATIYA, COSY, PPHPHYZERCY, High-Yielding). Weak activation on ' body' in "the body's". Silent on ordinary text without such a piece.
result.label: Capital Y word-piece

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "ach" in "Outreach" (also in other "ach" pieces such as Bhaskaracharya), with weaker firing on " fun" and " jo". Members are mostly detectors of "ach" and similar word pieces.
result.label: "ach" piece in Outreach

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a document-initial title or heading, mainly ' Bi' in "Biomedical", also ' farm' and ' restaur'. Culinary-themed members contribute, but the peak is mostly the start-of-document ' Bi'.
result.label: Document-initial ' Bi' (Biomedical) token

result.description: Fires on ' concept' and ' notion' (also ' idea') as a head noun after "the", typically before "of X" in academic or scientific explanations. Silent when the word starts a sentence or is a prefix of "conceptualization".
result.label: concept/notion after "the"

result.description: Fires on the "ages" piece after "w" in the word "wages" (also "age" in "wage and hour"), mostly in labor-economics text. Weaker on other "w"-initial word pieces.
result.label: "ages" in "wages"

result.description: Fires on the word " legal" (adjective before nouns like procedures, regimes, documents) and on "utter" inside "shutter" in photography text. Two unrelated tokens share the latent; the contrast text has neither.
result.label: ' legal' and 'shutter' piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ation' (sometimes 'ed') when it completes the word "relax" (relaxation, relaxed). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as motivation, reverberation and sensation.
result.label: 'ation' ending of relaxation

result.description: Fires on "balance" as a word, either the word piece "ance" completing "Bal-ance" or the token " balance", as in "balance of trade". It stays silent on "ance" in other words such as finance, enhance and elegance.
result.label: Balance (Bal-ance) word

result.description: Fires on possessive determiners, mostly ' their' (also ' its', ' our'), after a verb or preposition in analytical text about characters and narratives. It predicts words like 'own' or 'respective'. Also fires on 'lict' in 'Conflict'. It stays quiet on some 'their' cases.
result.label: Possessive 'their' before noun

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' y' / ' Y' (word-initial y as in yoga, yarn, or the variable y). Members are mostly detectors of ' y' and ' Y' tokens; contrast text has no such token.
result.label: Word-initial ' y' / ' Y' token

result.description: Fires on the word " regression" (also pieces like "ate" in "Univariate Regression") in statistics and machine learning text, especially after "linear", "logistic" or "nonlinear". Members detect earlier "regression" tokens and statistics vocabulary.
result.label: statistical " regression" token

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ess' (also 'ment', 'ze', 'y') when it appears as a fragment in a word being discussed, such as "ess" in "essential" or "non-ess-ential". It is silent on the suffix in "awareness".
result.label: 'ess' word-piece fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece " imped" (start of "impedance"), mainly in "acoustic impedance" in physics/engineering text. Members are detectors of "imped" and similar word-start pieces. The contrast "acousticism" is silent.
result.label: " imped" in impedance

result.description: Fires on recovery-related words such as "recover", "recovery", "lost" (as in "recovery of lost data") and "backup", in contexts about restoring or retrieving data or materials. Members are mostly "recovery" token detectors.
result.label: recover / recovery / lost words

result.description: Fires on "commerce" in "e-commerce" (also m-commerce), occasionally "ail" in "retail", in online retail and business text. Weaker on "economy" after "circular". Mostly the token itself.
result.label: e-commerce token

result.description: Fires on " present" as a noun/adjective in "the present" (the present moment, present perfect), mostly in English grammar and tense discussions. Members detect "present", "past", "perfect" and other tense words.
result.label: " present" in tense discussions

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' mo' (as in "moisture") and ' Tem' (as in "Temporal", "Temperature"), where the next piece completes the word. Members are detectors of these specific fragments.
result.label: ' mo' / ' Tem' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the adjective " global" (occasionally " international") before a noun such as temperature, sea levels, or supply chains. Strongest in climate and world-scale contexts. Members are mostly detectors of "global"/"Global" and similar scope words like national.
result.label: Adjective "global" before noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ness" completing "weakness(es)", and more weakly on " force" and similar word endings. Silent on "ness" in other words like "interconnectedness" or "harness". Members detect "weak" and "ness" pieces.
result.label: "ness" in weakness
compar-ative / compar-isons word piece
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ative' (and 'isons') when it completes the word "comparative"/"comparisons". It stays silent on 'ative' in other words such as narrative, investigative, performative, interrogative.
Fires on the suffix piece 'ial' (also 'al', 'istic', 'ism') ending a word, most strongly in 'factorial' within math/programming text. Weaker on other suffixes like 'ization' or 'ist'.
result.label: Word-ending suffix 'ial' (factorial)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ob' in "aerobic"/"anaerobic" (and "anarobes"), in biology text about metabolism. It is quiet on unrelated text. Weak activity on other pieces like 'pun' and 'pr'.
result.label: 'ob' in aerobic/anaerobic

result.description: Fires on the word "Urban"/"urban", mostly at the start of a document or heading (e.g. "Urban Planning"). Fed by upstream city/urban/cities detectors. Weak on "ambient" and "riv".
result.label: Urban word detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ues' completing "blues" (bl+ues), and weakly on similar endings like 'ips' or 'ass'. Members detect 'bl' + 'ues'/'ue' pieces, so it needs the preceding 'bl' fragment, mostly in music contexts.
result.label: 'ues' ending of "blues"

result.description: Fires on the 'W' token in the acronym "DAW(s)" (Digital Audio Workstations), right after "DA". Silent on a bare "W" or on "D W" written separately. Predicts continuations like 's' or punctuation.
result.label: W in DAW acronym

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'od', 'urg', 'ive' inside longer words like mel-od-ies, lit-urg-ical, immers-ive, mostly in music/liturgy text. Members are 'od' token detectors plus music-word detectors.
result.label: Word-piece 'od'/'urg'/'ive' in music words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' in the split word "anom|al|ies" (data anomalies). It stays silent on 'al' in other words like "reveal" or "detrimental". Members detect 'anom' and 'ies' pieces around it.
result.label: 'al' inside "anomalies"

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a biochemical term (f-ruct, P-FK, Co-A, H-exokinase) in metabolic pathway text such as glycolysis and ATP reactions. It is silent in other biology text, such as apoptosis proteins.
result.label: Biochemistry term-start fragments

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes (mostly 'orial', also 'ive', 'ic', 'og') completing the split word "pict-" (pictorial, pictograms, pictive). Members detect 'ict' and 'og' pieces right before it.
result.label: Suffix after 'pict' (pictorial)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' inside a word after a prefix, as in cas-c-ades, ups-c-ale, trans-c-ends. It is silent on 'c' after 'un' in 'unclaimed'. It predicts word continuations like 'asc'.
result.label: 'c' inside words (cascade, upscale)

result.description: Fires mostly on ' year', ' years' and similar time-span words (period, decades, century) in phrases like "During the year" or "early years". It also fires weakly on scattered unrelated tokens, including Arabic word pieces. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Year / time-span words

result.description: Fires on the token ' genre' (all peaks), in any use such as genre mixing, genre-specific or musical genre. Weakly on 'genres' and related style words. Members are mostly detectors of genre/gen tokens plus music and literature context.
result.label: ' genre' token detector

result.description: Fires on the noun ' issue' (also ' problem', ' concern') when it names a topic or matter under discussion, often after "the", "major" or "important" and before "of" or "in". Members detect issue/problem/concern words.
result.label: issue/problem noun as topic

result.description: Fires on the word " algorithm" (or "Algorithm") as a standalone noun, typically after a named algorithm such as Bellman-Ford, Euclidean or Stein's. It stays silent on "algorithmic" and on text-initial "algorithm".
result.label: Named algorithm noun ' algorithm'

result.description: Fires on ' particularly' (also ' especially') when it follows a comma and introduces a narrowing example or qualifier, e.g. ", particularly in the North". It stays silent when the word is not after a comma, as in "time particularly beginning".
result.label: Comma-introduced 'particularly/especially'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'uk' inside a word after a preceding letter, as in e-uk-aryote or F-uk-ushima, and occasionally on 'ism' in Cubism. Silent when 'uk' begins the word (ukaryotic) with no prefix.
result.label: 'uk' mid-word piece (eukaryote)

result.description: Fires on nationality/ethnonym adjectives, mainly "American" (also Spanish, Scottish, German), especially in compounds like "Spanish-American" or "Native American". Silent on generic text about linguistic diversity without such a demonym.
result.label: Nationality adjective 'American' and similar

result.description: Fires on ' organization'/' organisation' as a business or institution noun in business/management text, and on 'ain' in 'Supply Chain' at a document start. Silent on "organization's" possessive-type contexts. Members detect supply, company and organization words.
result.label: organization / Supply Chain in business text

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces that need a continuation, mainly ' mil' (before "estone") mid-sentence, also 'co' in eco-, and ' streams' after "venue". Silent when ' mil' starts the text.
result.label: Word-start fragments: mil(estone), eco, venue streams

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ac' mid-word, mostly in "vernacular" (also 'ab', 'aking', 'ive'), in text about languages and history. Members detect 'ac' pieces and linguistic words.
result.label: 'ac' in vernacular

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix 'ography' (chromatography, geography) and also on scattered tokens like ' wild' and 'abeled'. Members are detectors of 'ography'/'ographic' pieces, mixed with technique and science words.
result.label: -ography word suffix, plus wild/labeled

result.description: Fires on the word or connector right after "labor/labour" or "worked" in labor-economics text (e.g. "econom", "and", "-", "for"). Members are labor, worker and job detectors. It stays quiet on " un" in other contexts.
result.label: Token after "labor" in labor-economics text

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'cient' (mostly in "Ancient" at the start of a heading), plus ' situ', ' Scient' and ' International'. It is mainly a token-piece detector, strongest on "Ancient" before a civilization name.
result.label: 'cient' in Ancient, situ, Scient

result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles ' a' and ' an' when they follow a verb or preposition and start a new noun phrase, such as "embarked on a", "maintaining a", "within an". It is silent after the copula "is a".
result.label: Indefinite article after verb/preposition

result.description: Fires mostly on " coding" (e.g. insecure coding, channel coding, network coding), and also on " seem" and "almost"/"become" as a weaker side trigger. Peaks are dominated by the token " coding" across subjects.
result.label: ' coding' token, plus ' seem'

result.description: Fires on ' especially' (occasionally ' particularly') when it follows a comma and introduces a narrowing qualifier after a clause, e.g. ', especially in fields such…' or ', especially when…'. Members detect especially/particularly tokens.
result.label: ', especially' qualifier after clause

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "hands-on" (occasionally "on" after it), mainly in education contexts. It stays silent on hyphens in other compounds like real-world, problem-solving or self-improvement. Members detect "hands" and the hyphen after it.
result.label: hyphen in "hands-on"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' bre' (breeding, breaches, breathe, breasts), predicting a continuation like 'ached' or 'eding'. It fires on the token itself; the contrast text has no ' bre'.
result.label: ' bre' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uten' in "gluten" and on ' rep' starting "replication"/"replica"/"repels". Two distinct word-piece detectors, mostly inside those specific words, in science or food text.
result.label: 'uten' of gluten, 'rep' of replication

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' adv' when it begins "advancement(s)", especially after "technological". Early-layer members detect ' adv' and related progress/enhance pieces. Predicts continuation like "anc" (ancement).
result.label: ' adv' in "advancements"

result.description: Fires on the 'n' piece inside 'Car|n|ivore/carnivorous', after the 'car' prefix. It stays silent on 'n' in other words like 'omnivores' or 'needn't'.
result.label: 'n' in carnivore

result.description: Fires on the word-initial capital token ' W' (Wave, Waves, Woolf, W boson), as a split-off first piece before a continuation like 'ave' or 'oolf'. Silent on other names in contrast lists.
result.label: Word-initial ' W' token

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in a few specific words: 'isk' in whisk/whisking, 'ctu' in punctuation, ' liter' in literacy, and 'prise' in enterprise. Members are detectors of these word pieces.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: whisk, punctuation, literacy

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of a name or word where a completion is likely, mostly 'we'/'y' in John Dewey, and 'solid' in 'solidarity', 'fost' in 'foster', in academic or philosophy text. Peaks are scattered and mixed.
result.label: Word pieces in Dewey, solidarity

result.description: Fires on the piece 'avel' inside 'wavelength(s)', after the initial 'w' token. It stays silent when 'avel' starts the text with no preceding 'w'. Members are mostly 'avel' detectors from early layers.
result.label: 'avel' in wavelength

result.description: Fires on the first token of a line or list item at document start or after a line break, such as ' Str', ' K', ' Frank', ' Den', where a name or heading begins and a word continues. Peaks are mixed, and the circuit relies on early name and heading-piece detectors.
result.label: Line-initial name or heading word piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " intr" (intricate, intrinsic, intrusion, intriguing), mostly in abstract or scientific prose. It predicts continuations like "insic" and "icate". It stays silent when " intr" begins the text.
result.label: " intr" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes completing a word after a stem, mostly 'ution' (el-ution, poll-ution), also 'ony' (harm-ony) and 'unity'. Members are detectors of these suffix pieces; it needs the piece to follow its stem.
result.label: '-ution' / '-ony' suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the pronoun "it"/"It" (including "it's") when it is the subject of a clause, often sentence-initial or after a conjunction ("It is possible", "when it comes"). Silent when "it" is an object ("spot it", "reading it", "believe it or not").
result.label: Subject pronoun "it"

result.description: Fires on the token "scale" (no leading space), mostly as the second part of a hyphenated compound such as "large-scale", "small-scale", "micro-scale" or "ro-scale". Members are mostly detectors of "scale".
result.label: hyphenated "-scale" token

result.description: Fires on the word " expression" / " expressions" as a noun, across artistic, emotional, linguistic and mathematical senses. Members are mostly detectors of the token itself. Silent on nearby text that lacks the word.
result.label: ' expression' token detector

result.description: Fires on prepositions like "through", "across", "for", "in" that follow a noun or abstract noun phrase in formal, abstract expository prose (technology, business), introducing means or scope. Silent on some "through" uses. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Means/scope prepositions after abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the token ' metal' (chemistry, sculpture, and music uses), supported by upstream detectors of 'metal', 'material' and 'iron'. It is silent on other material words such as leather and buttons.
result.label: ' metal' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' willing', ' wait/waiting', ' sav(ings)', ' slow', which are often followed by a suffix (-ness, -ings, -er). Mixed word set; the contrast is a generic text with none of these words.
result.label: willing/wait/sav word stems

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ael' at the end of "Carmichael" (in Carmichael numbers). Early-layer members detect 'ael' directly, plus preceding "Carmich" context. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'ael' in Carmichael

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ident' as a split-off fragment, such as in inc-ident, de-ident-ified or ident-ification. The members are mostly detectors of 'ident'. The contrast text, which has no 'ident' piece, stays silent.
result.label: 'ident' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ist'/'ists' completing the word "chemist(s)", after the 'chem' piece. Members detect 'chem', 'chemical' and '-ist' endings. It stays silent on chemistry text lacking the word chemist.
result.label: -ist suffix in chemist

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' nut' (and ' fert') before 'ritional/rients', mostly in agriculture, biology or food text. Members detect 'nut', 'fert' and agricultural terms.
result.label: nut- / fert- word start

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' select' when it is the start of a longer word such as selective, selectivity or selectors. Members are detectors of select/selecting/selection tokens.
result.label: ' select' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'press' when it is a stem inside a longer word such as high-pressure or compressible, where a suffix like -ure or -ible follows. Silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: 'press' word-piece stem

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'on' when it completes the word "phonon" (phon|on), as in phonon-phonon interactions. It stays silent on 'on' in other words such as "phenomenon".
result.label: 'on' ending "phonon"

result.description: Fires on the standalone letter 'e' as its own token, such as in "i.e.", "r.e.", or in lists like "5e/6e" and "2e-3e". It stays silent when 'e' sits inside an ordinary word like "sleeves" or "gaze".
result.label: Standalone letter 'e' (i.e.)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'chni' in "Techniques" headings, also 'use' and 'ord'. Looks like a detector of incomplete word pieces that expect a suffix to follow; the pieces are varied and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-fragment pieces like 'chni'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sc' when it begins "scanners" after a type word like flatbed, handheld or drum. Weak activity on other 'sc' pieces such as "scare". Silent on "scale" in the contrast.
result.label: ' sc' piece of "scanners"

result.description: Fires on words in saving-money / eco-efficiency text, mainly " saving", " money" after "save", and pieces like "sav", "pool", "solar". Context is cost-saving or energy-efficiency benefits; logits are unclear.
result.label: saving money / efficiency words

result.description: Fires on the piece "lock" after the prefix "un" (unlock, unlocking, unlocks), and weakly on a few other word-piece endings like "atur" in miniature. Members are mostly "lock" detectors.
result.label: "lock" in "unlock"
' day' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' day' in many uses: 'day after day', 'modern day', 'day 30', 'the 31st day', 'daylight'. Members are mostly ' day' detectors in early layers. Weaker on 'today'.
Fires on the hyphen directly after "human" in compounds like human-robot, human-machine, human-centered. It stays silent on hyphens after other words (object-, hands-, decision-, real-).
result.label: Hyphen after "human"

result.description: Fires on the word " texture" (rarely " bul", " cutting") as a noun in art, music, or food descriptions. Members are mostly texture-token detectors plus art and flavor context. The contrast silence is not explained.
result.label: Texture word detector

result.description: Fires on the token " out", both as a particle (map out, sketch out) and as the start of a word split into pieces (out-break, out-comes, out-door). Members are mostly " out" detectors. The contrast text has no " out".
result.label: ' out' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " prevent" (prevent, preventing, prevention, preventive), strongest at the start of those words. Weaker on standalone verb "prevent". Members are detectors of "prevent" plus similar verbs like minimize and limit.
result.label: " prevent" token detector

result.description: Fires on ' language' when it completes the phrase "body language". Silent on ' language' in other contexts like "English language" or "appropriate language". Members detect 'body' and 'language' tokens.
result.label: 'language' in "body language"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iling' inside 'bilingual' and 'multilingual' (bilingualism, multilingual). It stays silent when 'iling' starts the text with no preceding 'b' or 'mult' piece. Members detect 'iling', 'ual' and language-related words.
result.label: 'iling' in bilingual/multilingual

result.description: Fires on the hyphen directly after the prefix "non" (non-violence, non-verbal, non-greed), where a negated compound word follows. It stays quiet on hyphens in other compounds like well-defined or role-playing.
result.label: Hyphen after "non" prefix

result.description: Fires on the '0' digit as the second character of a year starting with "2" (2023, 2000, 2020s). It stays silent on '0' at the end of decade years like 1960s or 1990s.
result.label: '0' in 2000s-style years

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' herm' at the start of "hermeneutic/hermeneutics" and similar words, especially in philosophy text. Members include herm/hermaneutics detectors and philosophy-word members.
result.label: ' herm' start of hermeneutics

result.description: Fires on emotion words (anger, joy, happiness) when they appear in lists of basic emotions or emotional responses, often after other emotion words like sadness. Weak on related words like feelings.
result.label: Emotion words in emotion lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ical" completing "ethical" (eth+ical), as in "ethical dilemmas/issues". It stays silent on "ical" in other words like "philosophical". Supported by members detecting "eth" and "ical".
result.label: "ical" in "ethical"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'val' (in pre-val-ence) and 'inet' (in k-inet-ics), and weakly 'ru' in dis-ru-ptions. It needs the fragment inside the word; a word-initial 'val' stays silent.
result.label: Mid-word 'val'/'inet' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'asy' completing "fantasy" (e.g. "fant|asy realms", "science fantasy"). Members are 'asy' detectors plus fiction/narrative context words. Weak activation on other pieces.
result.label: 'asy' in fantasy

result.description: Fires on the piece right after the word "hand" (h, w, sh, hyphen) when it continues a compound such as handheld, handwoven, hand-built, handshake. It stays quiet on 'h' in other words like pre-hospital or aesthetic.
result.label: Compound continuation after "hand"

result.description: Fires on the 'i' piece in "Idioms" (Id-i-oms), the second token of the word split, predicting 'oms'. Silent on 'i' in other words or math subscripts, so it needs the Id + i word-piece context.
result.label: 'i' inside "Idioms"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ues" completing "cues", mostly in "non-verbal cues" or "unspoken cues" contexts. It is quiet on "ues" in "clues", so it seems to need the "c" + "ues" word.
result.label: "ues" ending "cues"

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings 'ider' (collider, insider, antider-) and 'ender' (Gender) inside words, mostly after a word-start fragment. Members detect 'ider' tokens at earlier layers.
result.label: 'ider'/'ender' word-piece endings

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ive' completing the word "adaptive" (as in adaptive immunity/systems). It stays silent on 'ive' in other words like reflective, predictive, intuitive.
result.label: 'ive' ending "adaptive"

result.description: Fires mostly on " clouds" in meteorology or astronomy text, usually after "of", "from" or "into" rather than at the start of a text. Weaker on a few other tokens, such as "iffs" in "tariffs".
result.label: ' clouds' mid-sentence in atmospheric text

result.description: Fires on the 'ly' in "firstly" when it opens an enumerated list of points, typically after a colon following "several/five ... steps/principles". Silent on 'ly' in other adverbs like "artificially" or "indirectly".
result.label: 'ly' in enumerating "firstly"

result.description: Fires on the plural token ' versions', mostly after modifiers like 'earlier', 'variant' or 'other' and followed by 'of'. Members are detectors of 'version(s)' and near-synonyms (range, variety, iterations). Silent in the contrast, where 'versions' isn't used in this way.
result.label: ' versions' plural token detector

result.description: Fires on " Since"/" since" (causal or temporal conjunction, often sentence-initial) and on the "ions" ending of words like "insertions". Mixed peaks across two unrelated token types; the evidence doesn't give a single condition.
result.label: Since / -ions mixed token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ulf', mainly in 'Gulf' (Gulf Stream) and 'engulf'. Weakly on 'rupt' in 'disrupt'. Members are detectors of 'ulf' and similar word pieces.
result.label: 'ulf' word piece (Gulf, engulf)

result.description: Fires on ' meaning' and ' semantic' in linguistics or semantics discussions (e.g., "semantic meaning", "difference in meaning"). Silent on 'meaning' in other discussion contexts, such as a constructivist-style sentence.
result.label: meaning/semantic in linguistics text

result.description: Fires on the token ' Fourier' (as in Fourier analysis, Fourier transform), mostly in math or signal-processing text. Members are mainly Fourier-token detectors in early layers. The contrast shows no clear differing context.
result.label: ' Fourier' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' mo' (as in moisture) and ' memb' (membrane), plus occasionally ' pass'. These are incomplete word pieces where the completion is a specific word; it pushes toward the suffix like 'rane'.
result.label: mo- / memb- word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'ul' (encaps-ul-ates, pend-ul-um, vocab-ul-ary), also 'ic' in telemedicine, 'ly' in firmly and ' convention'. Members mostly detect 'ul' pieces inside longer words.
result.label: Mid-word 'ul' fragment detector

result.description: Fires on the noun ' use' (also 'utilization') right after a modifying adjective, as in "equitable use", "effective use", "selective use", mostly followed by "of". Weaker on verb-like "use".
result.label: Noun 'use' after adjective

result.description: Fires on " how" (occasionally " why") introducing an embedded clause after verbs of study or description, such as "studies how", "examines how", "describes how". Members are mostly detectors of " how".
result.label: ' how' after study/describe verbs

result.description: Fires on example-introducing words, mainly " instance" and " example" (as in "for instance", "for example"), plus the odd piece "MA" and a sentence-initial "Moreover". Silent on " instance" at the start of a text, so it seems to need a preceding "for".
result.label: "for instance / for example" tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' priority', mostly in operating-system scheduling text (priority scheduling, priority inversion, lower priority tasks). Fed by many members that detect ' priority' itself in earlier layers. Weakly fires on ' goal'.
result.label: ' priority' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces of plural occupation nouns (che-fs, far-mers, restaur-ateurs) in food, farming and culinary contexts, mostly in lists of people such as chefs, farmers and producers.
result.label: Plural food-trade person suffixes

result.description: Fires on word pieces in kitchen knife and cooking text, such as ' kn' (knife), ' bla' (blade), ' dic', ' cook' and 'jul' (julienne). It needs a culinary or knife-and-blade context; it stays silent in drilling text.
result.label: Knife and cooking word beginnings

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'al' or 'ial' (also 'ert') when it ends a word being built, e.g. transaction-al, Inert-ial, but stays quiet on 'al' in words like exceptional or functional. Members detect 'al' and 'transaction'.
result.label: 'al' suffix after transaction/inert

result.description: Fires on the token ' end' (also ' ru', ' une'), especially as the first piece of a longer word such as endangered, endure, endorsement, endocrine. It predicts word continuations like 'ison' or 'ection'.
result.label: ' end' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' names', the 'i' in "physiology" in a list of physiology topics, 'anning', and ' hardware'. Members detect name/names words and 'i'. No single trigger or condition is clear.
result.label: Mixed: names, physiology 'i', hardware

result.description: Fires on the 'ers' piece inside "immersive" (also 'se' in "immerse"), after "imm". Silent on 'ers' in other words like viewers, fosters, researchers.
result.label: 'ers' in "immersive"

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces in technical headings, mainly 'atur' (in saturation), ' packet'/' pack' (packet inspection) and ' Tem' (Temporal Logic). It is silent on 'atur' at document start, so it needs a preceding word piece.
result.label: atur / packet / Tem word pieces
T in IoT (and Gandhi)
result.description: Fires on the final 'T' of "IoT" (Internet of Things), after " Io". Also fires on 'hi' in "Gandhi". It stays quiet on other names and contexts.

Fires on the word piece "ervation" completing "preservation" (also "conservation"), mostly in text about language, cultural or art preservation. Members detect pres-/preserve pieces plus language, museum and art topic words.
result.label: "ervation" in preservation
' assim' word-start piece (assimilation)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' assim' at the start of "assimilation/assimilate/assimilated", mostly in sociolinguistic or cultural text. Members detect other word-start fragments (surv, transm, aff, dr) that precede a longer word continuation.
Fires on the word piece 'met' inside longer technical words such as asymmetry, supersymmetry and voltammetry, where it is followed by 'ry'. It is silent on the unrelated contrast text.
result.label: 'met' piece in -metry words

result.description: Fires on 'field' (mostly in 'subfield') and ' son' (as in 'sonic', 'Sonora') when preceded by a prefix like 'sub'. Members detect 'sub' prefixes and 'field' pieces; silent when the word isn't a sub-compound.
result.label: 'sub' + field / son word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings after a "d" start, mainly "ried" in "dried herbs", also "ating" and "ining" after d. It stays silent when "ried" starts the document without the "d" before it.
result.label: "d" + suffix piece, as in dried

result.description: Fires on the digit '9' (occasionally '8') as the second digit of a four-digit year starting with 1, such as 1912 or 1980, mostly in birth–death date ranges and parenthetical dates.
result.label: Year digit 9 after leading 1

result.description: Fires on mixed word-start pieces such as ' asym', ' tant', ' President' and a line-initial ' Computer' (as in course or topic lists). Peaks are scattered with no shared meaning; the members are mostly early-layer token detectors.
result.label: Scattered word-start pieces (asym, Computer)

result.description: Fires on the word "What"/"what" (any case), strongest when it starts a question or clause such as "What is…" at the start of a document or quote. Weaker for mid-sentence "what". Members are mostly "what"/"who" detectors.
result.label: Word "what" starting a question

result.description: Fires on a comma fused with a closing quote (,") after a quoted word in a list of quoted words or terms, such as prepositions or pronouns being enumerated. Silent on the contrast text with no quoted list.
result.label: Comma plus closing quote in quoted lists

result.description: Fires on word endings like "-ics" (esp. in "Dynamics"), plus " profiles" and " dynamics" in technical science/engineering text. Silent on "ics" in "mechanics" and "Robotics", so it is specific to certain words.
result.label: Dynamics / -ics / profiles endings

result.description: Fires on the word " to" right after the noun "ability" (ability to + verb). It stays quiet on other uses of "to", such as after "contributing", "needed", "poised" or "dimension".
result.label: "to" after "ability"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' challeng' (challenged, challenges, challenge), strongest as a verb after a subject such as a movement or artist challenging conventions. It also fires more weakly on the noun use. Predicts suffixes like -es/-ed.
result.label: ' challeng' word piece detector
' Sc' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Sc' when it begins a longer word, such as Scrum, Score or Scots. Members detect ' Sc'/' sc' tokens and following pieces like 'rum' and 'ore'. The contrast text has no ' Sc' token.
Fires on the word "educational" or "Education" (also "education"), including repeated "Education" as a heading-like start of a line. Members are education/teaching/student detectors.
result.label: Education / educational word detector
' orbit' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' orbit', including as the stem of 'orbitals' (atomic/molecular orbitals) and in orbit-related text. Members are mostly early-layer ' orbit' and ' orb' detectors. It stays quiet on a rocket and travel passage that lacks the word.

Fires on a closing quotation mark (with or without a trailing comma or period) after a quoted word in a list of mentioned words, such as pronouns or prepositions in grammar text. It stays quiet on closing quotes after scare-quoted words in ordinary prose.
result.label: Closing quote after listed words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ape" after "t", i.e. the word "tape" (magnetic tape, Turing machine tape, taping). It is silent on unrelated text, and its upstream members mostly detect "ape" itself.
result.label: "ape" in "tape"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' veget' (as in vegetables), mainly in cooking text, and weakly on similar prefixes like ' corpor' and ' conjug'. It stays silent on 'vegetarian' in the contrast example.
result.label: ' veget' piece in cooking text

result.description: Fires on the word ' argue', mostly in "critics/others argue that" after a plural subject noun. Silent when ' argue' starts the text with no preceding subject. Occasionally fires on ' taken' in "taken into account".
result.label: ' argue' after a subject

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ility" completing the word "mobility" (geographic/occupational/worker mobility). Weakly fires on "icul" in "meticulous". Silent on other text, including mobility-related passages without that suffix token.
result.label: "ility" in "mobility"
' subst' word-piece in substance
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' subst' at the start of "substance(s)" or "substituent", where the word continues into a suffix like -ances. Members are mostly ' subst' token detectors, plus chemistry and material word pieces.

Fires on word pieces inside hyphenated or compound words, mainly 'friend' in "eco-friendly" and 'less' in "stainless", where the piece is a suffix-like part of a compound. It is quiet on ordinary standalone uses.
result.label: Compound-word piece: eco-friend(ly), stain-less

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces, such as ' gal' (galactic, galvanizing), ' precip', ' ev' (evaporation) and ' em', in science-heavy text. It predicts the continuation pieces of that word.
result.label: Word-initial fragments in science terms

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'ure' in "procurement" and 'ot' in words like stereotype/homotopy/heterotropy, where an earlier word piece (proc-, stere-, hom-) precedes. Members detect these pieces and their prefixes.
result.label: Word-piece 'ure'/'ot' in procurement, stereotype

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ful' attached to a word stem, most strongly in 'play|ful'. It stays quiet on 'ful' in 'colour|ful', so it depends on the stem before it. Members detect 'ful' and the preceding 'play' stem.
result.label: 'ful' suffix after play-
'ality' suffix in "duality"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ality', peaking in "duality" in physics text. Members detect 'ality' endings in other words (reality, orthogonality, intersectionality) and "dual" prefixes. It is silent on nearby wave-particle text without that word.

Fires on mid-word fragments such as ' en', ' dem', ' ens' and on odd byte pieces, where a word is split and continues in the next token (direct|dem|ocracy, m|ens|ures). Silent on ' en' in other words like enabling or encompasses.
result.label: Word-internal fragment ' en'/' dem'

result.description: Fires on " prime" in the math sense, as in "prime factors" or "prime numbers", after a determiner or "product of". It stays silent when "prime" begins the text. A few weaker hits on "devi" and word pieces.
result.label: ' prime' in number theory

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Ent" (or " ent") at the start of words like Entropy and Entanglement, where the word is split into pieces. It is silent on other text about quantum topics.
result.label: Ent- word-start piece (Entropy/Entanglement)

result.description: Fires on digits ('5', '0'), '$', '-' and some other tokens in list or percentage/price contexts within business and marketing text. Members are marketing/brand/customer word detectors. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Numbers in marketing text

result.description: Fires on 'oun' in 'noun(s)' (e.g. "Abstract nouns", "Proper nouns") and on ' partici' in 'participle', in grammar-terminology text. It stays silent on 'oun' in 'pronoun'.
result.label: grammar terms: noun / participle

result.description: Fires on ' exchange' (currency/foreign exchange, 'exchanges') and ' far' as the start of 'farm/farming/farmers', plus weaker on similar word pieces. Mostly a token-specific detector for these two words, predicting continuations like 'between' or 'rates'.
result.label: ' exchange' and ' far(m)' tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' Battle' when it begins a named battle (e.g. "the Battle of Bull Run"), in historical or military text. Predicts "of" next. Members include Battle detectors plus war and soldier vocabulary.
result.label: ' Battle' in named battles

result.description: Fires on the word ' trust' (noun) in discussions of relationships and trust. Members include many ' trust' token detectors and 'trustworthy' pieces; it is weaker on near-synonyms like 'belief'.
result.label: ' trust' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (also 'ning') completing physics/materials-science process nouns like scatter-ing and spin-ning. It stays silent on 'ing' in other words such as tracking, bonding, testing, modeling.
result.label: -ing in scattering/spinning terms

result.description: Fires mostly on " Print" in printmaking-technique headings (e.g. "Intaglio Print|making"), with weaker hits on " stroke", " the" and word pieces. Members are print-word detectors and printing-related tokens.
result.label: Print in printmaking headings

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 's' directly after 'shell' (shells) in atomic/electron orbital text. Silent on 's' in possessives or verb endings. Members detect 'shell' and orbital/electron words.
result.label: plural 's' after 'shell'

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "shape"/"shapes"/"shaping" (e.g. "shape-", "shape of", "shape and", "shape or", "shapeful"), on the connector or suffix following it. Silent on "the" elsewhere. Pushes toward sizes, orientation, "aping".
result.label: Token following "shape"

result.description: Fires on the noun ending a medical or health problem phrase (diseases, problems, issues, conditions), mostly after a health or medical modifier like "functional", "respiratory" or "health". Silent on "ases" in unrelated words like "decreases".
result.label: Health problem nouns (diseases, issues)

result.description: Fires on the word " agents" (or " agent") as a noun, most strongly in chemistry text on oxidizing and reducing agents. It also fires on other agent senses such as talent agents and AI agents. Members are mostly detectors of the token "agent(s)".
result.label: ' agents' token, chemistry-leaning

result.description: Fires on the piece "fer" completing the word "safer" (sa|fer), as in "safer chemicals". Members detect "fer" and the "sa" prefix. It also appears on "fer" in other words (inferential, interferometer), though the evidence is mostly "safer".
result.label: "fer" in "safer"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' fra' (as in fractions, fraud), and weakly on similar pieces like ' sa' or ' sau'. Members are mostly ' fra' token detectors; the contrast text lacks the piece.
result.label: ' fra' word-start piece
'ig' piece in 'pigment'/Higgs
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ig' inside words like p-ig-ment and H-ig-gs, and occasionally on 'ross' in 'Gross'. It stays silent on 'ig' in 'mitigate'.
Fires mainly on the word-piece "opy" completing words like "Spectroscopy" or "Homotopy", with weaker firing on " Union" after "Soviet". Silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly "opy" detectors.
result.label: "opy" ending in spectroscopy

result.description: Fires on the 'ational' (or 'ations') piece completing "foundational" / "foundations" after "found". It stays silent on 'ational' in other words like observational, operational, condensational.
result.label: found-ational word ending

result.description: Fires on the final piece of environmental-impact phrases, mainly "print" in "ecological/carbon footprint" and " impact" after "environmental". Appears in sustainability text and predicts "foot"/"friendly"-type continuations.
result.label: Environmental footprint/impact word

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments such as ' pre', 'il' (in resilient), ' Cont' (in Continuous) and ' res', where the word continues into a longer word. Peaks on the fragment before the rest of the word completes.
result.label: Word-start fragments pre/il/Cont

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " hy" (as in hybridization, hybrid, hyphenation), predicting a continuation like "brid". Upstream members are mostly " hy" and "brid" token detectors.
result.label: " hy" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin longer words, mainly ' em' (empathy, embody, emissions), ' cons' (consolidation), ' inclus' (inclusive) and 'pect' in 'Respect'. It is silent when 'em' starts the text. Predicts word continuations.
result.label: Word-start fragments em/cons/inclus/pect

result.description: Fires mostly on " monitor" (and "monitoring") as a verb after "to" or "of", and also on " of" after "capable". Members include monitor/monitoring token detectors and an " of" detector.
result.label: monitor verb after "to"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments in food and cooking text, mainly ' flav' (flavor), ' sau' (sauce) and ' cu' (cuisine), where the word continues in the next piece. It stays silent when ' flav' opens the document, with no cooking context before it.
result.label: Cooking word-start fragments (flav, sau, cu)

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "ifs" in "motifs" (leitmotifs), and sometimes on "pr" inside words like "upright" or "enterprises". Early-layer members detect "ifs" and music/art context.
result.label: "ifs" in motifs

result.description: Fires on business-entity nouns like " companies", " business", "enterprises" as the subject of a clause in business/marketing text, often after a introductory phrase and comma, where a verb like "can" or "must" comes next. Silent when "companies" starts a text.
result.label: Business entity as clause subject

result.description: Fires on "thought" (also "theories", "theory", "decisions") when it names a body of ideas, mostly after "economic" or "schools of" (e.g. "economic thought"). Economics context members support it; it is silent in plain economic text without such a noun.
result.label: Economic thought / theories noun

result.description: Fires on the word " such" in most contexts, strongest when it modifies a noun ("such a", "such cases", "such techniques"). Weaker on "such as" lists. Silent in "also known as such conditions". Driven mostly by early-layer " such" token detectors.
result.label: ' such' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in scientific text: 'ulated' in "simulated", ' neut' in neutron/neutrino, and ' rocks' after "igneous". Looks like a mix of word-piece detectors, with no single shared token.
result.label: Scientific word pieces: simulated, neut-, rocks

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' completing the word "Strategic" (also weakly "catastrophic"). It stays silent on 'ic' in Macroeconomic, Seismic and Economic, so it needs the Strateg- stem before it.
result.label: 'ic' in "Strategic"

result.description: Fires on the piece "hold" inside "stakeholder(s)/stakeholding", after "stake". It stays silent on "hold" in "shareholders". Members detect "hold", "holder", "ake" and "ers" pieces.
result.label: hold in stakeholder

result.description: Fires on word pieces of a rare name or word (Gi, Marc, Leon, q in Muqla) that come right after "like" or "such as" in an example list. It seems to predict a continuation of the name.
result.label: Name pieces after "like/such as"

result.description: Fires on importance adjectives (essential, crucial, important, vital, key) in the slot right after "play(s) a/an ..." before "role(s)". Silent in unrelated contexts like questions about artists.
result.label: Importance adjective before "role"

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like 'ive' and 'ations' right after the stem "interpret" (interpretive, interpretations), in text about language and communication. Silent on 'ive' in other words such as adaptive or attentive.
result.label: Suffix after 'interpret'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' (also 'ity', 'ist') right after the stem 'relativ' in physics text about relativity. It stays silent on 'istic' in other words such as 'sophisticated' and 'probabilistic'.
result.label: relativ-istic suffix

result.description: Fires on the final piece of "undertaken"/"undertaking" and on " out" in "carried out", where a task or activity is being performed. Silent on " out" in "stood out" or "outcomes".
result.label: undertaken / carried out

result.description: Fires mainly on " cluster" as a noun after a modifier (e.g. "planetary cluster", "types of cluster"), with weaker hits on words like settlement and geometric. Members are cluster/clust token detectors, mostly in technical or astronomy text.
result.label: ' cluster' after modifier noun

result.description: Fires on the "ation" suffix completing "mitigation" (after "mitig"), as in risk or climate mitigation. It stays silent on "ation" in other words such as innovation and degradation. It pushes toward mit/risk-type continuations.
result.label: 'ation' ending 'mitigation'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' fi' when it starts "fiber/fibre" (fiberglass, fiber optics, fiber bundles). Weaker on ' self' in "selfless/self-determination". Supported by members detecting fi/fib/fab pieces and material words.
result.label: ' fi' start of fiber
education word token detector
result.description: Fires on ' education', ' Education' and ' educational', most strongly on 'Education' starting a line in lists of "Education and X" headings. It stays silent on 'education' in 'liberal education'. Members detect education, teaching and student words.
Fires on the word-piece 'ise' when it ends a word, as in tortoise, premise, Yenisei, merchandise, concise, practise, paradise. Members are mostly detectors of 'ise' and similar word-final pieces.
result.label: 'ise' word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ist' (also 'ism') right after 'Marx' in Marxist/Marxism text, as in "Marxist theory". Silent on 'ist' in other words like economist, communist, epistemic, materialist. Members detect 'Marx' and class/economy context.
result.label: 'ist' suffix after Marx

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments (suffixes like -axy, -ging, -ating, -inity, ' Open') inside long or compound words in title-like text, typically before a following noun such as 'Dynamics and'. Members are mostly generic token detectors, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in title phrases

result.description: Fires on the piece 'stra' in "Dijkstra" (after "Dijk"), in algorithm-related text. Early members detect 'stra' and 'ijk'; others add algorithm and computing context.
result.label: Dijkstra 'stra' token

result.description: Fires on the token right after a reciprocal phrase like "each other" or "one another" (and, 's, comma, at, closing paren). Silent on the same "and" in other contexts. Members detect "other", "each" and "hand".
result.label: Token after "each other/one another"

result.description: Fires on the 'ment' piece in "Augmented" (mainly "Augmented Reality"), occasionally on ' Aug'. Silent on 'ment' as a suffix in words like "entertainment".
result.label: 'ment' in Augmented Reality

result.description: Fires on the token ' scale' (also 'scales') as a noun in measurement or music contexts, such as the Pauling scale or major scale. Members are mostly detectors of the 'scale' token itself.
result.label: ' scale' token detector

result.description: Fires on the name "Pearson" (the 'Pear' or 'son' piece) in statistics text, such as Pearson correlation or Pearson's r. It stays silent on a bare 'son' without the Pear- before it.
result.label: Pearson in statistics text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' att' at the start of a longer word, mostly "attentive" and "attitudes". It predicts continuations like 'ain', 'itudes', 'rib'. Early token-level att detectors drive it.
result.label: ' att' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' sch' when it begins "scholars" (e.g. "Islamic scholars", "Arabic scholars"), mostly in medieval or academic history text. It stays silent when "scholastic" opens the text with no preceding context.
result.label: ' sch' starting "scholars"

result.description: Fires on the token " validation" in technical or process text (system validation, method validation, validation plan). Early-layer members detect the validation token itself. Weak activation on "Michel" in Michelangelo.
result.label: ' validation' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces ending chemistry-related words, mainly "actions" in "reactions" and "istry" in "chemistry", also "polymerization". It appears in chemistry text, built from chem/reaction detectors.
result.label: chemistry word endings (reactions, chemistry)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing "transportation" (and weakly on ' transport' itself). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like orchestration, degradation, innovation. Predicts logistics-type continuations.
result.label: 'ation' in "transportation"

result.description: Fires on the word " is" in definitional or explanatory statements in science/math text, such as "X is a ratio of…" or "because it is possible…". It stays silent on some " is" after a named subject in a more general or rhetorical context.
result.label: ' is' in technical definitions

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ro' (also 'ra', 'opy') inside "spect-ro-scopy" / "spectra", after the 'spect' piece in science text. Silent when 'ro' starts a fragment without 'spect' before it.
result.label: spect-ro in spectroscopy

result.description: Fires on the noun or word right after "every" (step, single, point, time, line, iteration), the slot of a distributive "every X" phrase. It stays silent on "step" used as a verb ("to step in").
result.label: Noun after "every"

result.description: Fires on the final word of a "Systems X" topic title (Engineering, Integration, Development, Design) in a list of course or topic headings. It stays silent on "Engineering" after other words like Mechanical or Software.
result.label: Word after "Systems" in titles

result.description: Fires on the token " processes" (also weaker on " process"), mainly after a modifier such as natural, geological, endogenic or weathering. Members are detectors of process/processes tokens. The contrast shows silence on other plural nouns such as "systems".
result.label: ' processes' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " our" when it follows a verb or preposition (part of our, maintaining our, leave our) and introduces a possessed noun. It predicts nouns like understanding, lives, planet, breath. Members are mostly detectors of " our" and " your".
result.label: possessive " our" before noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ple" in "de-ple-tion/depleted" (resource or charge depletion). Members detect "ple" and the "de" prefix. Weak firing on a few other tokens like "demic".
result.label: "ple" in depletion/deplete

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'wn' at the end of 'drawn', as in 'horse-drawn' or 'hand-drawn'. Members detect 'wn' pieces, such as in 'skewness', and other word-internal fragments.
result.label: 'wn' in 'drawn' compounds

result.description: Fires on the 'ull' piece of "Hull" when it is split as H|ull, mostly in ship-hull engineering headings (Hull Materials, Hull Shape Optimization). Weak activation on a few other word pieces.
result.label: 'ull' in split word Hull

result.description: Fires on the word " true" in logic and math text, especially after "is" or "are" in statements like "P is true whenever...". Supported by "true" detectors and logic/philosophy topic members. Silent on a contrast about tautology without the word.
result.label: ' true' in logic statements

result.description: Fires on the piece "cient" in "Ancient" when the word is split as "An|cient", especially at the start of a line in lists of ancient civilizations. It stays silent when "cient" begins the text.
result.label: "cient" in "Ancient" split

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ian" ending an adjective or name-derived word (Euler-ian, Dor-ian, Phryg-ian, Dravid-ian). Members are mostly "ian" detectors. Weaker on "ar" and "egalitar-ian".
result.label: Suffix 'ian' after a stem

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment, mostly 'c' (also 'ic', 'ard', 'og'), inside a longer word like Edu-c-ational or Av-ic-enna. It is silent on 'c' inside surnames such as Wojcicki, Wilczek and Mercator.
result.label: Mid-word 'c' fragment in Educational

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'acy' completing "privacy" (split as priv + acy), peaking in privacy-related text. It also fires more weakly on 'acy' in "Supremacy". It pushes toward nouns like issues, rights and concerns.
result.label: 'acy' in "privacy"

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' bre' (breathe, breed, brewery, brevity), where the next piece completes the word. Members are mostly ' bre' detectors plus other word-fragment detectors.
result.label: ' bre' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vere' inside "sovereignty" (mostly), and weakly on ' prof' in "profound". It marks a mid-word piece in a specific word, with members detecting 'vere' itself.
result.label: 'vere' in sovereignty

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments 'ado' in "paradox" and ' ske' in "skepticism"/"skewer", i.e. incomplete pieces of a word in the middle of tokenization. Mostly in philosophical or abstract text; the next token is a continuation fragment.
result.label: Word pieces 'ado' (paradox), ' ske'

result.description: Fires on " Model" ending a named model or framework, especially "Standard Model" and also "Spiral Model" or "Waterfall Model". Members detect " Model" and the preceding " Standard" or process-name words.
result.label: " Model" after Standard/named framework

result.description: Fires on the verb suffix pieces -ize/-ise/-ising completing "maximize", "minimize", "compromise". It is weak or silent on "utilize" and "revolutionize". It depends on the stem before the suffix, mainly maxim-, minim- and comprom-.
result.label: -ize/-ise suffix in maximize/minimize/compromise

result.description: Fires on the passive participle " processed" (also " accessed", " handled") after "be/are/being", where data or materials are acted on. Fed by members detecting "processed/processing" and data-topic tokens.
result.label: Passive "processed" after be-verb

result.description: Fires on object pronouns (them, you, us, it) directly after verbs like leave, let, give, bring, as the object of a causative or ditransitive verb. Silent on 'them' after prepositions or 'allows'.
result.label: Object pronoun after leave/let/give

result.description: Fires on the word " hidden" (rarely "indirect" or "invisible"), mostly as an adjective before abstract nouns like meanings, messages or truths in literary and analytical text. Members are mainly detectors of "hidden" and related words such as secret and buried.
result.label: " hidden" adjective detector

result.description: Fires on the middle pieces of the word "juxtaposition" ('ap' and especially 'osition' after 'juxtap'), in creative-writing text. Members detect the earlier pieces 'ju', 'xt', 'ap', 'osing'.
result.label: juxtaposition word pieces

result.description: Fires on data-access verbs like "retrieve", "sort", and "reads" in computer science text about memory, databases and algorithms, often after "to". Members detect retrieval/concurrency/memory word pieces.
result.label: Data retrieve/sort verbs in computing

result.description: Fires on the word " vessels" (also ships/ship) in shipbuilding and maritime engineering text, meaning watercraft. Members are token detectors for vessels/ships plus naval context. Silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: vessels (watercraft) in maritime text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ps' when it begins "psychoanalysis" or similar "psycho-" words, in academic or theory text. Members detect 'cho'/'y' pieces of psycho- words. It stays quiet on ordinary names.
result.label: ' ps' start of psycho- words

result.description: Fires on the word " colors" (or " colours"), most strongly as the head noun after modifiers like "primary" or "vivid" in color-theory and art text. Members include color-token detectors and art/painting context.
result.label: ' colors' token

result.description: Fires on ' period' (also years, era, periods) as a noun for a span of historical time, usually after "a", "this", or an adjective, introducing a description like "marked by". Silent when "period" begins a sentence with no preceding determiner.
result.label: Historical 'period' noun after determiner

result.description: Fires on the verb "help" and its forms (helping, helped, helps) used as a verb taking an object or "to" complement. It predicts verbs like improve, reduce, promote. Members detect help, enable and assist verbs.
result.label: verb "help" forms

result.description: Fires on the "-ensional"/"dimensional" pieces of multi-/uni-dimensional words and on " integrated" in "an integrated approach". It looks like a detector of multi-part or multi-layer descriptors, with logits favoring " multi".
result.label: dimensional / integrated word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " future" when it follows a verb or preposition and modifies a noun (predict future trends, shape future events). It stays silent when "future" starts a document or the phrase "future perfect continuous".
result.label: ' future' as modifier after verb

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lation' completing "Trans-lation", mainly in "Machine Translation" and "Translation Models" in NLP text. It stays silent on other 'lation' words like phosphorylation, and predicts translation/service.
result.label: Trans|lation word piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces, mostly 'ced' in "-induced" (climate-induced, human-induced), also 'itud' in latitude and 'ial' in familial. It marks word-internal pieces inside longer words, not whole words.
result.label: Word-internal 'ced' in -induced

result.description: Fires on the token right after a capital "B" at the start of a word, mainly "+" or "-" in "B+ tree" / "B-Tree", and weakly on other B-initial word pieces (Biling-, BIS, Bose). Members detect " B" and hyphen/plus.
result.label: Symbol after B in B-tree

result.description: Fires on the verbs ' is'/' are' (also can, may) that follow a coordinated "and" clause, where a second predicate is added to a shared subject ("...and is often associated with"). Silent on plain subject-then-is sentences.
result.label: is/are after "and" coordination

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lect' inside "dielectric" (mostly in electrical-materials text). It stays silent on 'lect' in "thermoelectric". Weaker hits on other mid-word pieces such as 'ive' in "conductive".
result.label: 'lect' in dielectric
'ity' in fluidity
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' when it completes "fluidity" (fluid + ity). It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like vitality, validity, diversity. Members detect the preceding word "fluid" and fluid-related tokens.

Fires on word pieces in abstract analytic or transformation vocabulary: 'ict' (predictive), ' transform', ' analyt', ' Equ' (equilibrium). Members are mostly generic token detectors; evidence is mixed with no clear shared condition.
result.label: transform/analytics/predict word pieces

result.description: Fires on comparative degree words ' higher' (also ' lower', ' high') before a quantity noun like frequency, pitch or level, and on the 'igen' piece in 'eigenvalues'. Predicts level-like nouns.
result.label: higher/lower and eigen- pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside a word, mainly "uning" in "pruning", "ull" in "Hull", and "ening" in "Strengthening". Fires on the mid-word piece, with weaker activity on "weakens" and "breakthrough".
result.label: Word pieces: pruning, Hull, -ening

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ay"/"ays" (as in clay, relays, overlays, Fay) and on " today" mid-sentence. The two sets share little in meaning, so it looks like a mix of token detectors.
result.label: 'ay/ays' pieces and 'today'

result.description: Fires on quantifier ' most' and ' some' when they start a subject noun phrase meaning "most/some of them" (e.g. "most musicians use", "some may think"). Silent on 'most' as superlative ("the most intimate") or after prepositions ("by most people").
result.label: Subject-position quantifiers most/some

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ic' inside the name "Epicureanism"/"Epicurus" (Ep|ic|ur-), right after the 'Ep' piece. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as rhetoric, dialectic, or when 'ic' starts a text.
result.label: 'ic' in Epicurus/Epicureanism

result.description: Fires on the word piece "enses" completing "expenses" (costs), mostly after "exp" in financial or cost text. Weaker on "ense" in "at the expense of". Members detect "enses", "ense" and "expend" pieces.
result.label: "enses" in "expenses"

result.description: Fires mostly on " more", especially in "more and more" or "become more", and on nearby words such as "of", "people" and "educated" in comparative "more X" phrases. It pushes the next token towards " than" and comparative words.
result.label: Comparative "more" (more and more)

result.description: Fires on an en dash (or slash/hyphen) between numbers in a range, especially years or quantities like 1900–192, right after the first number. Silent on a dash within a name like P–n junction.
result.label: En dash in numeric ranges

result.description: Fires on the 'hm' piece inside the name Brahmagupta/Brahmasphuta (Bra-hm-). Weak activation on a few other mid-word pieces like 'ius' in Arrhenius. Silent when 'hm' starts the text without 'Bra' before it.
result.label: 'hm' in Brahmagupta

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' mus' (mostly the start of "muscle", "musculoskeletal"), predicting continuations like 'cle', 'ually'. Members detect ' mus' and music-related tokens.
result.label: ' mus' word-piece (muscle)

result.description: Fires mainly on the adjective " significant" (also " es" in a repeated "essential" and similar degree words like major or critical) when it precedes a noun like change, shift or emphasis. Members detect significant/major/important/critical.
result.label: Adjective 'significant' before change nouns
