result.description: Fires on Arabic letters and word pieces (ب, ال, ي) inside Arabic words, and on fragments of broken multi-byte characters such as CJK. Weaker on "?." sentence ends. Mostly non-English script pieces.
result.label: Arabic and multibyte script fragments

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe used as a closing quotation mark around a quoted word or letter (e.g. 'answer', 'chair'), not on contraction or possessive apostrophes (aren't, let's, don't), where it stays silent.
result.label: Closing single-quote apostrophe

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ang' inside "entanglement" or "entangled" (after "ent"), and weakly on other "ent-" pieces like 'it' in "entitlements" and 'hal' in "enthalpy". Silent when 'ang' starts the word.
result.label: 'ang' in ent-anglement

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'igen' inside words like indigenous, eigenvalues, antigen, and occasionally 'ust' in "Sustainability". Members detect 'igen' and preceding pieces like 'ind'.
result.label: 'igen' word piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' completing the word "covalent" (after "coval"/"oval"). It stays silent on 'ent' in other words like "constituent", so it needs that specific word-piece context.
result.label: 'ent' in "covalent"

result.description: Fires on the word "meet"/"meeting"/"meets", most strongly in "meet requirements" (components or products meeting specific requirements). It also fires on "meeting" as an event noun. It predicts words like "specific" or "particular" next.
result.label: meet / meeting (requirements)

result.description: Fires on the word " values" (social, cultural or corporate values), mostly after "norms and", "shared", or "company's". Weakly on similar abstract plural nouns like "factors" and "messages". Pushes towards "values", "responsibility" and "conscious".
result.label: " values" as abstract noun

result.description: Fires on "processing" and the following word (units, and, techniques) in computing, signal and data-processing text, such as processing units (CPUs) or audio processing. Predicts data and task words next.
result.label: Data/computer processing term

result.description: Fires on the token ' partition', mostly as the stem before '-ing' (partitioning) in database and algorithm text. Weakly fires on related split/divide words. Predicts word-ending suffixes like 'ing'.
result.label: ' partition' word stem

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces completing computing/networking terms, mainly 'put' in "throughput", also 'ters' in "routers" and 'ing' in "addressing", in technical computer-systems text. Silent on the same-topic contrast text.
result.label: Word-ending pieces in computing terms (throughput, routers)

result.description: Fires on words for moving from one state or stage to another: "progression" (pro|gression), "transition", "move", "journey". Next-token logits lean toward "towards", "from", "toward", "phase", consistent with a change-of-stage sense.
result.label: Progression / transition / move words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'sur' inside "subsurface" (after "sub"), and weakly on similar mid-word pieces like 'ef' in "reef", 'foot' in "footprint". Members detect prefix "sub" followed by a split piece (sub-j, sub-ter, sub-c).
result.label: 'sur' in subsurface

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'opol' in "oligopoly" and 'el' in "Stackelberg", in economics/game-theory text about oligopoly models. Silent on 'opol' in "monopoly" and at word start, so it needs the oligopoly/Stackelberg word context.
result.label: oligopoly / Stackelberg word pieces

result.description: Fires on the verb ' has' (rarely ' have') when it follows a noun subject in expository text, before a predicate like "led to" or "two main". It stays silent after pronouns like "it" or "man", or at sentence start.
result.label: ' has' after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the adverb suffix pieces 'ly', 'fully', 'ally', 'ently' completing a manner adverb after a stem (clever-ly, grace-fully). Silent when 'ly' stands alone or follows punctuation or the stem 'sole', so it needs a preceding adverb stem.
result.label: Adverb suffix -ly/-fully after stem

result.description: Fires on the token ' affect' (including affects, affective, affecting) as a verb or word stem. Members are detectors of affect, impact, influence and inform-like tokens. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' affect' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' favorite' after a possessive (their/our/your favorite), and more weakly on family-relation words like siblings, cousin, uncle. Predicts nouns like songs or band. Members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: Possessive + favorite / kin words

result.description: Fires on the modal verb ' may' right after a plural or abstract noun subject (e.g. "policies may", "groups may"), where a verb like "also", "have" or "help" comes next. It is weaker on "we may" and on "often".
result.label: ' may' after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' divis' at the start of divisor, divisible and divisibility, in math text. It is silent on other number-theory text that lacks this word piece. Members are detectors of ' divis' and similar word pieces.
result.label: ' divis' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces, mainly 'urm' in "Sturm-Liouville" and ' exception' in "exceptional", plus occasional 'ette' or ' nas'. The peaks are scattered, and the members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: Sturm 'urm' and 'exception' pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'isms' completing the word "mechanisms" (after 'mechan'), also weakly on similar word-pieces like syllogisms. Silent when 'isms' starts a document with no 'mechan' before it.
result.label: 'isms' ending "mechanisms"

result.description: Fires on the piece "um" completing "Quant" at the start of a heading-like line (e.g. "Quantum Tunneling"), in physics topic lists. It fires more weakly on the word " quantum" itself.
result.label: "um" in "Quantum"

result.description: Fires on the token ' energy', strongest in chemistry/physics text such as "activation energy", "potential energy", "kinetic energy". Weaker in renewable-energy and sustainability contexts. Members are mostly energy-token detectors plus 'activation' detectors.
result.label: ' energy' in physics/chemistry terms

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis (')' or '),') that ends a parenthetical aside, often inside a list of items each followed by a bracketed explanation, in academic or technical prose. Silent on plain text without parentheses.
result.label: Closing parenthesis ending parenthetical

result.description: Fires on the word " company" (rarely " culture") when it follows "the" or similar and is likely to take a possessive, as in "the company's mission". Logits favor ’ and 's continuations.
result.label: " company" before possessive

result.description: Fires on ' CPU' and 'architect'/'architecture' tokens in computer hardware and processor-design text, predicting 'architecture'-like continuations. Members detect CPU, RAM, cache, computer and architect tokens.
result.label: CPU / processor architecture words

result.description: Fires on the token ' Class' (capitalized), as in 'Class A, Class B', 'Class I molecules' or 'Classical' word starts. Members are mostly detectors of Class/class. Weak activation on ' universe'.
result.label: Capitalized ' Class' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' scaling' (horizontal/vertical scaling, Min-Max scaling), in technical text on system or data scaling. Members are mostly detectors of 'scaling' and 'scale'. Silent on the contrast text, which doesn't contain the token.
result.label: ' scaling' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' comb' (as in "combustion"), and weaker on ' sun' and ' inf' (inflection, infected), where the word continues in the next token. Members mostly detect ' comb' itself.
result.label: ' comb' word-start fragment (combustion)

result.description: Fires on the token ' f' (word-initial f, also function name f(x) or the start of words like fuzzy, flip, falsifiability), predicting word continuations such as 'uz', 'lip', 'ract'. Silent on other tokens.
result.label: Word-initial ' f' token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' partition' (partitioning, partition schemes) and on ' rem' at the start of words like remittance, remnants, remodeling. Weak on a few other pieces. Members are token detectors for partition and rem.
result.label: partition / rem word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces such as 'ing' (cool-ing), 'abilities' (inst-abilities) and 'usion' (F-usion) in physics and engineering text on plasma and reactor cooling. It stays silent on 'ing' in cooking and air-conditioning contexts.
result.label: Suffix pieces in plasma/cooling physics

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yl' inside 'syllogisms' (s-yl-logisms), with weaker activation on 'yl' in other words like acetylation, methyl, Babylonian. Upstream members are mostly 'yl' token detectors.
result.label: 'yl' piece in syllogism

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'do' (also 'no') in the middle of a longer word, such as re-do-x, do-pting, k-no-ck, no-ema, where the next piece is expected to continue the word (e.g. 'x').
result.label: 'do'/'no' word-internal fragment

result.description: Fires on the word " brand" in marketing and branding text, especially as a modifier before a metric noun (brand awareness, brand performance, brand equity). Weakly fires on company or corporate terms. Predicts goal or target words next.
result.label: brand in marketing metrics

result.description: Fires on the word " significance" (cultural, spiritual, biological, statistical significance), especially as a noun after an adjective. Members detect significance/importance-like nouns and cultural context words.
result.label: ' significance' noun detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'quisition' in "Acquisition" (e.g. "Language Acquisition"), after the "Ac" piece. Members are mostly early-layer detectors of this same token, with some weak language-related context.
result.label: 'quisition' in Acquisition

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'od' (occasionally 'ios') in the middle of a longer word, such as emb-od-ies, therm-od-ynamic, comm-od-ity. It predicts continuation pieces like 'ies', 'ynam' and 'ied'. It stays quiet on some 'od' in other contexts.
result.label: 'od' mid-word piece
'ice' ending of 'injustice'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ice' when it completes the word 'injustice', especially in epistemic injustice text. Members detect 'just' and 'ice' pieces. It stays silent on 'justice' and 'social justice' contexts.

Fires on the word piece "special" (also "specific", "Spec-") where it begins a word like specialized, specialty or specific. It predicts suffixes such as -ized, -ities and -ties. Members are detectors of "special", "specific" and "polar".
result.label: "special"/"specific" word start

result.description: Fires on ' was' in the existential "there was" construction, typically after a time phrase ("During the early 2000s, there was a..."). Stays silent on ' was' after a subject noun like "nomenclature was developed".
result.label: existential "there was"

result.description: Fires on the lowercase letter piece 'p' as a word-internal fragment or variable (touch-p-ads, cas-p-ases, redu-p-lication), predicting continuations like 'read', 'inned', 'iration'. Quiet on text lacking a 'p' token.
result.label: Letter 'p' token fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece "alls" ending "Firewalls" (split as Firew|alls), also in "halls". It is silent on other text about firewalls that lacks this piece.
result.label: "alls" piece in Firewalls

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of long abstract words such as 'continu' (esp. in 'discontinuity/discontinuous'), 'ident', ' ambigu', 'emon', 'arch'. The word is incomplete and the next piece is expected to finish it.
result.label: Incomplete stem 'continu' / 'ident'

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' emer' at the start of emergency, emergence, emerged and emerging, before the continuation. Members are mostly detectors of this same token piece.
result.label: ' emer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token 'vers' at the start of "Conversely/Inversely"-type sentence openers ("versely, ..."). It stays silent when 'vers' follows a sentence end directly with no preceding word piece, so it seems to need the word-initial fragment context.
result.label: 'vers' in "-versely," openers

result.description: Fires on the 'l' piece in the split word "bott|l|eneck(s)", right after "bott" and before "eneck". Weak activation on 'l' in other split words like "Pol|l|ution".
result.label: 'l' inside "bottleneck"

result.description: Fires on the token ' V' when it starts an acronym or abbreviation such as VR or VPN, split off as a separate piece after a space. Mostly seen in VR/tech text, and it is silent on ordinary text without such a token.
result.label: ' V' starting acronyms (VR, VPN)

result.description: Fires on ' such' directly after a plural noun, as in "ingredients such as", where it introduces examples. Members are mostly ' such' detectors predicting ' as'. It stays silent in at least one similar case, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' such' introducing examples after noun

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix piece 'ors' (also 'es', 'ers') completing a word after a stem like "invest", "sens" or "recept". It is silent on 'ors' in "sponsors", so it seems to need particular stems.
result.label: Plural -ors suffix after invest-/sens- stems

result.description: Fires on the word ' environment' (and plural), in surroundings or setting senses such as 'their environment' or 'an environment that fosters'. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. Silent on the contrast text, which has no such token.
result.label: ' environment' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'iment' piece in "rudimentary" (also ' rud' and weakly ' simple'), at the point where a word meaning basic or primitive is being completed. Silent on unrelated complex-engineering text.
result.label: rudimentary word-piece 'iment'

result.description: Fires on adjectives meaning "necessary/very important" (essential, crucial, critical, vital), mostly after "is/are" in predicate position, anticipating "for/to" and a purpose. Weakly on "important".
result.label: Essential/crucial predicate adjective

result.description: Fires on " for" right after a noun naming a method, technique, tool or material, introducing its purpose or use ("techniques for", "cobalt for blue"). It stays quiet on "for" after verbs like "allows for" or after "standard for".
result.label: " for" after method/technique nouns

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'nt' (sovereig-nt-y, dow-nt-ime) and 'ried' in "dried herbs", plus 'ubble' in bubble. Mostly token-piece detectors for these word pieces; the contrast text has none of them.
result.label: Mid-word pieces 'nt' and 'ried'

result.description: Fires on the token ' research' (including before 'ers' and in 'market research'), mostly in text about research methods and studies. Members are mostly ' research' token detectors. Predicts 'ers' as a next piece.
result.label: ' research' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " change" (noun or verb), often after words like "organizational" or "effective" and in change-management or language-change text. Members are mostly detectors of change/changes/shifts.
result.label: ' change' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'asure' after 'tre' in "treasure" (treasure hunt, map, troves). Members detect 'asure' and 'tre' directly; it also appears in "Measurement"-type pieces.
result.label: 'asure' in treasure

result.description: Fires on the bare token 't' as a standalone letter or word-final piece (time variable t, "debt", "don't") and on ' not'. Weakly predicts words like "necessarily" and "only".
result.label: letter 't' / ' not' token

result.description: Fires on 'hold'/'holder' (or 'own') completing the word "shareholder" after "share". It stays silent on 'hold' in "stakeholder", so it needs the preceding "share" piece.
result.label: shareholder 'hold' after share

result.description: Fires on the 'ed' piece inside the split word "rem-ed-ial/iation/iatory" (remedial, remediation). Silent on 'ed' in ordinary past-tense verbs like developed or reviewed. Also weakly on 'al' in "renewal".
result.label: 'ed' in "remedi-" words

result.description: Fires on the tokens " chain" (polymer, supply chain) and " North" (North America, North and South), with a few hits on " African" and similar. Members are separate detectors for each token. Silent on the unrelated hash-map text.
result.label: ' chain' and ' North' tokens

result.description: Fires on the word " common" (rarely " strong") as an adjective before a noun, e.g. "more common ones", "common resources", "common examples". Members are mostly detectors of " common" and near-synonyms like universal and shared.
result.label: Adjective " common" detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ification(s)' after 'cert' (certification), and weakly on 'ograph/ography' in 'cartography'. It depends on the preceding word piece ('cert', 'cart'). It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: -ification after cert- (certification)

result.description: Fires on ' also' as an adverb right after a subject or auxiliary (e.g. "period has also introduced/witnessed"). It is quiet on "but also", "while also" and similar constructions. It fires weakly on "pers-pect-ives".
result.label: ' also' after subject/auxiliary

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eigen' (before vector/value/space) in linear algebra text. Weak firing on 'Io' in IoT. Silent on the word 'eigen' being absent, e.g. generic "linear transforms" text.
result.label: ' eigen' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' in a run of digits, usually after earlier zeros or a round number (e.g. 1000000, 200s, 0.0000101). It stays silent on '0' right after a single leading digit, as in 2015 or 90s.
result.label: Digit 0 in zero runs

result.description: Fires on ' price' (and sometimes ' temperature', ' cost', ' parameter') as a modifier or noun in economics/science text, e.g. "high price", "zero temperature", "price gouging". Predicts threshold/point-type nouns next.
result.label: price / temperature quantity nouns

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in biology/biochemistry text, mainly 'chem' in "biochemical", plus 'ones' and 'orm' in hormone words and 'product' in "reproductive". Silent on 'chem' in "neurochemicals".
result.label: Biochemistry/hormone word fragments

result.description: Fires on a hyphen or dash right after "fast" (fast-food, fast-paced), forming a compound. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like food-, door-to-door, or mid-.
result.label: Hyphen after "fast"

result.description: Fires on the token ' external' (also 'externality' pieces and rarely ' secondary'), across contexts like externalities, external factors and external tangents. Members are mostly ' external' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' external' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb "make" and its forms (making, make, makes), mostly as a causative or light verb ("make an impact", "making them want more"). Members are mostly detectors of make/making. Predicts object pronouns like them/it.
result.label: make / making verb forms

result.description: Fires on the verb "determine" and its pieces (determ-, -ines, -ining, determined), mostly in scientific explanations where a factor determines an outcome, often before "whether/how/what". Stays quiet on unrelated text.
result.label: "determine" verb forms

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' Vietnam', ' spons'/'ship' in sponsorship, 'king' in parking, and ' schools' (of thought/art). No shared meaning; the members are mostly token detectors.
result.label: Mixed: Vietnam, sponsorship, schools
'istic' suffix piece
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'istic' when it ends a split word (determin-istic, lingu-istic, soph-istic, Art-istic). Members are mostly 'istic' token detectors. Output nudges toward 'ated' and similar continuations.
Fires on the suffix 'ation'/'ations' completing the word "oscillation(s)", after the piece 'oscill'. It stays silent on 'ations' in other words such as determinations, deviations and investigations.
result.label: -ation in oscillation

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ments' in the word "developments" (develop + ments). It stays silent on 'ments' in other words such as "treatments", and fires only weakly in "instruments".
result.label: 'ments' in "developments"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' disc' and ' trans' (also ' cal') that begin a longer word such as discourage, discernment, transcription. Predicts a continuation piece like 'pose', 'rim', 'pos'.
result.label: disc-/trans- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ic' (also 'ig', 'ent', 'erm') right after the fragment 'pred' when it begins "predicate"-like words. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as symbolic, proficient or strategic.
result.label: 'ic' after 'pred' (predicate)
-ers suffix on thinker/scholar nouns
result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix "ers" at the end of person nouns like thinkers, philosophers, pioneers, in lists of scholars, artists and scientists. Stays quiet on "ers" in non-person words like reminders or minicomputers.
Fires on the word-piece ' squ' (start of "squared", "squaring", "squash", "squirting"), mostly in "squared differences" in variance text. Members include squ detectors and 'ared' detectors.
result.label: ' squ' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " specific" (occasionally " certain") used as a determiner before a noun, such as "specific type" or "specific energy". It stays quiet on generic text with no such word.
result.label: Determiner "specific" / "certain"

result.description: Fires on the word " poetry" (occasionally " literature") when it names the genre or art form, often after a modifier like "narrative", "dramatic" or "lyrical". Supported by poetry/verse detectors and literary-writing context members.
result.label: poetry word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " voice" or " voices" (speech, voice technology, grammatical voice, a writer's voice). Members include several voice-token detectors plus speech and audio technology context members.
result.label: voice / voices token

result.description: Fires on word endings and words about efficiency or productivity: "effect-iveness", "product-ivity", "efficien-cies", and " efficiency". Mostly appears in organizational or performance-measurement text.
result.label: Effectiveness/productivity/efficiency terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ared' completing "squared", mainly in statistics terms like chi-squared and R-squared. Members are mostly 'ared' detectors plus statistics context.
result.label: 'ared' in "squared"

result.description: Fires on era markers ' CE' and ' AD' (also BC/ago) right after a year number in historical date ranges, e.g. "1470 CE–1300 CE". Members detect CE/AD tokens and digits.
result.label: CE/AD era marker after year

result.description: Fires on the word piece " sens" when it starts a word like sensors, sensory or sensing, mostly in technical sensor-type lists. Members are mostly " sens" token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' sens' word-start piece (sensors)

result.description: Fires on the word "Distribution"/"distribution", most strongly after a named probability distribution (Normal, Binomial, Geometric) or as a heading. It is weaker in supply or heat "distribution" contexts.
result.label: Distribution token (statistics)

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'iling' when it follows 'bo' (boiling) and also in 'bi-iling-ualism'. It is silent when 'iling' starts a text with no preceding word piece.
result.label: 'iling' piece in boiling

result.description: Fires on the word ' loop'/' loops' (mostly programming loops, also feedback loops) and on the word-piece ' ag' (as in agenda, agile). Members are token detectors for loop and ag; it predicts word continuations.
result.label: loop / ag token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ower' in empowerment, 'pping' in overlapping, and also ' closed', ' town', 'iny'. It is silent when 'ower' starts a word after a sentence break, so it needs the preceding word piece (emp-, overla-).
result.label: Mid-word pieces: ower, pping

result.description: Fires on ' as' used as a role/function marker after a verb (used as, function as, acts as, seen as, regarded as), meaning "in the role of". Silent on "such as" and comparative "as".
result.label: ' as' after verb meaning "in role of"

result.description: Fires mainly on " relevant" as a pre-noun adjective after a verb or determiner (e.g. "gather any relevant information", "Provide relevant"). It weakly fires on similar participle or adjective modifiers such as presented, updated and exposed.
result.label: Pre-noun "relevant" adjective

result.description: Fires on the noun or quantifier right after the article "a" in a "a [moment/lot/nod/little/touch] of/to" phrase, where a measure or small-amount noun follows the indefinite article. Windows share this "a ___ of/to" slot.
result.label: Noun after "a" in quantity phrases

result.description: Fires on the word "audience" (including its pieces 'udi'+'ence', 'ces') and on the token right after it (' has', ' and', '-', "'"), in marketing/communication text. Silent on 'ence' in "essence".
result.label: audience word and following token

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'roid' completing a word, mainly in 'thyroid' (also 'embroidery'). Weak firing on 'gen' in 'allergen' and 'it' in 'prioritize'. Members are mostly detectors of 'roid' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'roid' in thyroid

result.description: Fires on the word fragment " festiv" (start of "festivals"/"festivities"), predicting a suffix like "als" or "ities". Weaker on " hon" and " encourag" fragments. Silent on the contrast text, which has no such fragment.
result.label: " festiv" word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after "made up" (also "consist of", "composed of"), the composition construction introducing constituents. It stays silent on ' of' in other uses such as "example of" or "field of".
result.label: 'of' in "made up of"

result.description: Fires on word pieces ending food/category plurals and stems, such as "gra-ins", "past-ries", and "LWR-s", mostly in food or category-listing text. It is silent on "proteins" in a flavor context. Members are food, cooking, and "range/variety" detectors.
result.label: Food-word fragments: grains, pastries

result.description: Fires mostly on the hyphen or en dash in "nose-to-tail" in culinary text, and on " grow" in plant-growing contexts. It is silent on hyphens in other compounds like "real-time" or "poverty-free". Predicts "up"-type continuations weakly.
result.label: Culinary hyphen in nose-to-tail; grow

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'inal' in "marginal" (marginal cost/benefit) and 'ias' in "Bias" (Bias-Variance), plus a few other mid-word pieces. Silent when 'inal' starts a text without the "marg" prefix.
result.label: marg-inal / B-ias word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " intr" (as in intricate/intriguing), mostly after "the", "an" or "its" in abstract descriptive prose. It stayed silent in one case after "and". Next-token logits are not clearly informative.
result.label: ' intr' piece (intricate/intriguing)

result.description: Fires on the word "slow" and the pieces that continue a "slow" compound, such as "-" in slow-roasted or "ing" in slowing, plus "cook". Silent on cooking text without "slow". Predicts "slow"-like continuations.
result.label: slow and slow- compounds

result.description: Fires on the token " life" (also "Life") in science and nature text, such as extraterrestrial life, origin of life, life forms and life cycle. Members are mostly detectors of " life" itself.
result.label: Token " life"

result.description: Fires on word-initial uppercase fragments like ' TH', ' WH', ' SY', ' ST' in ALL-CAPS titles or headings, where a word is split into pieces and the next piece continues it. Silent on normal lowercase text.
result.label: Caps word-start fragments TH/WH/SY

result.description: Fires on the digit '7' as a non-initial digit inside a multi-digit year, especially in historical date ranges like (1774–1789) or 1755. It predicts further digits next.
result.label: Digit 7 inside year numbers

result.description: Fires on "al" completing "Environmental" (and on the word " environmental"), predicting environment-related continuations like policy or pollution. Stays silent on "al" in other words such as Moral, Seasonal, Functional.
result.label: Environmental word ending 'al'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ains" after "g" (gains), mostly in prospect-theory and zero-sum text about gains and losses. Members detect "ains" in other words, such as chains, and similar word-start pieces like g-.
result.label: "ains" in "gains"

result.description: Fires on the word " your" when it follows a verb (improve, refine, keep, enhance, give) and precedes a noun the reader owns, as in advice or instructional text. Members are mostly " your" detectors.
result.label: ' your' after verb in instructions

result.description: Fires on the 'es' ending of 'Trees' (e.g. Binary Trees, AVL Trees, Red-Black Trees) in data-structure text. It stays silent on 'es' in other words like 'complexes'.
result.label: 'es' in 'Trees'

result.description: Fires on mid-word or hyphen tokens in the middle of a word or compound where a suffix is expected, such as 'Rhet|or|ic', 'COVID-19', 'nuclear react|ion'. Silent on many other hyphens (cloud-based, dot-com). Logits favour endings like -ors, -itor, -station.
result.label: Mid-word piece or hyphen before continuation

result.description: Fires on the word "learning"/"Learning" in machine-learning terms such as Reinforcement Learning, Machine Learning and Supervised Learning. It also fires weakly on "processing" in "preprocessing". It is silent on unrelated text like 3D modeling and rendering.
result.label: Learning in machine-learning terms

result.description: Fires on the 'ent' piece inside the name "Lorentz" (Lorentz Transformation/Force), after the ' Lor' token. It stays silent on 'ent' in other words like "tangent".
result.label: 'ent' in Lorentz

result.description: Fires mainly on " codes" as a noun, especially in "quantum error correction codes" or "these codes" (coding theory). Members detect code/codes tokens. It also fires weakly on a few other noun tokens such as "ann" and "polynomial".
result.label: " codes" in error-correction contexts

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lect' inside "thermoelectric" (thermoe-lect-ric, -ricity, -rics). Members detect 'lect' and the preceding 'oe' piece; it does not fire on other uses of electric or power.
result.label: 'lect' in thermoelectric

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' ante' (antecedent), ' nas' (nasal), ' rev', ' nin' (nineteenth), where the token starts a longer word and the next piece completes it. Silent on other word starts like 'lex'.
result.label: Word-start pieces: ante-, nas-, nin-

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' when it comes after a hyphen or slash in a run of numbers, such as year ranges (1715-1800) or hyphenated number sequences. Often it is the leading digit of a second year. It stays silent on '1' in fractions like -(1/2).
result.label: Digit 1 in hyphenated number ranges

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ation' specifically in "intonation" (speech/phonetics text). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like instrumentation, sophistication, communication, investigation.
result.label: 'ation' in "intonation"

result.description: Fires on the "ons"/"on" piece completing "lessons"/"lesson" after "less". Weak activity on "less" followed by other words. Predicts "learned".
result.label: "ons" in "lessons"

result.description: Fires on word-completion pieces such as "ically" in "historically", "ated" in "illuminated", "um" in "aluminum" and " voice" in "passive/active voice". It needs the stem before it (histor-, illumin-, alumin-); "medically" stays silent.
result.label: Suffix after histor-/illumin-/alumin- stems

result.description: Fires on the token 'u' as a word-internal piece, most strongly in "Altruism" (Altr-u-ism), and predicts suffix pieces like 'istic'. It stays silent on 'u' in "virtu-um".
result.label: 'u' inside Altruism-type words

result.description: Fires mid-word on the 'u' in "fid-u-ciary" (also 'u' in vacuum or induced), and on word pieces like " minim" and "CM". Fires on a word fragment that needs more pieces to finish the word.
result.label: Mid-word 'u' in fiduciary

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ating' (also 'ated') in "captivating"/"captivated", and more weakly "fascinating". Silent on 'ating' in verbs like "celebrating" or "investigating".
result.label: captivating suffix 'ating'

result.description: Fires on capitalized word-initial fragments at the start of a line or title, such as " Cir" in "Circles", " He" in "Heap", and " Bob". It needs a heading-like start, where the token begins a longer word or name.
result.label: Capitalized word-start fragment in headings

result.description: Fires on size/extent adjectives like "vast" and "large" (also "great", "wide"), mostly before nouns like regions, territories or amounts. Members are detectors of vast/large/larger/wide/massive-type words.
result.label: Vast/large size adjectives

result.description: Fires on the 'ated' piece completing "unsaturated" (also "monounsaturated", "saturated"), in chemistry and fats text. Weakly on other words ending in -ated; silent on "concentrated".
result.label: 'ated' in (un)saturated

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ers' (also 's') right after the word piece 'speak', as in 'speakers' or 'speaks', mostly in linguistics-style text. It stays silent on 'ers' after other stems like 'learn' or 'check'.
result.label: speak + ers suffix

result.description: Fires on the word " balance" (and the piece " bal" in balanced), mainly in the "balance between X and Y" or balanced-out sense. Silent on some uses of "balance" in other contexts. Members are mostly token-level noise, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: balance / bal token

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ating' (also 'ated', 'ates', 'ate') when it completes the word "advocating"/"advocate" after the ' advoc' piece, typically before "for". Silent on 'ating' in other words like operating, heating, validating.
result.label: advoc-ating suffix

result.description: Fires on ' peak' and ' maximum' (peak height, maximum concentration) as a modifier before a measurement noun, mostly in chromatography/analytical text. Weakly on words like 'desired' or 'next'. Members are mostly detectors of peak/maximum.
result.label: peak / maximum before measurement noun

result.description: Fires on the token ' freedom' wherever it appears, across political, philosophical and rights-related text. Upstream members are detectors of freedom, liberty, independence and rights words. It weakly fires on ' free' in other contexts.
result.label: ' freedom' token detector

result.description: Fires on the pronoun " they" (also "they"), mostly as the subject of a clause after a conjunction or verb like "if", "when", "that", and pushes toward verbs such as may, contain, operate. Silent on text without the pronoun.
result.label: Subject pronoun "they"

result.description: Fires on subscript/superscript markers after a math variable (x_, x^, x[k], x2 in polynomials and vectors), i.e. the token right after a variable letter like x. Silent on underscores in other math-markup contexts like logsub_p.
result.label: Index/exponent marker after variable x

result.description: Fires on the token ' interrupt' (interrupt handler, interrupt service routine, types of interrupts), mostly in computing and operating-system text. A few weak hits on ' shut' and ' reverse'. Fed by interrupt-token detectors.
result.label: ' interrupt' token in computing text

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like 'ers', 'er', 'ering' right after the stem "est" in chemistry text (esters, esterification). Silent on 'ers' in other words such as philosophers, polymers, lasers.
result.label: Suffix after "est" in esters

result.description: Fires on a period after a single-letter initial inside a person's name (e.g. "Kenneth H." or "L.R."), where a surname follows. It stays silent on periods ending a full name at a sentence or line end.
result.label: Period after name initial

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' compens' and the following 'ation' in "compensation" (especially executive compensation), plus some other mid-word pieces like 'val' in "approval". Silent on 'ation' in other words like litigation or corporation.
result.label: compensation word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " ideas" (occasionally " idea"), mostly when it is the subject noun starting a clause, such as "ideas also existed". Weaker in "exchange of ideas". Early-layer token detectors for ideas/concepts drive it.
result.label: ' ideas' token detector

result.description: Fires on process nouns like establishment, creation, formation after "the" or a modifier, mostly in abstract or political/economic text, where "of" is expected next. Silent when the word starts the document.
result.label: Creation/establishment/formation nouns before "of"
'ir' word piece inside words
result.description: Fires on the token piece 'ir' in the middle of a word, such as ch-ir-p, sw-ir-ling, T-Sh-ir-ts, squ-ir-ting, St-ir-ling and sat-ir-ical. Members are mostly 'ir' token detectors. Silent on text without that piece.

Fires on the last token of water-resource phrases in hydrology text (groundwater, water sources, drinking water, freshwater supplies), where the next word is likely a water term like aqu-, hydro-, or recharge. Silent on general climate text.
result.label: Water resource terms in hydrology

result.description: Fires on the token right after "allows/helps/provides/requires us" (' to', ' with', ' and', ' more'), and on "us" and "-able" pieces. It seems to need the verb-plus-"us" construction; ' to' elsewhere stays silent.
result.label: Complement slot after "allows us"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'aching' when it completes the word "coaching" (co + aching), especially in leadership or business text. It stays silent when 'aching' starts a document with no 'co' before it.
result.label: 'aching' in "coaching"

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns (e.g. "testing, documentation, reporting, administration"), mostly management or organizational terms. Silent on commas after sentence-initial or "on the other hand" phrases.
result.label: Comma within noun lists

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Do' when it begins "Doppler" (as in "Doppler Effect"), predicting the rest of the word. Weaker activation on ' No' before "Noam Chomsky". Members include ' Do' and 'pp' detectors.
result.label: ' Do' starting "Doppler"
'op' piece inside a word
result.description: Fires on the subword piece 'op' in the middle of a longer word, such as Isot-op-ic, end-op-araspit, ex-op-lanet and Hiph-op. It stays silent when 'op' starts the text as a standalone fragment.

Fires on word pieces completing forms of "balance" (bal-ances, bal-ancing, bal-anced, " balance"), especially the verb. Silent on "anced" in unrelated words like "nuanced". Members are detectors of "bal"/"balance" tokens.
result.label: balance word pieces (balancing/balances)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ace" in the middle of a split word, especially botanical family names like Rosaceae, Poaceae and Fabaceae. It also fires weakly on other mid-word pieces such as "endo" in crescendo.
result.label: "ace" piece in split words

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' emer' (emerge, emergent, emergence) and ' est' (esters, est-), where the piece starts a longer word. Silent on ' emer' in the foreign-looking 'emergendt'. Members are detectors of ' emer' and ' Est'.
result.label: ' emer' / ' est' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " context" (and occasionally " ambigu", " tone", " pace") in discussions of language, meaning and interpretation, often after a modifier like linguistic, cultural or situational. Members are mostly " context" token detectors.
result.label: " context" in meaning/interpretation text

result.description: Fires on the word " syntax" (and "syntax"), mostly in discussions of language, grammar, semantics or programming. Members include detectors for syntax, grammar and semantics tokens plus linguistics-related word pieces. Weakly fires on "gram" pieces.
result.label: syntax token detector

result.description: Fires on the "AD" piece in the acronym CAD (Computer-Aided Design), and on "D" in 3D, in design/modeling text. Mostly detects the AD token with virtual/real-world design context; next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: CAD acronym 'AD' token

result.description: Fires on the token ' mark' (and the following 'ing' piece) as a word stem in marks, marking, markings, markets, question mark. It predicts word-ending suffixes such as 'ets', 'ings' and 'ing'.
result.label: ' mark' word stem

result.description: Fires on the 'tz' piece in "Boltzmann" (Bol-tz-mann), predicting the continuation 'mann'. Early-layer 'tz' detectors drive it. It is silent on other thermodynamics text without that word piece.
result.label: 'tz' in Boltzmann

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' chrom' when it begins a word like chromosome, chromatin or chromatography. Members are mostly ' chrom' token detectors plus related prefix pieces like ' nuc'.
result.label: ' chrom' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'pe' in "therapeutic" (51 of 64 peaks), where the word is still unfinished. It weakly fires on other word-start pieces such as 'catal' and 'initi'. Members are mostly 'pe' piece detectors.
result.label: 'pe' inside "therapeutic"

result.description: Fires on ' Atlantic' right after 'North' (e.g., 'the North Atlantic', 'North Atlantic Alliance'). Members detect 'North', 'Atlantic', and geographic names like America and Asia. Weak firing on bare ' North'.
result.label: ' Atlantic' after 'North'

result.description: Fires on the quantifier ' multiple' (occasionally 'many'/'Many') before a plural noun, often in technical text about database relationships or variables. Upstream members detect multiple/several/various/numerous and other count words.
result.label: 'multiple' quantifier before plural noun

result.description: Fires on the "able" piece completing "afford-able" (mostly before "housing"), and weakly on "afford" itself. It stays silent on "able" in usable, sustainable, enjoyable and biodegradable. It pushes towards housing, price and rent.
result.label: "able" in "affordable"

result.description: Fires on the token ' pun' (the word pun/puns, and the start of punctuation/punster words split as 'pun' + piece), predicting a continuation piece such as 'ctu'. Weaker on word-start pieces like ' dis' and ' cre'.
result.label: ' pun' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ating'/'ators' in "estim-" words (estimators, estimating) in statistics text, and weakly on 'of' after "estimates". Silent on 'ating' in other words like accommodating or validating.
result.label: estim-ators/estimating suffix in statistics

result.description: Fires on abstract outcome nouns ending a phrase, such as " consequences", "outcomes" (out+comes), " purposes", and "virtues". It is strongest on " consequences" and "comes" in "outcomes". It predicts sentence-ending punctuation or "for".
result.label: Consequences / outcomes / purposes nouns

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces ('s', 'ed', 'sm') attached directly to the stem "craft" (crafts, craftsmen, crafted, craftsmanship). Stays silent on 's' after other words, such as possessives or myths.
result.label: Suffix after "craft" stem

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' gest' (gesture, gestures) and ' cam' (cameras), mainly in gesture/body-language text. It marks an incomplete word piece that is continued by a suffix such as -ures or -eras. Members detect gesture tokens.
result.label: ' gest' word-piece in gesture
' innov' word-piece before -ation/-ative
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' innov' mid-sentence, as the start of innovation/innovative (e.g. "business model innovation"). It is silent on ' innov' at the start of a document. It pushes towards suffixes like -ative and -ation.
Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing "appreci-ation" (appreciation for/of). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like innovation, communication, generation, pronunciation. Weak on "perce-ive".
result.label: 'ation' in "appreciation"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' compet' (also ' Compet') at the start of competitor, competitive, competence or competencies, before the rest of the word. Predicts continuations like 'itive', 'itor' and ' competition'.
result.label: ' compet' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ating'/'ates' (also 'ate', 'rate') right after 'orchestr-', i.e. forms of 'orchestrate'. Silent on 'ating' in other words like 'electroplating' or 'attenuating'. Members detect the orchestr- stem pieces.
result.label: orchestr-ating/ates suffix

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces, mainly ' tar' (before "iffs") and ' walk', also 'ber' and 'do'. Members include tariff-piece detectors and a ' walk' detector. The target is mixed and has no clear shared theme.
result.label: tar / walk word pieces

result.description: Fires on uppercase word-fragment tokens (ED, LE, ON, ER) in the middle of all-caps words or acronyms, such as LEED, PASTLE, COMMON. Silent on normal lowercase prose.
result.label: Uppercase word-piece fragments (ED, LE, ON)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'hed' inside 'polyhedra' / 'tetrahedron' (geometry), with a few weaker hits on other tokens like ' explos', ' waiting', ' off'. Members are mostly 'hed' detectors.
result.label: 'hed' in polyhedra/tetrahedra

result.description: Fires on the verb " contain" (also " possess") when it is a verb meaning to hold or include, as in "sets that do not contain themselves" or "contain the spill". Members detect "contain" and its variants.
result.label: verb "contain" / "possess"

result.description: Fires on the word " resistance", mainly in ship hull/fluid-dynamics lists (frictional, wave-making, pressure resistance). It also fires more weakly on other uses such as corrosion resistance. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' resistance' token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'cement' in 'reinforcement' (reinfor|cement), mostly in psychology/learning text about positive or negative reinforcement. Predicts 'learned'/'learning' next.
result.label: 'cement' in reinforcement

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' absor' (absorption, absorbed, absorber), occasionally on ' conform'. It predicts a word-completing suffix such as 'ption' or 'bing'.
result.label: ' absor' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the final piece "ence" in "due diligence" (after "dilig"/"dil-ig"). Stays silent on "ence" in other words like excellence, adherence, precedence, essence.
result.label: "ence" ending "due diligence"

result.description: Fires on regulatory-related terms: the "atory" piece of "regulatory" and nouns like "requirements", "standards", "frameworks" that follow "regulatory". It needs a regulation or compliance context; it stays silent on generic technology text.
result.label: Regulatory requirements/standards nouns

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'en' piece in the name Krashen (Krashen's theory, language acquisition text), plus occasional 'in'/'ial' pieces in academic words. Silent on 'en' in 'citizen'. Members detect the 'Krash' prefix.
result.label: 'en' in Krashen

result.description: Fires mainly on " composite" in materials-science text (fibre-reinforced composites, polymers, alloys), with weaker firing on word pieces like "loy", "ge", "iz". Members detect material, alloy and composite words.
result.label: Composite in materials science

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ley' ending a surname, such as Shapley, Morley, Cayley, Huxley and Earley, mostly in math and science text. Many members are 'ley' detectors.
result.label: 'ley' ending surnames

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' as the second digit of a 20xx year (2[0]01, 2[0]04, 202[0]), mostly in year ranges. Silent on '0' ending decade forms like 1960s or 1970s.
result.label: Zero in 20xx years

result.description: Fires on the token ' G' as a standalone capital G, both as a group-theory variable (subgroup of G, Z(G), G/Z) and as the start of 'Gender' or 'Gamma' at line starts. Members are mostly G-token detectors.
result.label: Capital G token detector
' advanced' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' advanced', both as an adjective ('advanced mathematics') and as a verb ('has advanced'). Members are mostly early-layer detectors of the same token. The contrast text has no ' advanced'.

Fires on the word-start pieces ' vers' (mostly in "vice versa") and ' par' (parity, parsers, paradox) when they begin a longer word. Members are detectors of these pieces. Weak activation on similar fragments such as 'rel'.
result.label: ' vers' / ' par' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ification' (also 'ality', 'ifying'), most strongly in 'personification', after the stem 'person'. Members detect person- stems and -ification endings. Weaker on other word endings.
result.label: -ification suffix after 'person'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ional' when it completes "emot-ional" (emotional connections, state, intelligence). It stays silent on 'ional' in "intentional" and on "ot-ional" fragments, so it needs the emot- prefix.
result.label: 'ional' after emot- (emotional)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ek' inside words and names (Petschek, edekind, truth-seeking, information-seeking). It also fires weakly on 'inking' in "Design Thinking" and on "solve" in problem-solving. Members are mostly 'ek' token detectors.
result.label: 'ek' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in technical materials-science terms, mainly 'att' in "lattices" and 'zo'/'za' in "piezoelectric". It also fires weakly on other word pieces inside long technical words. Predicts a continuation of the word.
result.label: Word pieces in lattice/piezoelectric

result.description: Fires on the token ' found' when it is the start of a split word like "foundations" or "foundational", predicting "ational" or similar continuations. Only weakly active on "found" meaning "discovered" (e.g. "configuration found in").
result.label: ' found' as start of foundation(s)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " found" (or "Found") when it begins a word like "foundation", "foundational" or "found objects". It predicts continuations such as "ational" and "ations".
result.label: ' found' as start of foundation-

result.description: Fires on the token 'n' used as a mathematical variable (factorial n!, binomial n choose k, sequence index a_n, n+1) in math text. Members are mostly 'n' detectors.
result.label: Math variable 'n'

result.description: Fires on the token ' decay', mainly in physics contexts such as beta, alpha, gamma or radioactive decay. It is weak on decay in rot or spoilage, and silent on other text. Early members are ' decay' token detectors.
result.label: ' decay' in radioactive decay

result.description: Fires on the word " something" as the object of a verb or preposition (finding something, create something, feel something). Weaker on " someone". Predicts continuations like " else" or a modifier. Members mostly detect " something"/" anything".
result.label: " something" as object pronoun

result.description: Fires on forms of "contribute" (' contribute', 'ributes', 'uting' in "contributing"), mostly where a subject is said to contribute to something, predicting " to". Silent on nearby text about collaboration without the verb.
result.label: contribute verb forms

result.description: Fires on the short pieces ' la' and ' de'/' De' (Spanish function words and word-start fragments like 'la'kes, 'de'construction), often where the piece begins a longer word. Silent in the Italian contrast text.
result.label: ' la' / ' de' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (also 'isation'), most strongly at the end of "Polymerization" in polymer-chemistry headings. It is weak on other words such as tokenization, and silent on acclimatization. Members include 'ization' and 'polym' detectors.
result.label: -ization suffix after polymer

result.description: Fires on the word piece "pect" as a split token, in "Res|pect" (e.g. "Respect for diversity") and "pers|pect|ives". It stays silent in "spectroscope" and "spectrum", where the piece is part of a different word.
result.label: 'pect' piece in Respect/perspectives

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' en' at the start of a word being built (enrichment, encompasses, enzyme, enlargement), predicting continuations like clos, velop, abling. Silent on other tokens.
result.label: ' en' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "electron"/"Electron" in "electron-electron" (also weakly on "electron" + pairs/density/ics). Silent on hyphens after other words like spin, cutting, high, non.
result.label: Hyphen after "electron"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " comp" when it begins a word, especially in compliance-related text where "compliance" is the expected continuation. Members are mostly detectors of " comp" and legal/regulation words.
result.label: " comp" start of "compliance"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "strateg" (strategic, strategies) and "ateg" in "-ategic/-ategically", plus occasionally "deliber". Silent on some "strateg" cases in risk-management or organizational text, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: strateg- word piece

result.description: Fires on the ending of academic discipline names, mainly '-ology' word pieces (sociology, ethnomusicology) and ' Geography' in lists of fields or topics. It predicts suffix-like continuations such as 'ography'. It stays silent on 'ology' in etymology, ideology, ontology.
result.label: Academic discipline name endings (-ology, Geography)

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'ing', 's', 'ors', 'ive', especially after 'collect' (collecting, collectors, collective) and after sender's. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like responding or assessing. Members are collect- and suffix detectors.
result.label: Suffix after 'collect' stems

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'aging' completing the word "messaging" (text, voice, instant messaging). Silent on 'aging' in "engaging" and at the start of a document.
result.label: 'aging' in "messaging"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ance' (also 'ry' in rivalry) completing nouns like dominance, codominance, sibilance, abundance, romance. Silent in 'governance' and 'enhance'. Strongest in genetics "incomplete dominance" text.
result.label: -ance suffix in dominance-type nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'st' inside 'cry|st|allization' and its variants (crystallite, crystallisation). Weaker on 'st' in '21st' and 'substantial'. Members are mostly 'st' token detectors.
result.label: 'st' in crystallization

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in academic or science text, mainly ' goal', ' Cooper' (Cooper pairs), ' Self', and 'e'. Peaks are mixed, and the members are mostly generic early-layer token detectors. Silent on 'Goal 14' list-style uses.
result.label: Scattered academic tokens: goal, Cooper, Self

result.description: Fires on ' repositories' and related repository/archive words (' repos', 'arch' in archives, 'DB') when used as collections of data or records. Silent on a library/organization sentence lacking such a word.
result.label: repositories / archives of data

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "male" (male-dominated, male-coded) and on a few other tokens like " male", " tax", "ress" after male/gender-themed context. Silent on hyphens after "gender" or "Socio".
result.label: Hyphen after "male" in gender text

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " check" (grammar checker, checkpoint, checks), with minor peaks on other pieces like " Reyn", " conform", " bod". Seems tied to compliance/verification-type terms; predicts word continuations like "compat".
result.label: " check" in checker/checkpoint compounds

result.description: Fires on the 'ism' piece in "seismic" (se|ism|ic), after the 'se' fragment. It stays silent when 'ism' starts a word, as in "ismology".
result.label: 'ism' inside "seismic"

result.description: Fires on the word "Vector"/"vector" in mathematical text (vector spaces, vector calculus), mostly capitalized in headings. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. It is silent on related linear algebra text that lacks the word itself.
result.label: Vector token (math contexts)
Separator punctuation in lists and times
result.description: Fires on separator punctuation (' -', ':', ';', '.') between items in lists, number sequences, times and dashed lines. Silent on ordinary sentence punctuation. Logits are mixed and not informative.
Fires on the word ' self' as a prefix piece, mostly in compounds like self-awareness, self regulation, self image, where a hyphen or noun follows. Silent on ' self' at the very start of a document.
result.label: ' self' prefix in compounds

result.description: Fires on " processing" in computing/technical text, most strongly in "central processing unit", also after digital, signal, parallel, data. Predicts suffix-like continuations such as "ting", "ation", "ors". Silent on general computing text without the word.
result.label: " processing" in computing terms

result.description: Fires on pieces of the term "UV-Vis spectroscopy" (Vis, Spect, spectra), mainly the 'Vis' and ' Spect' tokens in ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy text. Weak on other chemistry word pieces. Silent on generic "emission spectroscopy" text.
result.label: UV-Vis spectroscopy term pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'igen' in "Eigenvalues/Eigenvectors" and on 'vention' in "intervention". Both are mid-word pieces, and the members mostly detect 'igen' or 'vention' directly. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'igen' and 'vention' word pieces
' navig' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' navig' (navigating, navigational, navigators), often when the word is used figuratively for handling data or risk. Members are mostly detectors of navig/navigation tokens.

Fires on the hyphen right after "life" in compounds like life-saving, life-world, life-preserving. Silent on hyphens after other words (full-, self-, human-, pre-). Weakly fires on other "life" continuations such as lifecycle and lifespan.
result.label: hyphen after "life"

result.description: Fires on the word " processes" (also " process"), most strongly in computing and operating-system text about processes being scheduled, executed or allocated resources. It is weaker on "process" in general industrial or scientific uses.
result.label: ' processes' noun, computing contexts

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'acy' when it completes the word "privacy" (priv|acy). It stays silent on 'acy' at the start of a text or in 'efficacy'. Members detect 'priv' and 'acy' pieces.
result.label: 'acy' in privacy

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ative' completing "cooper-ative", mostly in game-theory text (cooperative games). Silent on 'ative' in other words such as integrative, legislative, interpretative. Weakly fires on collaborative.
result.label: 'ative' in cooperative

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " noise" (occasionally " rain"), especially in noise-reduction, noise-pollution and sound/acoustics text, where it is often the first part of a compound or topic. It nudges the next token toward filtering/selection words.
result.label: ' noise' token in acoustics contexts

result.description: Fires on prepositions (' to', ' in', ' at', ' of', ' into') right after a verb or noun like "leads", "culminating", "rest", "builds up", especially in result or outcome phrases. It is silent on many other ' to' uses.
result.label: Result-phrase prepositions after leads/culminating

result.description: Fires on the word " authentication" in computer security text, such as "multi-factor authentication" or "authentication methods". Members include several authentication token detectors. Weak activation on " user" in "multi-user".
result.label: authentication token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'st' inside "crystallization" (and misspellings like "crystalleization"), right after "cry". It stays silent on 'st' in "Substances", so it needs the word-internal cry+st context.
result.label: 'st' in crystallization

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'roph' inside biological terms like biotrophs, hemibiotrophs and necrotrophs (also 'ogeneous' weakly). Early-layer members detect 'roph' and the preceding 'ot' piece.
result.label: 'roph' in -troph words

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe that closes a quoted letter or word piece (e.g. 'wrist'', 'æ'') or follows a noun like "author'" before an expected "s". Silent on apostrophes at the start of text or in contractions like can't.
result.label: Closing apostrophe after quoted fragment

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in chemistry/materials text, mainly "atta" in Ziegler-Natta and "arch" in starch. Upstream members are materials/chemistry token detectors. Mostly a within-word piece detector.
result.label: Natta / starch word-piece in chemistry

result.description: Fires on word pieces in nanotechnology and materials-science text, such as 'nan', 'ot', 'ost' in nanotube and nanostructure, and on technical word starts like 'piezo' and 'exc'. Silent in general AI/tech text.
result.label: Nano/materials science word pieces

result.description: Fires on the document-start/newline-paragraph token (shown as ¶) that begins a new line in lists of short headings, topics or names, e.g. after "Mathematics." before "Computer Science". Silent on the very first token of a document.
result.label: Paragraph break in short-item lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ation' completing the word "Communication" in a list of short topic headings. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like Innovation, Penetration, Intonation, Hibernation.
result.label: 'ation' in "Communication"

result.description: Fires on word-internal fragments 'z' (Hz, Cézanne, Alzheimer's, Byzantine, Hertzsprung) and 'ry' in 'Dry', mid-word before the rest of a name or term. Silent on ordinary text.
result.label: Mid-word 'z' and 'ry' pieces

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces 'ing', 'able', 'ability' completing the word "account" (accounting, accountable, accountability). Silent on 'ing' in other words like sailing or expanding.
result.label: Suffix after "account"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' native', ' local', 'ual', 'ed', ' materials', ' sound') inside text about language-learning apps, audio and technology. Peaks are scattered and weak; members mostly detect language and linguistic words plus generic nouns.
result.label: Language/audio tech scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ific' in the middle of longer words such as insign-ific-ant, Sign-ific-ance, Scient-ific and Art-ific-ial. It needs a preceding word-start fragment. Weakly fires on other mid-word pieces like ' aw' in awareness.
result.label: 'ific' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires on the word ' use' (also ' uses', ' Use'), mostly as a verb after a subject ("how we use", "how artists use"), and also as a noun ("the use of"). Members are mostly detectors of 'use' and near-synonyms like utilization and application.
result.label: the word 'use'

result.description: Fires on plural nouns ' keys' (mostly database primary/foreign/candidate keys), and less on ' tracks' and ' entries', as the noun after a modifier or 'of'. Quiet in a hashing passage without the word keys.
result.label: Plural 'keys' (database keys)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' imag' at the start of "imagery" (and "imaging"), typically after adjectives like vivid, visual, or olfactory in writing and literature text. Members are mostly ' imag' detectors plus literary-topic context.
result.label: ' imag' in imagery

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start or sit inside words beginning with "per"/"fle"/"fe": 'fect' in Perfect, 'eting' in fleeting, ' per' (per meter, pertains). Predicts continuations like ' Per', 'lex', 'ense'.
result.label: Per-/fect/fleeting word pieces

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'any' in "accompanying" (also 'by' and other word-internal pieces), as the word continues to a suffix like -ing. Members detect word fragments such as 'any', 'iment', 'ary'.
result.label: 'any' inside "accompanying"

result.description: Fires on the word " change" / " changes" as a noun, especially after a modifier like social, political, technological or organizational (e.g. "change management"). Members are detectors of change/modification/shift words.
result.label: noun "change" after modifier

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of long technical words split into pieces, mainly ' ul' (ultrasound), ' vern' (vernacular) and ' Orth' (orthographic), where more pieces follow. Members are detectors of those fragments.
result.label: Word-initial fragments ul/vern/Orth

result.description: Fires on the comma or ' to' / ' of' directly after the word "addition" (In addition, / addition to / addition of). Members detect "addition" and "add-". It stays silent on commas after other words like "instance" or "contrast".
result.label: Token right after "addition"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ative' completing the word "iterative" (after 'iter'). It stays silent on 'ative' in words like innovative and creative.
result.label: 'ative' in "iterative"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ent' inside a longer word, especially "sequ-ent" (subsequent, consequent), and weakly on similar suffix pieces like 'al'. It stays silent on 'ent' after a space or at the start of a sentence.
result.label: 'ent' inside sequent-type words
Hyphen after prefix or label
result.description: Fires on the hyphen token '-' when it joins a prefix or short first element (macro-, anti-, Pre-, root-left-) to a following part. It stays quiet on hyphens in compounds like day-old, protein-rich and non-key.

Fires on words inside a description of a "process" (' involves', 'complex', 'process') right after the word "process" as subject, e.g. "process involves complex steps". Silent on 'involves' after other subjects like physics or project management.
result.label: Word after "process" subject

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing "Conserv-ation" (conservation of energy / geomorphic conservation). It stays silent on 'ation' in Acceleration, Hibernation and Penetration, so it needs the Conserv- stem before it.
result.label: 'ation' ending Conservation

result.description: Fires on the 'ly' piece inside "electrolysis/electrolyte/electrolytic" (after "electro"), and on ' intr' in "intriguing/intricate". Silent on ordinary adverb '-ly' endings such as solely, orderly, increasingly.
result.label: 'ly' in electrolysis; ' intr' in intriguing

result.description: Fires on analysis/perception verbs like detect, identify, analyze, understand, especially as verbs in lists or after "to". Logits favor suffixes (-able, -ment), so it likely expects a suffix or object next.
result.label: Detect/identify/analyze verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' revel' (also ' anticip') when it begins "revelation(s)", mostly in text about stories, readers and plot. It is a detector of the first piece of a multi-token word.
result.label: ' revel' start of revelations

result.description: Fires on a measure or process noun (density, growth, dynamics, size) right after "population" in ecology/statistics text. Members detect "population" and "density". It predicts quantitative nouns like statistics or trajectory.
result.label: Population + growth/density noun

result.description: Fires on function words (around, of, and, for, from) in text about prehistoric or ancient civilizations, language origins, and early writing. Members detect ancient-civilization and early-human words (cuneiform, Mesopotamia, Paleolithic). Silent on 'around' before dates in other topics.
result.label: Function words in ancient history text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "innov" (' innov' or 'nov' in "Innovation/innovative") and predicts continuations like -ation/-ative. Silent in one case where it started the text (document-initial position).
result.label: innov- word start (innovation)

result.description: Fires on the token " begins" as a verb, typically in "X begins with/at ..." describing how a process or stage starts. It stays silent when "begins" opens a sentence right after a period, with no subject before it.
result.label: " begins" after a subject

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments that begin or sit mid-word: 'det' in determin-/deterministic, ' Ro' in 'Role', and 'eling' in 'tunneling'. It looks like a mix of unrelated pieces whose next token continues the word.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: det, Ro, eling

result.description: Fires on the token " expert" (and its start-of-word use in "expertise", "expert systems", "expertly"). Upstream members are mostly " expert" token detectors in early layers. The contrast has no "expert" token, so it needs nothing else.
result.label: ' expert' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " eyes", mostly in lists of body parts or senses (eyes and ears, with my eyes). Members detect eyes, ears, heart, gaze and sight tokens. Silent on general vision-system text without the word.
result.label: ' eyes' in sense/body-part lists

result.description: Fires on causal or system-dynamics words (causes, effects, balance/equilibrium, drive, stimulates) in climate and physical-science text about processes and feedbacks. Peaks are scattered across several words, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Causal/process words in climate science

result.description: Fires on the verb suffix 'ing' of a gerund verb such as limiting, restricting or protecting. These usually appear in regulatory or economic text and take an object. It stays silent on 'ing' in noun-like words such as functioning, licensing or mastering.
result.label: Gerund 'ing' in regulation text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " aud" (also "aud", " Aud") at the start of "audit", "auditor" or "auditory", when the full word is still unfinished. It predicts completions like "itor", "itory" and "ers".
result.label: "aud" piece of audit words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Si' when it begins "Siouan" (as in Siouan languages), in linguistics text. Predicts continuation pieces like 'ou'. Weak activation on other split-word beginnings like 'Bra' in Brahmi.
result.label: ' Si' starting "Siouan"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ums' completing "forums" (plural), with weak activation on other suffix pieces like 'ity' in "equity". Early members are detectors of the 'ums' / 'um' ending.
result.label: 'ums' in "forums"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'id' inside a word, mainly "hum-id-ity" (also rig-id, ox-id-ation). Silent when 'id' starts a word or follows other pieces, e.g. "mult-id-imensional" or after a full stop.
result.label: 'id' piece in humidity

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ul' that begins "ultra-" words (ultrasound, ultrasonics, ultrathin) in technical or medical text. Members detect ' ul' and following 'ason' pieces, plus medical/testing context.
result.label: ' ul' start of ultra- words

result.description: Fires on the word " left" (direction or position, as in "to the left", "left rotations") when it follows other words. It stays silent when " left" starts the text. Members are mostly detectors of "left" and "leave".
result.label: Word "left" after context

result.description: Fires on the noun " hub" (also " centre"/" center") as a central node or focal point, such as trading hub, central hub or network hub. Weaker on similar words like "point" in "turning point".
result.label: hub (central node) token

result.description: Fires mainly on ' ion' (ionic, ionization), and also on ' tested' and ' charged', in science and technical text. Members include electric/current and ion detectors. The tokens are mixed and the contrast is uninformative.
result.label: ion / tested / charged tokens

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ic' ending "socio-economic" (and "socioeconomic"), especially in social-science contexts. It stays silent on 'ic' inside other words like mimicry, practicable, proficiency.
result.label: 'ic' in socio-economic

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'ises' in "premises" (and occasionally 'ions', 'conclusion', 'construction') in texts about deductive logic and arguments. Predicts argument/proof words next.
result.label: 'premises' in logic/argument text

result.description: Fires on the token ' Quant' (start of "Quantum") at the beginning of a title or list item, such as quantum-topic headings. It fires more weakly on lowercase ' quantum' in running text. Members are mostly ' Quant' and quantum-related detectors.
result.label: Quant- at start of Quantum

result.description: Fires on the piece 'net' when it follows 'Mag' inside "Magnet", "Magnetic", "Magnets". It stays silent when 'net' starts a text without the preceding 'Mag'.
result.label: 'net' inside Magnet words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "aps" completing "swaps" (e.g. "currency swaps", "interest rate swaps") after "sw". Silent when "aps" starts a document with no "sw" before it.
result.label: "aps" in "swaps"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compens' (start of "compensation") in the middle of text, usually after an adjective like "variable" or "equitable". It stays silent on the capitalized "Compensation" in the contrast. Members are mostly ' compens' token detectors.
result.label: ' compens' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token " emission" (as in emission/absorption spectroscopy or emission lines), built from detectors of emission/emissions word pieces. Weak activation on a few other words like " ambient" and " photo". Silent on a spectroscopy text without the word.
result.label: ' emission' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " linked" (singly linked lists, closely linked), and also on " extends", "executed" and word pieces like "intr-icate". Members are mainly " linked" token detectors plus related-word detectors. Peak consistency is moderate.
result.label: " linked" and similar verb participles

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ort' (coh-ort, dist-ort-ion, rapp-ort), 'on' (trig-on-ometric), and 'om', where a word is split into pieces. Members detect these word pieces. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ort, on, om

result.description: Fires on ' acceleration' and ' addition' (e.g. electrophilic/Michael addition) in physics and chemistry text. Silent on a nearby physics passage about energy and conservation without those words.
result.label: acceleration / addition in science

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ors' or 'ing' completing "sens-" (sensors, sensing) in technical remote-sensing text. It stays silent on 'ors' in other words like "investors".
result.label: sens-ors / sens-ing suffix

result.description: Fires on comparative degree words like "greater", "stronger", "closer" and "more", mostly in science or explanatory text, where a "than" or a following noun is expected. Members are detectors of "more" and "greater".
result.label: Comparative adjectives: greater, stronger, closer

result.description: Fires on the token " reflection" (physics of light/sound, e.g. "diffuse reflection", "reflection properties"), and rarely on "gru" in "congruence". Members are mostly detectors of "reflection"/"reflect" tokens.
result.label: ' reflection' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'point' as the suffix in hyphenated numbered terms like "one-point, two-point", and on ' of' after "Method" in titles. Silent on 'point' in "pinpoint". Predicts word-start continuations like 'anal'.
result.label: '-point' in one-point; 'Method of'

result.description: Fires on suffixes 'ing' and 'ful' attached to the stem "color" (coloring, colorful), mostly in graph-coloring text. It stays silent on 'ing' after other stems like intersect-, travers-, revis-. Members detect color/colors words.
result.label: color + suffix (coloring, colorful)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " maxim" (as in maximize, maximization, maxim of action), especially as the start of maximize-type words. It predicts suffixes like -izer/-izing/-ize. Weakly fires on " optim".
result.label: maxim- word piece

result.description: Fires on the word "offer"/"offering" (also "providing") as a verb or noun, mostly in business or marketing text about what a company or product provides. Members detect offer/provide tokens and related words.
result.label: offer / offering word

result.description: Fires on the 'ap' piece inside the word "metaphor" and its variants (metaphoric, metaphorical), after "met". Silent when 'ap' starts a document without "met" before it.
result.label: 'ap' inside "metaphor"

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces of plural/science nouns such as 'cles' (second "Circles" after a repeated heading), 'tes', ' cells', ' stars', 'cules'. Peak is mostly on repeated "Cir|cles" in math topic lists. Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Plural noun endings: cles, cells, stars

result.description: Fires on the final token of "World War I/II", "World Wars", and "interwar"/"postwar" (war, Wars, I), in historical text about the world wars. It predicts "II" or "war"-like continuations.
result.label: World War I/II and interwar tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' self' (including 'self-' compounds like self-regulation, self-reflection, and the noun "self"). Many members are ' self' detectors; it pushes towards a following hyphen.
result.label: ' self' token detector
