result.description: Fires on word pieces right after the prefix "Comp" (Comp|an-ies, Comp|ens-ation, Comp|act-ness), i.e. the continuation piece of a word starting with "Comp". It is silent on "an" without that prefix.
result.label: Continuation piece after "Comp" prefix

result.description: Fires on the token " reality" in all its uses: virtual, augmented or mixed reality, objective reality, reality TV, and philosophical talk about reality. Members are mostly detectors of " reality" itself, plus some truth and philosophy context.
result.label: ' reality' token detector

result.description: Fires on " management" as the head noun right after a noun modifier, especially "water resource management" and similar compounds (network, memory, fault management). Silent when preceded by adjectives like "adaptive" or "effective", or by "and".
result.label: noun-compound ' management'

result.description: Fires on the token " transport"/" Transport" (also "carri", "ation") when it is the start of words like transportation, mostly in logistics and infrastructure text. Upstream members are mostly transport-token detectors plus road and route words.
result.label: transport(ation) token in logistics

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ame' in "sesame" (also ' bla', 'ot'), where the word is not yet complete. Strongest in "sesame seeds" in food/seed lists. Weak elsewhere. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: 'ame' in sesame (word fragments)

result.description: Fires on the word " mass" (also " Mass"), strongest in physics and chemistry text such as mass spectrometry, mass-to-charge ratio and atomic mass. It also fires weakly on "mass" as in "mass population movements". Members are mostly token detectors for "mass".
result.label: ' mass' token detector
Digit '8' as third year digit
result.description: Fires on the digit '8' (sometimes 6, 5, 3) as the third digit of a four-digit year starting with 1, such as 1811 or 1650, especially in date ranges. It stays silent on '8' in years like 1908 or 1980.

Fires on religion-related words such as faith, worship, religion, divine, and weakly religious, in text about religion. It pushes towards spiritual/sacred vocabulary. Upstream members detect church and religious words.
result.label: Religion and faith words

result.description: Fires on the "or" piece inside "spons|or" (sponsorship, sponsors), in marketing and music-industry text. Weaker on "ors" in "vendors". Silent on "or" in "endorse" and "and/or".
result.label: "or" in sponsor(ship)

result.description: Fires on word pieces at the start of longer words, mainly ' una' (unaffected, unauthorized), also ' inhab', ' experien' and ' affected'. Predicts a continuation fragment of the word. Silent on unrelated data-topic text.
result.label: Word-start pieces: una-, inhab-, experien-

result.description: Fires on a full stop ending a sentence, mostly in essay-like prose about themes, culture or methods, often followed by a new sentence or numbered item. It stays silent on periods right before a document break.
result.label: Sentence-final period mid-document
'wh' word-piece before 'om/ose/isk'
result.description: Fires on the token 'wh' (or ' wh') when it is a word-start fragment, as in 'wh|om', 'wh|ose' and 'wh|isk'. It stays silent when the full words 'which' or 'who' appear.

Fires on adjectives or word pieces (-ative, effective, structural, consistent, improvements) in writing/editing advice text, where the next word is likely about editing or writing. Silent on 'ative' in communicative/generative/transformative.
result.label: Writing/editing quality adjectives

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' den', ' ill', 'ynt', ' ex' when they begin a longer word split into pieces (denaturation, illumination, denote, syntax). The continuation is predicted as a suffix piece.
result.label: Word-start fragments den/ill

result.description: Fires on the word piece " depart" (as in departments, departing), mostly in business or organizational text. Weakly fires on " equipment". Members include detectors of " depart" and word-start pieces that continue into longer words.
result.label: " depart" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words that are split into pieces, such as ' vari' (variability, varieties), ' Res' (Respect), ' prof' (profound), ' pron' and ' kn'. It seems to anticipate a continuation suffix, mainly at the start of a document or phrase.
result.label: Word-initial fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on the word-ending pieces 'te' in "analyte" and 'ary' in "stationary", in chromatography/separation-science text. Supported by detectors for the preceding pieces "analy" and "station".
result.label: analyte / stationary word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "br" in "brush", "bristle" and similar (br+ist, br+ush, also br+ands, br+ass). It stays silent on 'ist' in other words such as "specialist".
result.label: Piece after "br" in brush/bristle

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' fail' (and ' erg', fault-like stems) at the start of a word like "failures", mostly in technical text about system or engineering failures. Members detect fail/failure tokens. It is silent on unrelated engineering text.
result.label: ' fail' stem in failures

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, especially single Arabic letters inside words and long runs of dashes or underscores, plus pieces like 'touch' and 'mouth'. Evidence is mixed, with no single shared trigger.
result.label: Arabic word pieces and dash runs

result.description: Fires on "ly" in "particularly" and on "especially" (also "pecially"), the emphasizing adverb that introduces a parenthetical or qualifier. It stays silent on "ly" in other words like "initially", "overly", "scholarly" and "nearly".
result.label: particularly / especially emphasis adverb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' en' that begins a longer word (enrichment, enriching, enlightened, encompasses, enzyme), often after "and" or a comma. Predicts continuations like 'abling', 'hanced', 'rich', 'closed'.
result.label: Word-initial ' en' piece
Apostrophe before possessive s
result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token right after a name (Maxwell', Engelhardt', Receiver') where a possessive 's comes next, and pushes towards 's'. It stays silent on a closing quote mark after a word, as in 'binary'.

Fires on the token ' products', mostly as the head noun after a modifier such as dairy, cleaning, soy or animal, in food and consumer-goods text. Members include detectors of products/product and food or cooking words.
result.label: ' products' after food/goods modifier

result.description: Fires on the "season" word and its "al" suffix in "seasonal" (and "seasons"), in contexts about seasonal cycles, produce or calendars. It stays silent on "al" in unrelated words like "meal". Predicts season/cycle/calendar words next.
result.label: seasonal / season word piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' completing the word "constructive", where it follows the piece "construct" and predicts feedback/criticism. It stays silent on 'ive' in other words like productive or adaptive, or at the start of text.
result.label: 'ive' in "constructive"

result.description: Fires on ' Despite' opening a sentence, right after a document or paragraph start or a full stop. Members include detectors of 'Despite', 'although' and 'though'. Weak activation on other concessive words.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'Despite'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' che' in food contexts, mostly the start of 'cheese' (also 'chefs'), where it predicts a continuation like 'fs' or 'ese'. Members are mostly ' che' token detectors plus cooking and food context.
result.label: ' che' piece (cheese/chefs)

result.description: Fires on the word " atoms" (plural) in physics and chemistry text about matter, lattices and particles. It is built from detectors for atom, atomic, electrons and particles. It is quiet on chemistry text about bonds and forces that lacks the word.
result.label: Plural "atoms" in science text

result.description: Fires on the 'od' piece in "Geodetic" (after "Ge"), in geodesy text. It stays quiet on 'od' in other words like "theodolites" or at the start of a word.
result.label: 'od' in Geodetic

result.description: Fires on the word " ocean" (and "cean"), often in earth-science or marine text, including before suffixes like -ic. Mostly an ocean token detector; the next-token logits favor suffixes such as 'ic'.
result.label: ocean token detector

result.description: Fires on the word stem right after the prefix "un" (un-famil-iar, un-touch-ed, un-script-ed, un-met, un-match-ed), where the prefix is followed by a stem that continues into a word. Silent on other uses of these stems.
result.label: Stem after "un-" prefix

result.description: Fires on the token " life" in many contexts: life jackets, life testing, life-saving, life cycle, quality of life. Members are mostly " life" token detectors. Silent on text without that word.
result.label: ' life' token detector

result.description: Fires on verbs like "build", "falling", "break", "find" in essay-style text about narrative structure or gradually developing momentum (e.g. "falling act", "gradually build momentum"). Mixed verb set; members detect build/fall tokens and story-stage words.
result.label: build/falling in narrative structure

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'ically' and 'il' after a stem, especially 'crit|ically' and 'fert|il|ization'. Silent on 'ically' after other stems such as 'artist' or 'Schemist'. Weaker on 'reve|al'.
result.label: Word-piece 'ically'/'il' in crit-, fert-

result.description: Fires on the token ' derivative', in both calculus (second derivative of a function) and finance (derivative contracts). Weakly fires on 'denotation'/'connotation'. Supported by members detecting derivative tokens and math/calculus context.
result.label: ' derivative' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ius' ending (and ' Arr' before 'henius') in the name Svante Arrhenius, in chemistry contexts. It stays silent on 'ius' in Berzelius, so it needs this specific name.
result.label: Arrhenius name ending 'ius'

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that need a continuation, mainly ' eigen' (before vector/value), ' analy' (before tytes), and ' find' (findings), plus dash-line separators. Predicts suffix pieces like 'ings', 'aties'.
result.label: Incomplete word starts: eigen, analy, find

result.description: Fires on the token ' well' in the noun sense (quantum well, oil/water well, wells) and more weakly in 'as well as'. Silent when ' well' starts the text, with no preceding context. Members are mostly ' well' token detectors.
result.label: ' well' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "pr" (also "om", "ph", "rm") directly after the prefix "u" in words like "upright" (also "uranium", "urmari"). Silent on "pr" at the start of "principles", so it needs the preceding "u".
result.label: "pr" after "u" in upright

result.description: Fires on the token " health" in policy and public-health text (public health, population health, health policy). It predicts "care" next. Most members are detectors of " health" itself.
result.label: ' health' in policy contexts

result.description: Fires on varied nouns and function words (energy, electron, rings, within) shortly after the 'omic' piece of 'atomic' in science text. Silent on ' electron' in other contexts like 'electronegativity', so it needs the preceding 'atomic' cue.
result.label: Word after 'atomic' in chemistry text

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token (') glued to a preceding word, mostly in quoted or garbled text where it acts like a quote mark or contraction apostrophe. Silent on some apostrophes, e.g. at the start of a text or after a sentence end.
result.label: Apostrophe after word

result.description: Fires on " to" right after an evaluative adjective like "essential", "crucial" or "fundamental" (is essential to...). Members detect " to" and words such as essential, crucial and important. It stays silent on some " to" cases in similar sentences.
result.label: "to" after essential/crucial

result.description: Fires on the token right after "Local" or "local" at the start of a document (Local music, Local season, Local econom, Local Area Network's s). It seems to carry a "local" context forward. Silent on the same tokens elsewhere.
result.label: Token after document-initial "Local"

result.description: Fires on a token a few positions after the name "Walter" (e.g. " and", " introduced", "'", " who", digits after "Walter"). The members detect "Walter" and its following name pieces (Scott, Br). It stays silent on " and" in lists without Walter.
result.label: Token following the name Walter

result.description: Fires on "achieve"/"achieving" and the following "optimal" in goal-attainment phrasing, such as "achieve optimal results". It is silent on some "to achieve" cases in business or strategy text, so extra context matters.
result.label: achieve / achieving optimal results

result.description: Fires on the token " presentation" in food and culinary writing, especially when it repeats a recent "presentation" (e.g. "visual presentation and presentation"). It stays silent on some "presentation" tokens in other culinary phrasings, such as "art of presentation".
result.label: culinary 'presentation' token

result.description: Fires on the token after "employs" (mostly the "ys" piece of "emplo|ys", also " met", " mon", " range"), predicting the object of "employs" (a technique or method). Silent on "ys" in "analyses" or "geophysics".
result.label: Token completing "employs"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens inside or right after rare word pieces beginning with "ra" (rainfall, raingauge, rack, raiders). Peak tokens listed are inconsistent. Members mostly detect the " ra" token. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Pieces after "ra" word starts

result.description: Fires on commas (and 'and') right after a person's name in a list of philosophers, such as "Peirce, William James," in text about pragmatism. Silent on commas after common nouns or topic words like "Pragmatism,".
result.label: Comma after listed philosopher names

result.description: Fires on the preposition (' in', ' within', ' our') or the 'rained' piece right after "deeply ingrained/embedded". It needs the "deeply embedded/ingrained" construction; plain ' in' elsewhere stays silent.
result.label: preposition after deeply ingrained/embedded

result.description: Fires on the pieces of the word "milestone" (mil, est, estone) and sometimes the related "culminated", when the word is split into tokens. Silent on one "milestones" instance in a historical context. Members are mostly "mil" token detectors.
result.label: milestone word pieces

result.description: Fires on words following "atmospheric"/atmosphere context (pressure, weather, gradient, meteor-, -pher), i.e. meteorological terms after atmosphere cues. Silent on "pressure" without an atmospheric lead-in.
result.label: Atmospheric science terms after atmosphere

result.description: Fires on the word " context" as a standalone noun, often after a modifier (linguistic, situational, cultural, low context). It stays quiet when "context" is followed by a suffix or hyphen, as in "context-dependent" or "contextual". Members are mostly " context" detectors.
result.label: ' context' as noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on varied words (verbs, connectives, nouns) shortly after a phrase like "executed correctly" or "properly executed", in text about things done right. Members detect executed/properly/correctly/execution.
result.label: Words following "executed correctly"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of longer multi-piece words (pt/ure, ly, iles, ich, ics) and on ' Analysis' in title-like text. Mostly early-layer token-piece members; the pattern is mixed and not tied to one word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments and ' Analysis'

result.description: Fires mainly on a closing parenthesis ')' that ends a parenthetical, list label or formula argument, and sometimes on ' and', where the sentence continues after it. Silent on a ')' closing a date range such as (1878-1958).
result.label: Closing parenthesis before continuation

result.description: Fires on tokens inside or following "magnif-" words (magnification, magnifying) and on word pieces like ' teles' in optics text about lenses and magnification. It stays silent on ' teles' in plain telescope contexts without magnification.
result.label: magnification / optics word pieces

result.description: Fires on the verb (' is', ' are', ' was', ' be') right after the existential 'there' (there is/are no..., there is an inherent...). Members detect 'there' and its 's. It stays silent on some 'there is' cases and on non-existential 'is'.
result.label: Verb after existential 'there'

result.description: Fires on ' Material' (capitalized) at the start of a heading or topic-list item, such as "Materials Science" near document start. It stays silent when ' Material' follows a modifier like Biodegradable or Hull in a list of headings.
result.label: Capitalized ' Material' heading start

result.description: Fires on the 'ET' piece completing the acronym ARPANET (and similar network or transistor acronyms like JFET). Members detect 'ET', 'AN' and 'AR' pieces from earlier layers.
result.label: ET ending of ARPANET

result.description: Fires on the connecting word right after "knowledge" (of, about, and, in, that, from), where a complement is expected. It stays silent on "of" after other nouns such as "product", "use" or "branches".
result.label: Link word after "knowledge"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ol', 'ck', 'on' inside rare words and names (cholesterol, Ockham, Astragonus), often in text about scholars. Peaks are scattered and silent on 'ck' in ordinary words like 'peckages'.
result.label: Word fragments in rare scholarly terms

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing or following "dolphin" and other marine animal terms (dolph-ins, whale, fish, lamprey) in marine biology text. It is silent on "dolphins" in one contrast context about endangered species.
result.label: Dolphin and marine animal word pieces
Standalone word " term"/" terms"
result.description: Fires on the whole word " term" or " terms" (as a noun, or a repeated token), and not when "term" is the start of "termination". Members are mostly detectors of the token term/terms.
Fires on the word " colonial" (also " colon" in colonies/colonist, and " imperial") in academic text about colonialism and empire. Members are detectors of colon/colonial tokens.
result.label: colonial token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the ' innov' piece (innovation/innovative), and weakly on efficiency, cost, job in technology/economy text. It stays silent on some ' innov' tokens, e.g. after 'for', 'about' or 'facilitates', and the reason is unclear.
result.label: ' innov' token in innovation words

result.description: Fires mostly on " of" right after "use" at the start of a document or title about language, style or rhetoric (e.g. "the use of intensity adverbs"). It stays quiet on "use of" in mid-text sentences about other topics.
result.label: "use of" in language-topic titles

result.description: Fires mostly on " instance" in "for instance" at the start of an example-introducing phrase, with weaker hits on " those", " to" and word pieces. It is silent on "instance" in some other positions, such as mid-sentence after a comma. Members detect "for" and "example".
result.label: "for instance" example-introducer

result.description: Fires on function words (' it', ' these', ' this', commas) right after the opening word "Essentially," near the start of a text. Silent on ' it' after other introductory clauses. Members mostly detect "entially".
result.label: Words following "Essentially,"

result.description: Fires on tokens following the name "John" (e.g. "F. Kennedy", "Lenn-ard", "of Garland"), continuing a person's full name after a first name. Members detect " John" and name pieces. Silent on sentence-ending periods elsewhere.
result.label: Name continuation after "John"

result.description: Fires on the token right after a document-initial "Using" (the, these, of), i.e. the second or third token of a document opening with "Using". It stays silent on "the" after other verbs like reduce, enhance or use mid-text.
result.label: Word after document-initial "Using"

result.description: Fires on words right after a form of "exploit" (the, their, inher-, explo-, of), as in "exploits the inherent properties". It needs a preceding exploit/exploiting verb; "the" elsewhere stays silent.
result.label: Words following "exploit" verb

result.description: Fires on tokens right after the word "détente" (comma, "of", "was", "an", "sought") in text about détente/diplomacy, where the word was split into pieces. Silent on "was" elsewhere, including directly after "Détente" at sentence start.
result.label: Tokens following "détente" in diplomacy text

result.description: Fires on the word or piece right after "marked" (the/by/another/a/revers-/-fold/change), as in "marked the beginning of" or "marked by". It stays silent on some "marked the" cases, so the condition is not well pinned down.
result.label: Token following "marked"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ough' completing the word "dough" (d|ough) in baking text, mostly when the word is repeated in a passage. It stays silent on some other "dough" mentions, such as "dough layering". Weak on similar pieces like 'ish'.
result.label: 'ough' in "dough"

result.description: Fires on "named" and the following "after" in "named after [person]" eponym phrases (also "named Vilfredo", and the name piece "Batt"), in technical or scientific text. It predicts that a proper name follows.
result.label: "named after" eponym phrases

result.description: Fires on the final letter H of the acronym EMH (Efficient Market Hypothesis) and nearby tokens such as ' which' or ')' after it. Members detect 'Hypothesis' pieces and acronym fragments. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: EMH acronym ending in H

result.description: Fires on "bal" in "nonverbal" and on "communication" after "nonverbal"/"verbal", in discussions of non-verbal communication. Silent on "bal" in plain "verbal" or "verbalized", so it needs the "non-" prefix context.
result.label: nonverbal communication

result.description: Fires on the 'ing' (or 'itz') piece completing the surname "Klitzing" after "Klaus von Klitz/Kl". Stays silent on ordinary '-ing' suffixes in other words.
result.label: Klitzing surname ending 'ing'

result.description: Fires on the word right after "especially" (or "especially important/true"), such as " in", " the", " true", " useful", " when". The members detect "especially" and "particularly". The same tokens stay silent without that qualifier.
result.label: Word following "especially"

result.description: Fires on the noun " importance" (also " significance", " relev-") in academic-style text, typically after "the" and before "of". Members include token detectors for importance/significance and "emphasis" words. Silent in one "balances the importance of" case.
result.label: Importance/significance noun

result.description: Fires on the demonstrative ' this' (occasionally 'the', 'their') when it starts a noun phrase that refers back to something in the preceding text, e.g. 'seeds of this', 'In this part'. Silent on some 'this' after a semicolon or in 'this approach'.
result.label: demonstrative ' this' referring back

result.description: Fires on ' business' and on following function words or punctuation (comma, 'the', parenthesis) in text dense with business terms, near the start of a document. Silent on some ' business' tokens in other contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: business word and following tokens

result.description: Fires on the token right after "statue", "statute" or "stat-" words (e.g. "/", " and", "'", " Men" in "Statue of Menes"). Members detect stat-, statute and legislation pieces. It looks like a next-token slot after a stat- word.
result.label: Token after statue/statute words

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'estone' of "milestone" (and sometimes on ' marked' in "marked a milestone"), mostly in project or history text. Silent on unrelated contrast text. Members detect 'mil'/'estone' pieces and stage/step words.
result.label: milestone 'estone' piece

result.description: Fires on the word right after "permits"/"permitting" (e.g. from, the, may, enable, as), the next token following a form of "permit". Members detect "perm"/"-its" pieces. Silent on " the" elsewhere.
result.label: Token following "permit(s)"

result.description: Fires on 'cient' in "Ancient" (and on " An") when the word is at the very start of a document or heading, as in "Ancient Babylon". Silent on 'cient' mid-sentence, e.g. "the Ancient Assyrian".
result.label: Document-initial "Ancient" (An|cient)

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes inside "relation"-related words and some other split words (Di-agr-ams, Relations-hip, non-rel-ational), mainly when completing a multi-piece word in technical text. Members detect 'ations', 'Rel', 'hip' pieces.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of 'relationship'-type words

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 'als' (metals, integrals, orbitals, diagonals) in technical math/science text, plus occasional weak firing on function words nearby. It stays silent on 'als' in "line/double/triple integrals", so the condition is unclear.
result.label: 'als' suffix in technical plurals

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after the word "free" (freezing, free energy, free from, free market), i.e. the word or piece following or repeating "free". Members detect "free" and "freedom". Silent on "freeze" meaning to ice up.
result.label: Token following "free"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' at the end of "intellig|ent" (split word, e.g. "intelligent memory/lighting"). Silent on 'ent' in other words like "prevalent", so it depends on the preceding "intellig" piece.
result.label: 'ent' in "intelligent"

result.description: Fires on determiners like "these"/"the" (and some nouns) right after "studying" or similar verbs of study/understanding, in scientific text. Silent on "these" in other positions, so it needs the object slot of "studying".
result.label: Object determiner after "studying"

result.description: Fires on the space or the "0" digit right after "early" (e.g. "early 198", "early 2000"), where a decade or year is about to be written. It stays silent on the same "0" in other date contexts, such as "the 1930s" or "(2000)".
result.label: Year digits after "early"

result.description: Fires mainly on " either" after a modal like "can" (can either act as / serve as), occasionally on following words in either-constructions. Silent on some "either" cases, e.g. "can either stabilize or" and ", either propelling", so context matters, and the contrast does not clearly show which.
result.label: 'either' after modal verbs

result.description: Fires on the token ' Not' at the start of a document or sentence, as in "Noteworthy", "Notably", "Notwithstanding", "Not only", and "Notation". Fires on this token across these varied continuations.
result.label: Document-initial ' Not' token

result.description: Fires on tokens in or right after the word "reliability" (reli-, -ability, -ant, "requires"), tracking the word "reliab-" in context. Silent on ordinary ' and' tokens elsewhere. Members detect "reli" and "-ability/-ant" pieces.
result.label: reliability word-piece continuation

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (mostly 'ly', ' is', ' ge') appearing shortly after the repeated 'ough' / "dough" token, in a garbled, repeated "oughough" context. Members are mainly 'ough' detectors; silent on ordinary 'ly' elsewhere.
result.label: Tokens following 'ough' (dough) context

result.description: Fires on tokens in and right after the phrase "Middle Ages" or "Middle English" (the apostrophe in "Middle Age's", " English", " period", "ges"). Silent on apostrophes after other words, such as possessives after plural nouns.
result.label: Middle Ages / Middle English context

result.description: Fires on tokens following or inside the word "relevance" (the 'ance' piece, ' of', ' extends', ' is' right after "relevance"). Silent on ' of' after other nouns like continuity or aspect.
result.label: Tokens after "relevance"

result.description: Fires on pieces of "archaeology"-related words (arch, ae, ac, ological, dig, sites, record, find) in archaeology/science text. Early members detect the " arch" and "ae" pieces; stays silent on "record" in non-archaeological contexts.
result.label: Archaeology word pieces and related terms

result.description: Fires mostly on the digit '8' (also other digits, quote marks, mid-word pieces) in year-like or numeric strings, but stays silent on some '8's in other years such as 1861 or 1980. Mixed, low-consistency peaks.
result.label: Digit 8 in years (mixed)

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "exploration" (of, and, around, the) or on the "expl" piece within a repeated exploration theme. It stays quiet on "of" after other nouns such as proof, modes, role or essence.
result.label: Token following "exploration"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces or later words of multi-word technical titles/headings (e.g. "Software Requirements Spec|ification", "Configuration", "Radio|active") near the start of a document, where a word continuation or heading noun is expected.
result.label: Technical heading word pieces

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' integer', ' state', ' end', ' two', math braces) shortly after "states that" or "state" in physics/math statements of laws or theorems. Silent on ' integer' elsewhere. Members mostly detect ' state(s)'.
result.label: Tokens after "states that" theorem statements

result.description: Fires on ' recogn' (also ' appreci', ' acknowled') as a verb stem in "involves recognizing/acknowledging" style abstract prose. Silent on some ' recogn' cases in communication-skills text, so context matters, though the cause is unclear.
result.label: recogn-/acknowledge stem in abstract prose

result.description: Fires on the 's' piece that ends a decade written with digits (1940s, 1960s, 2000s), after a year-number stem. Stays silent on possessive 's, plural 's' on words, or word-initial 's'.
result.label: Decade 's' after year digits

result.description: Fires on the possessive " our" (rarely "own", "heart") after a verb or preposition in reflective, general-human prose, e.g. "sharpen our intuition", "to our tasks". It stays silent on some " our" cases, such as "shape our perceptions", and the contrast doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: possessive "our" in reflective prose

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (e.g. ' heavily', '1', "'", word pieces) shortly after the misspelled or odd name "Bayer" used in place of "Bayes/Bayesian", in statistics/ML text. Members are mostly topic and token detectors; a ' Bay' detector is the discriminative one.
result.label: Tokens following "Bayer" (Bayesian) in stats

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (cash flows, interactions, split name pieces like C-oulent, He-isenberg) in abstract, science/finance explanatory text about fundamental concepts. Peaks are scattered with low consistency; the circuit includes a 'fundamental' detector.
result.label: Fundamental-concepts science text, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on 'stein' and on pieces like 'itt', 'ag' in the split name "Witt-" (Wittig, Wittiv...), and sometimes in Wittgenstein. It is silent on 'stein' in some other names, e.g. Wittgen-stein and Ingarden-stein, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Witt- / -stein name pieces

result.description: Fires on a noun like protocol, procedures, measures, resources or training right after "safety" or similar policy words, in safety/health procedure text. It is silent on some identical "safety protocols" contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Safety-procedure nouns after 'safety'

result.description: Fires on the 'ins' piece in "origins", especially after "its" or "the" and in "tracing its origins" phrasing. It stays silent on 'ins' in other words such as "twins". Members detect 'ins' and 'originated'.
result.label: 'ins' in "origins"

result.description: Fires on name-piece tokens completing surnames of scientists in author lists, especially 'ard' in Brassard, 'ini' in Benjamini, and Bennett/Br pieces. Members detect 'Ben', 'nett' and 'ard' pieces.
result.label: Surname pieces Brassard/Benjamini/Bennett

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after the word "phenomena" (verbs like illustrate, are, include, exhibit, or a comma), carrying the subject forward. Members detect "phenomena"/"phen-omena" pieces; silent on text without that word.
result.label: Words following "phenomena"

result.description: Fires on the word right after a definitional "refers to" (e.g. "refers to the [degree]", "refers to [common]"), the first content word of the definition. Members detect "refers"/"to" tokens.
result.label: Word after "refers to"

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces like 'ic', 'ins', 'enn', 'ine' that complete a word, especially 'gastronom-ic' and 'cuis-ine' in culinary text. It stays silent on 'ic' in iconic, organic, proficiency.
result.label: Culinary word-ending pieces (gastronomic, cuisine)
'ch' in merchandise
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ch' inside the word "merchandise" (mer-ch-andise). Members mostly detect 'ch' and 'mer' pieces. Other 'ch' words like crochet appear only in members, not as target peaks.

Fires on the word "deep" / "Deep" (including repeated runs of it and "deep learning"), with case variants. Members include detectors of Deep/deep tokens plus context from neural networks and water or ocean topics.
result.label: Deep / deep token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'ynam' in thermodynamics/aerodynamics and 'cers' in producers, i.e. specific word-internal fragments. Members are detectors of these pieces ('ynam', 'cers' after 'produ').
result.label: ynam / cers word fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' metal' in both the heavy metal music sense and the chemistry/materials sense (transition metal, alkali metal, metalworking). Members are mostly detectors of ' metal' and material/chemistry words.
result.label: ' metal' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "othing" at the end of "clothing" (cl|othing). Members are mostly "othing" token detectors in early layers; the contrast has no "clothing" text.
result.label: "othing" in clothing

result.description: Fires on ' levels' after a measured quantity (pH levels, moisture levels) and on ' faith' after 'of' (leap of faith, validity of faith). Two token groups, mostly in science and religion contexts. Weaker on other nutrient/moisture levels.
result.label: ' levels' and ' faith' tokens

result.description: Fires on ' random' (randomization, random sampling, random forests) and 'ochastic' in stochastic, in statistics and sampling text. Weakly fires on ' forced'. Silent in unrelated math text such as factorization.
result.label: random / stochastic in statistics

result.description: Fires on the pieces of a split-up "multi-" word, mainly "if" in "multifaceted", also " mult" and "fac" (multilingual, multi-faceted). It needs to sit inside such a word, after "mult".
result.label: multi- word fragments (multifaceted)

result.description: Fires on the word-final piece 'ry' in "tapestry", typically in the phrase "rich tapestry of". Members detect 'ry' endings and the mosaic/tapestry-like word pieces.
result.label: 'ry' in tapestry

result.description: Fires on the verb ' explore' (and weaker on 'exploring'/'explores'), mostly in academic or tutorial text like "we explore", "let's explore", "can explore". Members are explore/expl-piece detectors.
result.label: verb 'explore' detector

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and punctuation (commas, "are", "is", "also", "as", apostrophes) in expository prose, mostly after a subject phrase. Silent on many commas after introductory phrases. Members are generic token detectors; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Commas and copulas in expository prose

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'AD' inside acronyms such as NADH, NAD+ and CAD. Members are 'AD' token detectors in early layers. Silent on other acronyms like ETC.
result.label: 'AD' piece in acronyms (NADH, CAD)

result.description: Fires on ' into' after a transformation verb (transform, turn, transformed, decomposed) marking the resulting state. Silent on ' into' after 'insight' or 'delves', where it is not a change-of-form construction.
result.label: ' into' after transform verbs

result.description: Fires on a space token that sits between numbers in a sequence or list (e.g. "12, 13, 14" or "2 + 1"), where a digit is expected next. Silent on a space after a heading marker like "### 8."
result.label: Space before next number in sequence

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside longer words, mainly "closed" in "enclosed", also "olid" in "consolidation" and "lic", "ain". Mostly en-/con- prefixed words with a split-off middle piece. Weak elsewhere.
result.label: Mid-word piece in "enclosed"/"consolidation"

result.description: Fires on ' how' when it introduces an embedded clause after a verb like determines, understanding, investigate, concerns (e.g. "determines how power flows"). Members detect ' how' itself.
result.label: ' how' after determine/understand verbs

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: ' aircraft', ' military', and 'metric' (as in symmetric/asymmetric), plus 'rical' in geometrical. Mixed word set; silent on 'symmetry' in an art context.
result.label: aircraft, military, -metric tokens

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ances' (also 'ance'/'s') ending "substances", mostly in materials science and chemistry text. It stays silent on 'ances' in "enhances", so it needs the subst- word.
result.label: 'subst-ances' suffix in materials text

result.description: Fires on the noun ' generation' (also production, release, conversion) after an energy or power term, as in "power generation" or "ATP production". It stays quiet on energy text without such a noun.
result.label: Energy/power generation noun
'oir' in 'memoir'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oir' when it completes 'memoir(s)'. It is silent on a bare 'oir' at the start of a document, with no 'mem' before it. Members include 'oir' and 'mem' detectors.

Fires on the word piece ' convers' (conversation, conversely, conversational) at the start of the word. Members are mostly ' convers' token detectors plus language and communication context. Predicts suffixes like 'ations', 'ational'.
result.label: ' convers' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rome' completing "syndrome" (synd+rome), including after invented or odd names before "Syndrome". Driven by 'rome' and 'synd' detectors in earlier layers.
result.label: 'rome' in "syndrome"

result.description: Fires on the token ' matrix', mainly in linear-algebra text after a modifier such as diagonal, invertible or orthogonal. Members are matrix/matrices detectors plus linear and diagonal detectors. Weaker on 'matrix mechanics'.
result.label: ' matrix' in linear algebra

result.description: Fires on the verb ' is' after an abstract or technical subject noun (e.g. "morality is", "semantics is", "diffusion is") in academic or scientific text. Silent on some ' is' after words like "theory" or "concept", or at the start of a text.
result.label: ' is' after abstract technical subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' tri' in the middle of a sentence (before "angle", "als") and on 'able' in "Uncountable". It stays silent when ' tri' starts the text. Members are mostly ' tri' and 'count' piece detectors.
result.label: tri- and uncount-able word pieces

result.description: Fires on the adverb " essentially" (rarely " basically"), mostly right after "is" or "considered" when a subject is being restated or summarized loosely. Members detect "essentially" and similar adverbs.
result.label: Adverb " essentially"
' situations' after modifiers like various/other
result.description: Fires on the word " situations", mostly after modifiers such as "various", "other", "varying" or "unconventional". Members detect near-synonyms like scenarios, cases, context and range. It stays silent on unrelated text.

Fires on the word " coordinates" (e.g. after Cartesian, polar, spherical) in math/geometry text. It stays quiet in a contrast passage on integrals that has no such use. Members detect "coordinate" tokens and related math terms.
result.label: " coordinates" in math/geometry

result.description: Fires on the token " uniform" (uniform continuity, uniformity, uniform convergence), mostly in mathematical or technical prose. Weak on a few other tokens like "redu" and " acting". Early-layer uniform-token detectors drive it.
result.label: ' uniform' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token 'v' (the version letter) in IPv4/IPv6 discussions, including a repeated "v" right after a sentence-ending period before a version number. Members are mostly 'v' token detectors plus an ' IP' detector.
result.label: 'v' in IPv4/IPv6 version

result.description: Fires on " structures" (also "structure") and the "matically" piece of "grammatically", mostly in linguistic/syntactic text such as "syntactic structures" or "grammatically correct". Weakly active on everyday "structures" outside linguistics.
result.label: Structures in linguistic/grammar context

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vel' inside "marvel(s)", after "mar". Members detect 'vel' and similar mid-word pieces. Weak activation on other word fragments like 'crypt' and 'ic'.
result.label: 'vel' in "marvels"

result.description: Fires mostly on ' beam' in physics text (particle/plasma beams), with weaker hits on other scattered pieces like 'P' in NPV/NP-complete, ' applied' and 'ized'. Mostly a ' beam' detector in technical contexts.
result.label: ' beam' in physics contexts

result.description: Fires on the token 'o' as a mid-word piece in rare or split words (Q-o-S, sm-o-othing, Bar-o-que, du-o). Needs the word-internal position after a preceding piece such as Q, sm, Bar or du.
result.label: Word-internal 'o' piece

result.description: Fires on the prefix token ' sub' at the start of a word being split (subtraction, subduction, suburban, subproblems), predicting continuations like 'urban', 'plan', 'reference'. Weakly on ' neural' and ' urban'. Silent in 'subtext'.
result.label: ' sub' word-prefix token
'ility' suffix in fertility
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ility' completing a word, mostly "fert|ility" in soil and agriculture text, and also "mob|ility". It relies on earlier pieces such as 'fert' and 'il' being present.

Fires mainly on the ending piece 'ule' in "molecule", and also on ' Lewis' (Lewis base/theory) and a few word-piece endings in chemistry and science text. Members detect molecule pieces, Lewis, and chemistry words.
result.label: molecule 'ule' / Lewis in chemistry
'ise' suffix in merchandise
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ise' completing "merchandise" (all 64 peaks), mostly in music/fan merchandise and marketing text. Members are mostly 'ise' token detectors in early layers.

Fires on word-ending pieces like 'ations' in "Differential Equations" and 'ya' in "Pólya" within mathematical/technical terms. Silent on 'ations' in ordinary words like innovations, foundations, permutations.
result.label: Math term suffix: Equations, Pólya

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (and 'ytics') completing words like "Visualization" and "Analytics", mostly in data/analytics headings. It stays silent on 'ization' in "personalization" and "Optimization", so it seems to depend on the word being completed.
result.label: visualization / analytics suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ynast' in "Dynasty" (e.g. Shang Dynasty), and occasionally on 'bes' in "Hobbes". Early-layer detector of these specific word pieces, driven by members that peak on 'ynast'.
result.label: 'ynast' in Dynasty

result.description: Fires on the suffix token 'ants', most strongly in 'consonants' (also 'discriminants', 'Giants'), in linguistics/phonetics text. Occasionally fires on other word pieces like 'ple' in 'droplets'. Members detect 'ants' and linguistic/sound context.
result.label: 'ants' ending, as in consonants

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ibr' inside words like vibrational, vibrations, vibrant and fibrations. Members are detectors of 'ibr' (and similar pieces like 'acc' in vaccine, 'ow' in vowels) at the token itself.
result.label: 'ibr' word piece (vibration)

result.description: Fires on past-tense verb suffixes (-ized, -ited, -ated, -ored) completing a word in colonial/colonization text, especially "colonized". Silent on "-ized" in other words like "characterized" or "revolutionized" outside colonial context.
result.label: -ized suffix in colonial text

result.description: Fires on the second 'r' token in "irrational" (ir|r|ational), mostly in math text about rational and irrational numbers. Weaker firing on mid-word pieces of other long words (hyperbolic, phrasing).
result.label: 'r' inside "irrational"

result.description: Fires on the ending of abstract nouns, such as "interpretation", "calculation", "division" and the "-imation" piece of "Underestimation". It often follows "and" in technical or academic text. The peaks are mixed and the logits are unclear.
result.label: Abstract process-noun endings in technical text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'liance' completing "compliance" (comp+liance), in regulatory and audit text. Silent when 'liance' starts a document without the preceding 'comp'.
result.label: 'liance' in compliance

result.description: Fires on verbs of comprehension like " understand" and " interpret" (also see/seeing), mostly right after infinitive "to" in purpose clauses ("to understand", "to interpret"). Silent on unrelated contexts.
result.label: "to understand/interpret" verbs

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer multi-piece words, most often 'bi' in 'ubiquitous', also 'our', 'ic', 'actor', 'bear'. Members are detectors of word pieces (pr, ran, ic, ing, bi) inside split words.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on the word " smart" (as in smart appliances, smart homes, smart grid), occasionally on "Good" at a document start. Members include several " smart" token detectors plus technology and energy context features.
result.label: " smart" in tech contexts

result.description: Fires on the second piece 'act' or 'point' when it completes a word beginning with 'counter' (counterpoint, counteract, counteracting). Members detect 'point'/'act' pieces and the 'counter' prefix.
result.label: counter- word completion (act/point)

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces ('er', 'ant', 'ated', 'ates') in technical or statistical words like confounder, correlated, determinant, often mid-word. Also fires weakly on ' agents' and ' parties'. Mixed suffix pieces with statistics/science flavor.
result.label: Suffix pieces in technical words

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces 'iance' and 'ivity' (ambiance, brilliance, variance, subjectivity, resistivity), mostly after a word stem split into pieces. Members are detectors of these suffixes and of other split-word pieces.
result.label: -iance / -ivity suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' aber' at the start of "aberration/aberrations", mostly in optics contexts such as chromatic or spherical aberration. It is silent on other text. The next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: ' aber' in aberration

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' of verbs like review-ing, assess-ing, evaluat-ing, forecast-ing, in business/analysis text about reviewing or assessing. It stays silent on 'ing' in nouns like positioning, modeling, banking.
result.label: 'ing' of review/assess verbs

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece "metric" completing "asymmetric" (asymmetric encryption/key), with weaker firing on "or" in "either/or" and a few other word pieces. Members detect "metric"/"met"/"asym" pieces.
result.label: asym-metric word piece

result.description: Fires on the prefix piece " mis" (also "fr", " fal") at the start of a word, as in misinterpretation, miscommunication, misleading. Predicts a word-continuation piece such as "hire", "scribe" or "quire".
result.label: mis- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' in the middle of the word "anomalies" (anom|al|ies). It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "identical" or "reveal", so it needs that specific word.
result.label: 'al' inside "anomalies"

result.description: Fires on the standalone capital letter ' C' (variable, language name, or abbreviation like C++, C#, CAM, or a name starting with C). Members are mostly detectors of ' C' and other capital letter tokens.
result.label: Capital letter ' C' token
'pt' inside 'elliptical'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pt' in 'elli|pt|ical' (elliptical polarization, elliptical orbits). Weakly fires on similar mid-word pieces like 'urt' and 'xt'. Members detect 'pt'/'elli'/'ps' pieces from sculpture and ellipsoid words.

Fires on the word-start piece " sym" (or " Sym"), mostly in "symplectic" and also "Symphony". It is split off as a prefix before the rest of the word. Upstream members are detectors of sym/syn-like word starts.
result.label: " sym" word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after "serve/serves/serving" (function-role sense, "serves as X"). It stays silent on 'as' in "seen as", "known as", "such as". Members detect ' as' and 'serving'.
result.label: 'as' after serve (serves as)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ile' inside words like "dilemma" (d-ile-mma) and "textile", and on ' w' as the start of split words like "wizards" or "widespread". It is a mid-word fragment detector.
result.label: Mid-word 'ile' fragment in dilemma

result.description: Fires on ' countries' (also ' nations', ' conduct', weaker ' languages') as the object of "among/across/between/in", in comparative discussion of countries or languages. Silent on generic cross-cultural text without such a plural noun.
result.label: countries/nations after among/across

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " conclusion" in logic and argument text (premises and conclusion, terms of the conclusion). Occasionally fires on "AN" in VLAN. It stays silent on the plural "conclusions".
result.label: ' conclusion' in logic contexts

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' Dis' (also ' Ph', ' Pr', ' Ex') in title-like text, where the word is incomplete and a continuation such as "aster" or "parity" is needed. Mostly ' Dis' after a capitalized name or modifier.
result.label: Dis- word-start fragment in titles

result.description: Fires on ' they' as the subject of a new clause, usually after a conjunction or comma (but they, and they, as they). Silent when 'they' starts a text or follows 'how' in an embedded question.
result.label: clause-subject ' they' after conjunction

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' comfort' and ' sens' (before -ation, -ors), mostly in texts on touch, sensors and emotion. Predicts word-completing suffixes. Silent on the non-verbal communication contrast text.
result.label: ' comfort' / ' sens' word stems

result.description: Fires on the "-asing"/"-ased" ending of "showcasing"/"showcased" (the suffix piece after "showc"). Weaker on related pieces like "illustrating" and "showcase". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: showcasing suffix -asing

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece "oun" in "pronoun"/"noun" in grammar-lesson text, and on " language" after "body". Weaker on a few other word pieces like "ation" in "inflation".
result.label: "oun" in pronoun/noun; body language

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' after a verb, conjunction or preposition, where a noun phrase begins, in explanatory or technical text (math, science). Members are mostly ' a' detectors. The contrast text has no ' a'.
result.label: Article ' a' in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token " errors" (mostly as a plural noun in technical or scientific text about error types, e.g. syntax errors, systematic errors). It is supported by upstream "errors" detectors and error-correction code members.
result.label: " errors" token detector

result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles 'a' and 'an', mostly when they are quoted or discussed as words (e.g. "'a' and 'an'", "'a parliament'"), not in ordinary running use. It is weaker on 'the' in quotes.
result.label: Quoted articles 'a' / 'an'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "isions" (as in decisions, collisions) and on "back" in "Feedback", plus occasionally "decision" in "decision-making". Mostly a detector of these specific word endings or pieces.
result.label: isions / Feedback word pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece "or" when it ends or sits inside a word (conductor, donor, Rigor, fluoric, Cantor, Caloric), not on the standalone conjunction (as in "and/or").
result.label: "or" as word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the word "natural" and its pieces (natural, atural, non-natural, semi-natural, -etic as in synthetic), mostly in materials or biology contexts. Weak elsewhere (e.g. "natural language"). Members are mostly detectors of "natural".
result.label: "natural" token and fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' mo' (moisture), ' precip' (precipitation), ' micro', ' temper' in climate/environmental science text, where the word is completed by the next piece.
result.label: Climate word fragments: mo-, precip-

result.description: Fires on ' different' (also ' various', ' distinct') as a plural-noun-modifying adjective after a verb or preposition, as in "use different tools" or "across different regions". It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' different' / ' various' modifier

result.description: Fires on the relative pronoun " who", strongest right after "those" (those who earned less). It stays silent on "who" after concrete nouns like "individuals who" or "problem-solvers who", and in "see who".
result.label: "those who" relative pronoun

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ers' (also 'ry', 'res', 'ce') completing the word "fibers" after "fib". It stays silent on 'ers' in agent nouns like retailers, designers and volunteers.
result.label: "fib|ers" word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ilo' in soliloquy, 'ori' in Montessori, and 'o' in flamenco or Iroquoian. These are word pieces in rarer, multi-token words, mostly near word endings.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in rare words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ash" in "dishwashers/dishwashing", where the model has split the word as dish-w-ash. Weak on a few other mid-word pieces. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "ash" piece in dishwash-

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' tar' when it begins "tariff(s)", in trade and tariff text. Predicts the continuation "iff". Members include detectors of 'tar' and 'iffs' plus law and trade-related tokens.
result.label: ' tar' as start of tariff

result.description: Fires on the token ' solid' (solid state, solidification, solid-liquid) in physical-science and materials text. Early-layer members are mostly ' solid' token detectors, plus some generic material/property features.
result.label: ' solid' token detector

result.description: Fires on the digit '6' as the third digit of a four-digit year in the 1600s (e.g. 1611, 1623, 1616). It stays silent on '6' in other year positions such as 1764, 1960s or 1996.
result.label: '6' in 1600s years

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside names of famous physicists/scientists, mainly 'win' in Erwin, ' Ein' and 'stein' in Einstein, also weakly 'He' in Heidegger. Appears in science-history name lists.
result.label: Einstein/Erwin name pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' intermediate' in technical text (intermediate states, species, layers, representation). Silent on 'intermediates' in the contrast, so it needs the word itself. Members are mostly ' intermediate' detectors plus stage/step and chemistry context.
result.label: ' intermediate' token detector
' expand' and Krebs 'bs'
result.description: Fires on ' expand' (expanding/expanded) and on 'bs' in "Krebs Cycle". Two unrelated tokens share the latent. Members include Kre- and bs-detectors plus an expand detector.

result.label: Digit '2' in 1920s years
result.description: Fires on the digit '2' as the third digit of a 20th-century year, like 19[2]2 or 19[2]7. It stays silent on '2' in 18xx years and in '20th century'.

Fires on word-ending pieces 'es' (mainly in "microscopes") and 'itive/itors' in "competitive/competitors", after the micro-/scop- or compet- stems. Silent on 'es' in other words like "businesses" or "hinges".
result.label: microscop-es / compet-itive endings

result.description: Fires on the token " sum" as a noun in mathematical text, such as "the sum of", "direct sum" and "vector sum". Members are mostly detectors of " sum". Weak activation on some document-start or paragraph-break tokens.
result.label: ' sum' token detector
'lic' in "implicature"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lic' inside "implicature" (imp-lic-ature), in linguistics and pragmatics text. It stays silent when 'lic' starts the text without the "imp" before it. Weak activation on 'rag' in "pragmatic".

Fires on the word "computer" / "Computer" (also "Comput-"), in computing and computer-science text such as "computer science", "Computer Architecture", "your computer". Silent on other tech text like 3D rendering.
result.label: computer token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " potential" in electrochemistry text, especially after "cell", "half-cell" or "electrode" (cell potentials, electrode potentials). It is weaker for the general sense, as in "maximize their potential".
result.label: electrochemical " potential"

result.description: Fires on "assess" / "-ment" in "risk assessment" and related risk-analysis terms (identification, "ks"), in risk-management text. It stays silent on "ment" in other words like commitment or adjustment.
result.label: risk assessment word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'cent' when it is the middle piece of "incentive(s)" (in|cent|ive). It stays silent on 'cent' in "reminiscent", so it needs the "in" prefix.
result.label: 'cent' inside "incentive"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece ' ju' in "juxtapose/juxtaposition", and also on the hyphen in "well-" compounds and 'ained' in "maintained". It stays silent on the related word "contrast". Several members detect ' ju'.
result.label: ju- of juxtapose, well- hyphen

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' in "cardinality" and on ' infinite' in set-theory/infinity discussions. It stays silent on 'ity' in "continuity", so it depends on the word and the math context.
result.label: cardinality / infinite in set theory

result.description: Fires on "early", "earliest" and "first" meaning early in a period or process, usually after "the" ("the early universe", "the early Miocene", "in the early stages"). Members detect early/initial/stage words.
result.label: "early" as period/stage modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'so' inside "crossover" (genetic algorithm crossover), and more weakly on 'tr' pieces in the middle of words. Members detect 'so' and 'tr' fragments in early layers.
result.label: 'so' in "crossover"

result.description: Fires on word pieces in scientific terms, mainly 'atom' in anatomy and 'etic' in genetic/geodetic, plus occasionally ' coefficient'. Depends on the preceding word piece forming the particular word.
result.label: atom/etic word-piece in science terms
'ving' word-piece ending (evolving, carving)
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ving' ending a split word, most strongly in "ever-evolving" and also "carving" and "improving". Members detect 'ving' and other -ing endings. The weaker contexts are 'ancing' and 'changing'.

Fires on the word-start piece " cogn" (as in cognitive, cognition, cognates), most strongly after "and" in academic text. Members are mostly detectors of " cogn" itself plus related cognitive/mental word pieces.
result.label: ' cogn' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' for' directly after a noun or name, introducing its purpose or target (e.g. "NUnit for .NET", "Respect for"). Stays silent on 'for' as a prefix (foreseeing) and in clausal or "important for X to" uses.
result.label: ' for' after a noun or name

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' eng' (as in engage, engagement, engaging) before the rest of the word. Members are mostly ' eng' and 'agement' token detectors from layer 0. Weakly fires on other word-start pieces like ' rev' or ' emot'.
result.label: ' eng' word-start piece (engage)

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ics' in "Thermodynamics", especially after "Law of", and more weakly on ' law' in named physical laws (Ideal Gas Law). It stays silent on 'ics' in mechanics, kinetics and economics.
result.label: Thermodynamics 'ics' / physical law

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' inside a year, mainly as the second digit after '2' (2016, 2013, 2003, 2000s). It stays silent on '0' later in the year, such as 1980, 1990 or 2020. Also fires weakly on ' concentration'.
result.label: Zero in 2-0-xx years

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' emb' when it begins a longer word such as embroidery, embellishments or embryo. It stays silent on 'embraced', where the piece forms a different word. Early members are mostly ' emb' detectors.
result.label: ' emb' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' as' in comparative "as ADJ as" constructions, especially the first/second as after "can be/seem/being" (e.g. "as thrilling as"). Silent on "such as" examples.
result.label: ' as' in comparative "as…as"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer abstract or scientific words, mainly ' simultane' (relativity of simultaneity), also ' inher', ' contra', ' inner'. Predicts a suffix continuation such as 'ous'. Also weakly fires on garbled or odd-character tokens.
result.label: Incomplete word stems like simultane-
'ings' and ' looking' token pieces
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ings' (especially in "recordings", "matchings") and on " looking"/" looks", with weaker firing on other word pieces like 'orb' and 'inn'. Fires on a few specific token forms rather than on one meaning.

result.label: ' time' as modifier noun
result.description: Fires on the word ' time' (or ' Time') when it follows a modifier and acts as a compound-noun head, as in "logarithmic time", "solar time", "time zone". It predicts compound continuations like frame, series, or zone.

Fires on a colon after a short label or item in list-like text (word-class lists, language lists, schedule times like 5:45, "Who: whiz"), where a definition or value follows. Silent on ordinary scientific prose without such colons.
result.label: Colon after list label or time

result.description: Fires on the word piece "inction" completing "extinction" (e.g. "mass extinction", "Permian-Triassic extinction event"). It depends on the preceding "ext" piece; members detect "ext" and extinction-related ecology context.
result.label: "inction" in "extinction"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ability' completing a word, most strongly in "avail-ability" (availability engineering, reliability contexts). Weaker on usability or accessibility. Silent in "interoperability", so it depends on the word being formed.
result.label: 'ability' suffix in availability

result.description: Fires on the verb ' convey' in mid-sentence, typically after "to" or a modal, as in "to convey emotions". It stays silent when ' convey' is the first token of the text.
result.label: ' convey' verb mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: 'le' in "Role", ' entire', 'atus' in "apparatus", 'ers', and ' overall'. Often mid-word pieces or whole/entirety words; no single shared context is clear.
result.label: Mixed: Role, entire, apparatus pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " other" in lists or comparisons, mostly after "and" or "or" ("and other related activities", "or other factors"). Weakly fires on " another". Members are mostly detectors of " other".
result.label: " other" after and/or in lists

result.description: Fires on the word " personal" (as in personal space, personal life, personal experience), mostly in workplace and communication text. Members are mainly detectors of " personal" and its variants like personalized.
result.label: ' personal' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ois" in the name Lavoisier (Lav|ois|ier), after "Lav". Upstream members detect "Lav" and "ois" pieces. Weak activation on a few other word pieces like "ase".
result.label: "ois" in Lavoisier

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ing, -ive, -or, -ors) completing the word "predict" (predicting, predictive, predictor). Silent on -ing after other stems like model-, collect-. Upstream members detect the "predict" stem and its suffix.
result.label: Suffix after "predict" stem

result.description: Fires on ' are' in the existential construction "there are", right after "there". It stays silent on ' are' following an ordinary plural subject (e.g. "virtues are") or at the start of a text.
result.label: ' are' in "there are"

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also '-' or ' and') right after the word "type(s)" (e.g. "types of", "type-"), and weakly after "set of". Silent on ' of' after other nouns like use, array, behavior.
result.label: "of" after "type(s)"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "agement" completing "engagement" (split as eng+agement), and weakly on "age" in "engage". Needs the preceding "eng" piece; members detect eng+agement/age pieces.
result.label: "agement" in "engagement"

result.description: Fires on the word " eager" (including before "-ly"), as in "eager to" or "eagerly waiting". Weak activation on " still", " willing" and " able". Members include detectors for eager, wanting, seeking.
result.label: ' eager' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verbs " begins" and " starts" when a subject noun (a process or stage) is said to begin, typically before "with" or "to". Silent when " begins" opens the text with no subject before it.
result.label: Process 'begins/starts' verb after subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece " attend" (as in attendance, attend a concert), mostly in event, festival and venue contexts. It is driven by festival and "-ance" detectors. Silent on nearby text about footfall and parking without the word.
result.label: ' attend' in event attendance

result.description: Fires on the word right after "includes"/"include" (activities, including, topics, having), where a list of items begins. Members detect "include(s)" and list-like words such as range, items. Silent on " including" after a comma.
result.label: Word following "includes" list opener

result.description: Fires on scattered, unrelated tokens (ū, www, Philip, Cyrillic or Arabic pieces, function words), often mid-word or in multilingual text. No coherent meaning; the members are mostly token-piece detectors, and the logits are weak.
result.label: Scattered mixed-token early-layer latent

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix 'ened' after a stem, especially in "heightened" (also "deepened"). Weaker on ' coll', ' bra', and 'enhance'-type pieces. Members are 'ened' detectors, mostly in "heightened".
result.label: 'ened' suffix in heightened

result.description: Fires on the word piece " pres" (preservation, preservative, prescriptive) and also on " try"/" trying" and "end". Mostly early-layer token detectors for "pres" feed it; the logits are a mixed set of sacrifice-related tokens.
result.label: " pres" word-start piece, try

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in title-like headings, mainly 'iffer' in "Differential Equations" and 'ender' in "Gender and X". It seems to work on the first piece of a heading word, with the rest of the word still to come.
result.label: Heading word pieces: Gender, Differential

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ute' in "flute", 'utes', and 'мо' inside garbled Cyrillic text. It is strongest on 'ute'/'uct' pieces after 'fl'. It is silent when 'utes' starts a word or sentence.
result.label: 'ute' piece inside words (flute)

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ys' ending of "valleys" (plural of valley) in geography text, with weaker hits on ' Sur', ' ref' and 'war'. Silent on 'ys' in other words like "journeys" or "adshockeys". Members include valley and 'ys' detectors.
result.label: 'ys' in "valleys"
' kn' word-start piece (knot)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' kn' at the start of words like knot, knotted, knives, knighted. Strongest in knot-theory text. It is silent on ' kn' at the start of a document (knife). Members are early-layer ' kn' detectors.
Fires on the piece 'ological' when it completes the word "biological" (after "bi"), as in "biological systems/data". It stays silent on 'ological' in other words like epidemiological.
result.label: 'ological' in "biological"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly " rough" (roughness, roughened), also "m" in dismantlement or Pragmatic, and " Catal" in Catalan. The next token is expected to complete the word.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (rough, m, Catal)

result.description: Fires on ' to' as an infinitive marker of purpose or function, often after a noun or verb in scientific or biological text (e.g. "proteins to translate", "rush to relay"). It stays silent on prepositional 'to' after verbs like "contributed to" or "belonging to".
result.label: Infinitive 'to' of purpose

result.description: Fires on degree/level adjectives like "high", "upper", "low", "lower" before a measured quantity (pressure, voltage, unemployment, bounds). Members detect high/higher tokens and level-related words.
result.label: High/low level modifiers

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare, multi-token words, mostly 'ff' or 'dor' in "Hausdorff" (math topology text) and 'emon' (as in "ceremon-"). Members are mostly word-piece detectors, not a single meaning.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: Hausdorff, emon

result.description: Fires on the token ' design' as a noun, mostly after "the" or in technical/engineering text (the design phase, design elements). Silent in the one contrast example, where it follows a hyphenated modifier ("-based design principles").
result.label: ' design' noun in engineering text

result.description: Fires on the token ' such' when it follows a noun or noun phrase and sets up an example list ("such as"), e.g. "factors such as". Members are mostly ' such' detectors that boost ' as'.
result.label: ' such' introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the piece "anning" in "spanning" (e.g. "spanning tree"), after the "sp" piece. It stays silent on "anning" in "Planning", so it needs the sp- word start.
result.label: "anning" in "spanning"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "anning" in "spanning" (spanning tree), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like " arc", "fect", " travers", "anging". Needs a preceding "sp"-like prefix, mostly in graph theory text.
result.label: "anning" in spanning tree

result.description: Fires mostly on " angles" in geometry text, after a modifier like "complementary" or "vertical". It stays silent when "angles" starts the text or sits in other contexts. Minor peaks on "ized", "intellect" and "exper".
result.label: ' angles' after geometry modifier

result.description: Fires on the 'ch' token piece, strongest in "crochet"/"crocheting" (cro|ch|et), and weakly in other words like merchandise or Epoch. It stays silent on 'ch' in "ever-changing".
result.label: 'ch' piece in crochet

result.description: Fires on the word " theory" right after a field name, mainly "music theory" and "color theory". Members detect "theory"/"Theory" tokens plus music and art context. Weaker on "music notation".
result.label: "theory" after music/color

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' ending "Layering" in the heading "Dough Layering", where the stem is "Layer". It stays silent on 'ing' in other words such as Cook-ing, mimick-ing and master-ing. Weak activation on ' surv' and 'cies'.
result.label: 'ing' completing "Layering"

result.description: Fires on the word "model"/"models" as a standalone noun (e.g. "dynamic models", "static models"). It stays silent when "model" is the start of "modeling". Members mostly detect "model" tokens and neighbouring modeling or ML vocabulary.
result.label: word "model/models" as noun

result.description: Fires on " thinking" right after "critical" in educational/philosophical text. It stays silent on "creative thinking" and "innovative thinking", so it needs the "critical" context. Members detect thinking/reasoning words and philosophy terms.
result.label: "thinking" after "critical"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'bo' inside 'carbohydrate' (after 'car'), and on 'writ' in 'songwriters'. It stays silent when 'bo' starts the text or follows a period with no 'car' before it.
result.label: 'bo' in car-bo-hydrate

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ics' completing "kinetics" (reaction kinetics). It stays silent on 'ics' in other field names such as Mathematics, Thermodynamics and Electrodynamics, so it needs the 'kinet' piece before it.
result.label: 'ics' in "kinetics"

result.description: Fires on ' specific' (and ' particular') as a modifier, plus 'ot' in 'Robot'/'Robotics'. Members detect 'specific', 'special', 'certain', and 'Rob'. Mixed trigger; fires on these tokens without a clear extra condition.
result.label: 'specific' modifier and Robot 'ot'

result.description: Fires on the token ' frames' (plural), mostly after a modifier like global, local, time or reference, as in reference frames. Members include detectors of ' frame' and ' frames'. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' frames' token detector
'ary' ending of vocabulary
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ary' completing "vocabulary" (also 'scop' in microscopes). Silent on 'ary' in other words like planetary or evolutionary. Members are 'ary' and 'vocab' piece detectors.

Fires on a few different noun endings, mostly 'ism' in "activism" and ' sessions' after "Q&A"/"webinar"/"breakout". It stays silent on 'ism' in words like colonism, nationalism and bilingualism, so it needs the specific word.
result.label: 'ism' in activism; ' sessions'
' energy' after 'internal'
result.description: Fires on the token ' energy' when it directly follows "internal" (internal energy, thermodynamics context). It stays silent on ' energy' after words like "the", "all" or "for", so the preceding word matters.
Fires on the piece 'os' inside the word "erosion" (er|os|ion), mostly in soil and water erosion text. It stays silent on 'os' as a standalone token or in "pathos".
result.label: 'os' in "erosion"

result.description: Fires on the 'stal' piece in 'crystal' / 'crystallography' (mid-word after 'cry'), with a few weaker hits on ' month' in 'monthly'. Members detect 'stal' and 'cry' pieces.
result.label: 'stal' in crystal words

result.description: Fires on "export" and the "ing" in "exporting" (also "exports") in trade-balance text about exports versus imports. It stays silent on "ing" in other words like "exceeding" or "sloping".
result.label: export / exporting in trade text

result.description: Fires on the token " Direct" (also " direct") as a word or word start, such as "Directed Graphs" and "Directive". It is weaker on "to direct". It stays silent on related words like "direction" and "undirected" in the contrast.
result.label: "Direct" word token
Development token in headings
result.description: Fires on the word "Development" (or "development") as the final word of a noun phrase or heading, such as "Software Development" or "Agricultural Development". Weaker on lowercase "the development of". It is silent on other heading words like "Policy".
Fires on the token "is" when it is a word piece inside a longer word (cis, sisal, Gelisols, Landis, debris) or the quoted Python keyword. Silent on "is" as a normal verb.
result.label: "is" as word piece

result.description: Fires mainly on 'lock' completing "deadlock" (computing/concurrency text), with weaker peaks on other word-piece endings like 'toire' and 'art' in Mozart. Mostly a within-word detector for 'lock' after 'dead'.
result.label: deadlock 'lock' word piece

result.description: Fires on the capitalized nouns ' Code' and ' Law' ending title-like headings or list items (e.g. "International Trade Law", "Code Review"), plus some suffix pieces like 'ation'. Silent on similar "Policy" headings.
result.label: Code / Law in headings

result.description: Fires on the "ed" ending of "witnessed" when a period or era is the subject ("the period also witnessed the rise of..."). Stays silent on "ed" in other verbs like thrived or reacted.
result.label: "witnessed" with era as subject

result.description: Fires on 'ova' in supernova and on ' star' in astrophysics text about massive stars and stellar evolution. Members detect 'ova', 'star' and stellar/cosmic words. Silent on a nucleosynthesis passage without those tokens.
result.label: supernova 'ova' and 'star' in astrophysics

result.description: Fires on ' of' in a few specific positions: after a demonstrative "those" (those of A), after "made", or after a technical noun like "sine" or "product". It stays silent on ' of' after many abstract nouns such as "significance" or "protector".
result.label: ' of' after those / technical nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'se' completing "immerse" (also 'ers' in "immersive"), mostly in "immerse yourself". Silent on other 'se' pieces such as in "Morse" contexts.
result.label: 'se' in "immerse"

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'ogy' (mostly in "Ecology"), also 'ios' in symbiosis and 'ples', in ecology/science-style text. Members detect 'col' and 'ogy' pieces plus ecology/habitat topic words.
result.label: Ecology word-ending 'ogy' suffix

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'inu' (in "continuous"/"continuum") and 'gru' (in "congruent"), plus weakly ' ambigu' in "ambiguity". These are mid-word fragments of specific words; the members are detectors of those pieces.
result.label: inu / gru mid-word fragments
