result.label: ' br' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on nouns like stories, tales, characters, struggles in discussions of storytelling and fiction (authors, characters, narratives). It pushes toward story-related continuations such as ' stories', ' insp', ' reson'. Silent on non-literary text.
result.label: Story/tale nouns in literary discussion

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside the word "viscosity" (vis-c, vis-co, -ity) in fluid-mechanics text, and weakly on other physics word fragments. Silent on -ity in words like "proportionality" or "centrality".
result.label: Pieces of "viscosity" in fluid text

result.description: Fires on the token "in" when it is the piece right after "mar" inside "marinating/marinade" words. It stays silent on "in" in other words or at word starts, and weakly fires on other "mar-" pieces.
result.label: "in" inside "mar-in-ating"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "reduc-" words (redu-ction, decre-asing, redu-cing), mainly in oxidation-reduction chemistry. It stays silent on "ction" in "extraction", so it needs the reduction/decrease word, not just the ending.
result.label: Reduction word endings (redox)

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' numer' (numeral, numeration, Roman numerals), especially after Arabic/Roman/Indian in text about number systems. Weak firing on 'math' and 'highlights'. Members are mostly ' numer' detectors.
result.label: ' numer' in numeral words

result.description: Fires on the period inside a decimal or section number (1.6, 2.1.2, 1.10), between digits. It stays silent on sentence-ending periods after names or words.
result.label: Period inside numbers

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "bil-" words such as bil|ine|ar, bil|ateral, bil|ing|ual (mostly 'ine', 'al', ' bil'). Silent on 'al' in other words like oral, functional, skeletal. Members detect 'bil' and 'ater'.
result.label: Pieces of "bilinear/bilateral" words

result.description: Fires on word pieces after "rel" (rel-ent-less, rel-ates, rel-ational) and on " he" in "heating" after rapid/contact. Silent on 'ent' in other words like intelligent, unrelenting, prevalent.
result.label: Word piece after "rel" (relentless, relates)

result.description: Fires on the middle of a multi-piece term like "Term" in "Long Short-Term Memory", and on "mem"/"Memory" pieces. Also weakly on other mid-word fragments. Seems to predict a continuing word piece.
result.label: Term/Memory in Long Short-Term Memory

result.description: Fires mainly on " animal" (also "life" in wildlife, "sampling") as a modifier or noun in environmental/biology-type text, with animal-detector members upstream. Weaker hits on scattered other tokens; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: animal / wildlife word detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ersion' (in "dispersion"), also 'ans', 'anc' (advancements), 'ro'. Strongest on 'ersion' after "disp"; the contrast is a different word with no such piece.
result.label: 'ersion' in dispersion, word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' e' when it begins "ecosystem" or "ecological" (the following 'cos'/'colog' piece is predicted), mostly in ecology or biology text. It is silent on 'e' at document start.
result.label: ' e' starting ecosystem/ecology

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of academic words, mainly 'soci' (dissociation, sociologist) and 'ologist' in psychologist/sociologist, with weaker firing on ' electron' and 'cian'. Predicts word-completing suffixes such as 'ologist'.
result.label: soci- / -ologist word pieces
Statist- / statistical word piece
result.description: Fires on ' Statist' (start of "Statistical") and ' statistical'/'statist' pieces, mostly in statistical mechanics or statistics text. Members are mainly detectors of statistics-related tokens. Weak activation on 'regression'.
Fires on the word piece "ature" completing "curvature" (curv|ature), mostly in math/geometry text on surfaces and tensors. It is silent on other geometry text without that word piece.
result.label: "ature" in curvature

result.description: Fires on 'able' or '-' suffix/joiner directly after the word "action" (actionable, action-value, action-reaction). Silent on 'able' in other words like inexorable or comparable.
result.label: 'able' or '-' after "action"

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "life" in compounds like life-saving, life-preserving, life-support, life-world. Other hyphens (bridge-, blue-, cost-, resource-) leave it silent, so it needs the preceding word "life".
result.label: Hyphen after "life"

result.description: Fires on ' Dr' at the start of a line in a list of names (e.g. "¶ Dr. Smith"), right after a document start or line break. Silent on ' Dr' in other positions, such as inside names like Jean Drèze.
result.label: Line-initial ' Dr' in name lists

result.description: Fires on the word-final piece 've' completing "conducive" (as in "conducive to"), with weaker firing on a few other word pieces like 'il' and 'ward'. It stays silent on 've' in "conveying".
result.label: 've' ending "conducive"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ments' completing "treat|ments" (medical treatments). It stays silent on 'ments' in "develop|ments", so it needs the preceding 'treat' stem. It weakly fires on similar endings like "treat|ies".
result.label: 'ments' after treat- stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' in the middle of a word, especially 'Se|qu|ences' (also earth|qu|ake, ade|qu|ately). Weak or silent on 'qu' in 'qubits'.
result.label: 'qu' inside Sequences

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "gress" inside "aggressive", and weakly on other mid-word pieces like "iv" in "pivotal" or "progressivism". It needs the word-internal position after a prefix such as "ag".
result.label: "gress" in "aggressive"

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ic' completing the word "mosaic" (also 'malleability'). It is silent on 'ic' in other words like Islamic or prehistoric, so it needs the 'mosa' prefix.
result.label: 'ic' ending "mosaic"

result.description: Fires on the piece "archy" completing "monarchy" (political-system text), with weaker firing on "rule", "fundamental", "principle". Silent on "monarch" without the "-archy" piece. Members detect "mon-" prefixes and "archy".
result.label: 'archy' in monarchy

result.description: Fires on the token ' ocean' (and 'ocean' in 'oceanography') and on the piece 'il' inside words like 'soil', 'fossil', 'multilanguage'. Two token detectors share one latent; the contrast text with 'oceans' stays silent.
result.label: ' ocean' and 'il' word pieces
Small number words (two, four)
result.description: Fires on small cardinal number words, mainly " two" and " four" (also three), often after "into" or "to" and before a hyphenated compound like "three-carbon" or "two-dimensional". Members are number-token detectors.

result.label: ' ur' word-start piece (urgent)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ur' at the start of a split word, mainly 'urgent' (also urgency, urine), especially in the Eisenhower-matrix 'neither urgent nor important' text. Members are mostly ' ur' token detectors.
Fires on the token ' quality', mainly as a head noun in "the quality of X" or "tonal/statistical quality". It stays silent after "product" and at the start of a text.
result.label: ' quality' as head noun

result.description: Fires on the token ' fan' (as in fan engagement, fan culture, fan communities), usually as a modifier right before a noun like base, community or involvement. Predicts nouns like norm, values, appreciation.
result.label: ' fan' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on ' power' right after "the" in "the power of ..." (harness the power, the power of words). It stays silent on 'power' in compounds or after modifiers like "solar power" and "interpersonal power".
result.label: "the power" after determiner
Suffix after "culmin" (culminate/culmination)
result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces -ate/-ation/-ated/-ates completing "culmin-" (culminate in, culmination of). Stays silent on -ation in other words like preparation, anticipation, experimentation. Members detect "culmin" and stage/end-of-process words.

Fires on ' million' when it ends the second number of a numeric range or pair ("23 million to 53 million"), in a list of quantities. Weakly fires on "well-" hyphens. Silent on ordinary text without such numbers.
result.label: ' million' in numeric ranges

result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix "ers" (occasionally "ors") when it completes a person-noun like researchers, employers, buyers, designers. Strongest on "researchers"; silent on "speakers" in a linguistics context.
result.label: Agent-noun suffix "ers" (researchers)

result.description: Fires mostly on the digit '0' inside long runs of zeros (e.g. lakh 1,00,000 or binary strings), plus occasional 'such' in 'such as' and ' usually'. It stays quiet on a '0' in short numbers like 180° or 10.
result.label: Zeros in long digit strings

result.description: Fires on the first word-piece of a multi-token word (pres, inst, pl, cre, cont) that comes right after an opening parenthesis or quote in a list of examples. The word is incomplete and continues next.
result.label: Word-start fragment inside parenthetical examples

result.description: Fires on the adverb ' locally' (mostly before sourced/grown/produced), and weaker on other manner adverbs like ' purely', ' dynamically', ' rather'. Members are mostly 'local' detectors plus generic word-piece features.
result.label: Adverb 'locally' and similar adverbs

result.description: Fires on ' solution' / ' solutions' as a noun, mostly after a modifier like "closed form", "exact", "particular", "optimal" or "series". Members include solution-token detectors and math/equation context. The contrast, an ODE passage with no such word, is silent.
result.label: solution(s) noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word " diameter" in geometry-style text about circles and radius, often after "the". Members include detectors of "diameter", "radius" and "circle". Weak firing on a few other measure words.
result.label: diameter token in circle geometry

result.description: Fires on digit tokens '2', '3', '0' inside long, repetitive digit strings or code-like numeric sequences (e.g. 332B223, 222-232). It stays quiet on a digit starting a year like 2010 or in normal dates.
result.label: Digits 2/3/0 in digit strings

result.description: Fires on the token ' wave' (physics wave mechanics, wave equations, wave-particle), with weak activity on related words like 'river'. Supported by members detecting wave/waves tokens.
result.label: Physics ' wave' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-completion suffix pieces (ate, ential, eries, acy, ately) right after a split-off stem like "qu" or "adequ", completing words such as adequate, queries, inadequacy. Silent on 'ate' in other words like mitigate or elaborate.
result.label: Suffix after 'qu'/'adequ' stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' chrom' at the start of words like chromatography, chromatin, chromosome and chromium. Members are mostly ' chrom' token detectors from layer 0, with some other word-piece detectors.
result.label: ' chrom' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ra' (also 'i', 'rag') right after 'suff' in "suffragettes/suffragists". Members detect ' suff' and similar word-start fragments; weak firing on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ra' in suffragette

result.description: Fires on ' optimized' (also ' custom', ' intellig') when it opens a noun phrase as a modifier, like "optimized supply chain". Silent when it follows "be"/"is" as a predicate or after another adjective.
result.label: ' optimized' as attributive modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ant' when it appears inside a longer word, such as Bantu, implantation, secant, resonant, univariant. Members are mostly 'ant' token detectors from early layers.
result.label: 'ant' word piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the token 'ed' when it is a standalone verb suffix ending a past-tense verb, just before 'the' plus an abstract noun (toolkit, influence, emergence). It stays silent on 'ed' inside other words or after certain stems like slic-ed, challeng-ed, spark-ed.
result.label: 'ed' verb ending before 'the'

result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix "ers" ending a person-noun like think-ers, philosoph-ers, research-ers, especially in lists of intellectual or professional groups. Stays quiet on "ers" in words like followers or centers.
result.label: "-ers" ending thinker-type nouns

result.description: Fires on ' he' (also ' she', surnames like Wilson/Davis) as the subject pronoun in biographical profile text about a person, especially after a clause such as "promised himself he". Silent in bare name lists.
result.label: Subject pronoun 'he' in biographies

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' invent' as the start of a longer word, mostly 'inventory' in supply-chain and business text. It is weaker in 'inventor' and 'invented'. Many members are detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' invent' word-piece (inventory)

result.description: Fires on a word that is followed by a suffix or compound completion, mainly ' Bank' in "Money and Banking", ' Model' after "Waterfall", and 'fall'. It predicts word-ending pieces like 'ing' and 'fall'.
result.label: Bank/Model/fall compound-word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' manip' at the start of manipulate/manipulation/manipulative, predicting continuations like 'ulative'. Members are mostly detectors of manip-/manipulate tokens. Rare weaker firing on 'artificial' and 'imbalance'.
result.label: ' manip' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' ending the word "phonemic" (also "epistemic"), after word pieces like phon-em. Silent on 'ic' in "proficiency" or "acoustic".
result.label: 'ic' in phonemic/epistemic

result.description: Fires on the tokens ' engines' and ' pop'/' Pop' (pop music), with a few weaker hits like 'Grand'. Members are mostly detectors of these specific tokens plus related topic words (jazz, solar, engineering).
result.label: ' engines' and ' pop' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' Swift' as a name (e.g. Jonathan Swift, Swift's), in all 64 peak examples. Driven mainly by a single layer-0 attention member that copies the ' Swift' token itself.
result.label: ' Swift' token detector
"sets" after "data"
result.description: Fires on " sets" (also " set") right after the word "data", as in "data set(s)". It is weaker on "data points" and "intricate details". Members detect "data" and "set" tokens. It stays silent on the one-word "datasets".

Fires on the token right after "good" (mostly "ness", also " and", " thing", " for") when the word "good" is being continued. It stays silent on "ness" after other words like fair or robust. Members detect "good" and "ness".
result.label: Continuation after "good"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'le' completing "mantle" (Earth's mantle, geology), and weakly on other word endings like 'ending' or 'phere'. Silent on 'le' in "puzzle" or "Aristotle", so it needs the mant- prefix.
result.label: 'le' ending of "mantle"

result.description: Fires on the first word pieces of technical science words, especially 'Ferr' and the following 'im' in "Ferrimagnetic", and on mid-word pieces like 'orm' in "hormones". Peaks are mixed and the logits are not clear.
result.label: Ferrimagnetic and technical word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' differenti' (start of "differentiable/differentiability") in math text, peaking on that token. Weak activation on a few other word-start pieces like ' Compet' and ' familiar'.
result.label: ' differenti' word piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ational' (also 'ations') when it completes the word "conversational"/"conversations", after the piece 'convers'. Silent on 'ational' in other words like "organizational".
result.label: 'ational' in conversational

result.description: Fires on the word piece "yth", mainly at the start of "Pythagoras" and related words, and weakly in "rhythm/rhythmic". It pushes towards continuations like "mic", "agoras" and "onian".
result.label: "yth" in Pythagoras

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' ris' (of risks, risky) and ' invest' (investors, investments), mostly in finance or business text. Members detect these pieces, with some separate 'risk' and 'ks' detectors. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: ' ris' and ' invest' word starts

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces (ver, c, ce, j, struct) right after a "con" prefix, as in convergence, conjunctions, concavé, constructive. Members detect "con" and related pieces. It stays silent on "ver" in other words like "adver".
result.label: Word piece after con- prefix

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'm' and 'las' in the middle of split words like cytoplas-m, Plexig-las, neoplas-ms. Silent on 'm' as a standalone abbreviation, such as in (mRNA). Logits favor '-ology' style continuations.
result.label: -plasm / -glas word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Systems' after "Traffic Control" in title-like phrases, and on scattered word-piece endings like 'ic', 'ol', 'le'. It is silent on 'ic' in words like proficient or athleticism. The peaks are mixed and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Control Systems title; scattered suffixes

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ness' when it completes a word such as compactness, closedness or boundedness, mostly in topology and analysis text. Members detect 'ness' and preceding stems like compact, closed and act.
result.label: 'ness' suffix after word stem
' defense' in biological/security text
result.description: Fires on the token ' defense' (all 64 peaks), mostly in biological or immune defense contexts such as 'passive defense', 'defense mechanisms'. Driven mainly by an attention latent that detects 'defense/defence' itself, plus weak security/mechanism members.

Fires on ' stage' and ' theatre' (stage designers, theatre types) in performing-arts text; weak firing on a few other nouns like plate or sandy. Driven by token detectors for stage/theatre plus topical members like fiction, jazz, ancient.
result.label: stage / theatre word detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' inner', most strongly in "inner product (space)" in math text; only weakly (about 38%) on the ordinary sense, as in "inner workings" or "inner motivation". Mainly driven by an attention latent that detects ' inner'.
result.label: ' inner' in inner product

result.description: Fires on generic container nouns like " content", " item", " text", " items", especially as the head noun after "the" or "each" (e.g. "each item", "the content of"). Silent on unrelated sentences. Members are mostly detectors of these same tokens.
result.label: Content/item/text noun detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'hr' (e.g. in "Phrase", "Bohr"), mostly when it starts or sits inside a word like "Phrase". Members are mainly detectors of 'hr' itself, plus a few related word-piece detectors.
result.label: 'hr' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces of "safeguarding" (mainly "arding" and "egu" after "safegu"), with weaker firing on "protecting" or "protective". Members detect the "egu" and "arding" pieces and protect-related tokens.
result.label: safeguarding word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pid' at the start of "pidgin(s)" or "pidginisation" in text about language contact. Members are mostly weak attention latents on linguistic and academic words, plus one ' pid' detector.
result.label: ' pid' in pidgin

result.description: Fires on the word piece "refix" (as in prefix, prefixes) and on " prefix"/" suffix", in text about affixes and word formation. Weak on related linguistic words. Silent on other language-structure text.
result.label: prefix word piece 'refix'

result.description: Fires on the token 'red' as a word-ending piece, as in verbs ending in -red (e.g. "...red the development"). It stays silent when 'red' sits inside "ingredients". Weaker on 'med' in "medicine".
result.label: 'red' suffix piece, not ingredients
' reci' word-piece (reciprocity)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' reci' at the start of words like reciprocal, reciprocity and reciprocating. It also fires weakly on 'reci' in recipe. Members are mostly detectors of ' reci' and 'pro' pieces.

Fires on the piece "it" (and "itate", "ating", "ates") inside "facilitate" and its forms (facilitating, facilitator). It stays silent on "it" in other words such as audit, prioritize and competitiveness.
result.label: "it" inside facilitate

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'id' or 'ym' right after the prefix 'ox' (oxidation, oxymorons), mostly in the middle of those words. It stays silent on 'id' without a preceding 'ox', as in word-initial 'idation' or 'multidimensional'.
result.label: 'id'/'ym' after 'ox' prefix

result.description: Fires on the token ' conversion', mostly when it starts a sentence or clause as the subject (e.g. "conversion process involves…"). It stays silent when 'conversion' follows a noun, as in "energy conversion" or "the conversion of".
result.label: Sentence-initial ' conversion'
Word-start 'li' / 'lipid' pieces
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' li' and the following pieces 'pid'/'pop' in words like lipid, lipoprotein, and liability. It is strongest in lipid biochemistry text. It stays silent on unrelated general text.

Fires on the piece 'in' (also 'if', 'id', 'il') right after the prefix 'mult' in words like multinomial, multiumiality, multidisciplinary. Silent on 'in' elsewhere, such as standalone 'in' or after a period.
result.label: 'in' after 'mult' prefix

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens: ' highway'/' Highway' and SQL ' JOIN' (e.g. after FULL, OUTER, using), with an occasional ' Rob'. Weak firing elsewhere; members are mostly generic attention detectors.
result.label: highway and JOIN tokens

result.description: Fires on the token " note" (musical note, note header) and on word pieces like "ocity" (velocity) and "ody"/"ythm". Several members detect these tokens directly. Weak, mixed evidence on what else it needs.
result.label: ' note' and 'ocity' token pieces

result.description: Fires on the word right after "significant" (adv-, progress, period, impact, use, contributions), where a noun of change or development is expected. Members detect "significant" and change/period nouns. Silent on ' adv' without a preceding "significant".
result.label: Word following "significant"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " cross" (also " heter") at the start of a compound like cross-validation, cross-temporal or crossroads. It stays silent when " cross" follows "of", "into" or "and" before a hyphenated cross-cultural or cross-linguistic term.
result.label: " cross" compound prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ch' (mostly the start of "chord", also in "chocolate"), with a few hits on ' right'. Driven by members that detect ' ch' and ' right' on the current token.
result.label: ' ch' piece, as in chord

result.description: Fires on the word " derivative" (finance or calculus senses, also plural) and on " repeated", as in "repeated games". Members are mostly token detectors for derivative and repeated, plus financial-word context.
result.label: derivative / repeated word detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the ' $' token opening inline LaTeX math (e.g. "$P$", "$f$"), with minor firing on word pieces like ' pas' and ' bin'. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Dollar sign opening inline math

result.description: Fires on a few specific words: "depends"/"depend", "intercept(s)" and "attacks", mostly in technical or logical text such as security or argument discussions. Upstream members are mainly token detectors for depend, attack and related words.
result.label: depend / intercept / attacks words

result.description: Fires on the token ' establishment' (and ' establish'), mostly when it is not directly preceded by 'the'. It stays silent on 'the establishment of ...' in history and finance text. Members are detectors of establish-words.
result.label: ' establishment' without preceding 'the'

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of a rare or multi-piece word, most strongly 'hip' in "Entity-Relationship" and also 'ie', 'ua', 'jar' in names. Silent on 'hip' in "Partnership", so it needs the specific word.
result.label: 'hip' in Entity-Relationship

result.description: Fires mainly on " signal" (also satellite, audio, recording) in lists of technical fields like telecommunications, imaging and signal processing. Silent on a similar passage without such a word.
result.label: signal in telecom/imaging lists

result.description: Fires mostly on ' cup' (and 'set') in measuring-cup contexts like "1/4 cup" or "cup set", with weaker hits on ' fun' and a few other word pieces. Logits suggest word-suffix continuations. Mixed evidence.
result.label: measuring cup token

result.description: Fires on the word " agents" / " agent" (AI agents, chemical agents, literary agents), pushing the next token toward agent-like words. Built from layer-0 attention heads that detect agent tokens, plus some weak shared context heads.
result.label: ' agent(s)' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'od' when it follows 'mel' in melodic words (melodic, melodies, melodically). It stays silent on 'od' in other words such as 'embodied' or at the start of a text. Members detect 'mel' and 'od' pieces.
result.label: 'od' inside 'mel-od-' words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ital', mostly in "revitalize/revitalization" and also in "orbital". Predicts suffixes like -ization, -izing, -ized. It stays silent on related physics text that lacks the 'ital' piece.
result.label: 'ital' piece in revitalize/orbital

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "intellectual" (journey, movement, and, thought, exploration, or pieces like ' purs'), when "intellectual" is the preceding word. Silent on ' purs' after "the".
result.label: Token following "intellectual"

result.description: Fires on word endings (-ating, -ate, -ation, -ates) only when they complete the word "anticipate" and its forms. The same suffix after other stems (animating, investigating, navigating) stays silent.
result.label: Suffix of "anticipate" forms

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'st' (e.g. in "stamas", "brushstrokes", "substantial", "21st") and on ' zeit' in "zeitgeist", mostly as a word-initial or mid-word fragment. Members are mostly layer-0 detectors of these pieces.
result.label: 'st' and 'zeit' word fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " Among" when it opens a document or sentence ("Among the many types…"). It is mostly driven by an Among-detector and document-start attention members. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Sentence-initial " Among"

result.description: Fires on improvement/simplification verbs, mainly " optimize", also " simplify", " validate" and " improve", in technical or engineering prose where the verb follows "to" or "and". Members are detectors of these verbs.
result.label: optimize/simplify verbs in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token " protein" (weaker on "prote" in "proteins"), mostly in biology or biochemistry text. It is driven by attention members that detect "protein" and "prote" tokens. It is silent in food and cuisine text.
result.label: ' protein' token detector

result.description: Fires on a few specific nouns, mostly ' hands' (e.g. washing hands), also ' pressure', ' stroke' and ' smoke'. Members are mostly detectors of those same tokens. It is silent on thermodynamics text.
result.label: hands / pressure / smoke noun tokens

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments (er, an, m, at) completing a split word after a "ram"/"Cram"-like prefix, e.g. Cram[er], dram[at]iker. Silent on 'er' in ordinary words like foster or richer.
result.label: Mid-word piece after 'ram'
'ly' piece in scientific word fragments
result.description: Fires on the token 'ly' when it is a word fragment inside technical words (hydrolysis, glycolysis, cyclic terms like -lysis, -clys). It stays silent on 'ly' as an adverb suffix (singly, mistakenly).

Fires on the word piece 'ru' when it is the start of a longer word such as dis-ru-ptions, Inter-ru-ptions, Inst-ru-ments or -ru-ence. It is silent where the 'ru' piece is missing. It predicts word continuations.
result.label: 'ru' piece inside longer words

result.description: Fires on the token " gained" (e.g. "gained popularity", "gained access", "gained momentum"). The circuit is mostly token detectors for "gained" and "gain" in early attention latents. The contrast has no "gained", so it gives no condition.
result.label: ' gained' token detector

result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Three', mostly in titles and names like "Three-Body Problem", "Three Mile Island", "Three Dimensions". Driven mainly by a ' Three' token detector in layer 0 attention.
result.label: Capitalized ' Three' in titles

result.description: Fires on word pieces ('-', 'ity', 'ist', 'istic') that directly follow the word "human", as in "human-centered", "humanity", "humanist". Silent on hyphens after other words like avant-, self-, Pre-.
result.label: Suffix or hyphen after "human"

result.description: Fires on word pieces following the prefix "aff" (aff-able, aff-ix, aff-inity, aff-irm), the continuation after "aff". Members include detectors of " aff" and of the suffix pieces.
result.label: Word piece after "aff-"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'icult' in "multiculturalism"/"multicultural", mainly when it starts a token after "mult". Driven by an 'icult' token detector and a following 'ural' detector. Weakly fires on "that" in lists of demonstratives.
result.label: 'icult' in multicultural

result.description: Fires on a few specific word-start pieces, mostly ' Par' (Paradox, Parallel, Paréto), also ' brut' (brutal/brutality), ' violence' and ' duplicate'. Members are per-token detectors for these pieces; it is silent on plain structural text.
result.label: Par-/brut-/violence word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces ' Ph' and 'on' (and 'en', 'er') in the word-start "Phon-"/"Phen-"/"pher-" family, mostly "Phonetics", when the preceding Ph piece is present. Members detect Ph/ph tokens and phonetic/linguistic context.
result.label: Ph-/Phon- word-piece in phonetics

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Arch' at the start of a word, such as Archimedes, Archer or Architectural. It fires weakly on ' Er' at word starts. It is driven mainly by members that detect ' Arch' itself.
result.label: ' Arch' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the final capital letter of an acronym, mostly the 'T' in "IoT" (also the W in EDW, M in EDM), after the preceding acronym piece such as Io or ED. It stays silent on ordinary text.
result.label: Acronym-final letter, IoT
' compreh' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compreh' (start of "comprehensive"/"comprehension"), mostly before "-ensive". Driven by attention latents that detect ' compreh' itself. It predicts continuations like 'ension' and similar understanding-related pieces.
Fires on the word piece 'ass' inside split words such as 'seagrass', 'agrass', or 'encompassing'. It weakly fires on 'agr', 'und', 'ang' pieces. Members detect these pieces, especially after 'agr'.
result.label: 'ass' word-piece after 'agr'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' when it follows the word 'institution' (institutional, institutionalizing). It stays silent on 'al' in other words like instrumental or bilateral, or at the start of a text.
result.label: 'al' after 'institution'

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "encompass" (the "ass" in encomp-ass-ing, and the endings -es/-ed/-ing after encompass), and weakly on the following " the". Needs the word to be a form of "encompass".
result.label: encompass word pieces

result.description: Fires on function words or word pieces (' and', ' to', ' of', 'ing', 'ely') that directly follow "speaking" or "convers-" words. It stays silent on ' and' after other nouns. Members detect speaking, conversation and language tokens.
result.label: Token after speaking/conversation words

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces 'ing'/'ING'/'ed' in "blanching"/"blanched" (after 'anch'), plus 'bean' in Caribbean, in cooking text. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like maintaining or cooking.
result.label: Suffix after 'anch' (blanching)

result.description: Fires mainly on 'ik' in "Rubik's" and on particles after "take/taking" (out, up, into, place). Mixed peaks; members include an 'ik' detector and a take-verb detector.
result.label: Rubik's 'ik' and take-particles

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after the word "center" (center of electron density, center of gravity, center of commerce). Weaker on "cent-ers" pieces. Silent on 'of' after other nouns like top, middle, details.
result.label: ' of' after "center"

result.description: Fires on the token right after "health" (suffixes like -y, -ier, -ful, or following words like care, and, measures). Members detect " health" and "care" in the previous position.
result.label: Token following "health"

result.description: Fires on word pieces in historical linguistics text about reconstructing ancestral languages (ancest-, reconstruct, languages, past). Peaks vary across related words in this topic; it weakly pushes toward families/populations.
result.label: Ancestral language reconstruction words

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside proper names of ancient peoples and places, such as Akk-ad, Az-te(c), and Moh-and. Silent on 'ad' in unrelated words like 'cradles'. Members detect name-start pieces like Az and kk.
result.label: Name-ending pieces: Akkad, Aztec

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'itter' (jitter, litter), with weaker peaks on a few other tokens like ' mine', ' smoke', ' processed', ' raw'. Mostly a detector of the 'itter' piece, mixed on the rest.
result.label: 'itter' word piece (jitter, litter)

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'el' piece inside "Mandelbrot" (after ' Mand'), with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces like 'ag', 'ji', 'aring'. Members detect the preceding ' Mand' token.
result.label: 'el' in Mandelbrot

result.description: Fires mostly on " Space" in mathematical vector-space terms (Null Space, Normed Space, Vector Space), and weakly on pieces like "Dim" or "-". Members include " Space" detectors. Logits are unclear.
result.label: " Space" in math space terms

result.description: Fires on the word ' both' in mid-sentence, after a verb or preposition (master both, through both, led both), where it introduces a pair. It stays silent on sentence-initial 'Both'. An earlier ' both' detector feeds it.
result.label: Mid-sentence ' both'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'king' in Hawking, 'tr' in filtration, and hyphen/'ed' after 'buffer'. It seems to be a token-piece latent for word continuations, with weak, mixed evidence for a single trigger.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: Hawking, filtration, buffer

result.description: Fires on the beginning-of-document token <s> at the very start of a text. It stays silent on <s> tokens that appear after a preceding passage, such as after a period in a concatenated document.
result.label: Document-start token

result.description: Fires on the token ' era', mostly when it starts a clause or subject (e.g. "era's", "era set the stage"). It is weaker when "era" follows "the". Two members detect ' era' directly. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' era' token detector

result.description: Fires on the hyphen (and 'sh' in 'workshops') right after the word "work", as in work-life or work-energy. Silent on hyphens after other words like AI-, well-, open-, mid-. Members detect 'work' and the hyphen.
result.label: Hyphen after 'work'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'iv' in "individual/indivisible" and 'or' in "absorbing", plus '/' in slash-separated lists. It is silent on 'iv' in "pivotal", so it needs particular word contexts.
result.label: Mid-word fragments iv/or in words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' bal' (ballet, balloon), ' leg' (legatus) and ' scr' (scrutiny) that begin a longer word and need a continuation. Silent when ' bal' starts "balances". Members are detectors of those pieces.
result.label: Word-initial pieces bal / leg / scr

result.description: Fires on the comma (sometimes ' of') right after the word "example" in "for example," or "in this example,". Members mostly detect the preceding ' example' token. Other commas stay silent.
result.label: Comma after "for example"

result.description: Fires on the token " second"/" Second", most strongly in "second derivative (test)" in math contexts. It is weaker for "second" in other uses such as "second-most" or "second time". Members are mostly detectors of "second".
result.label: ' second' token, esp. second derivative

result.description: Fires on the 'erson' piece in "Ford-Fulkerson" (the maximum flow algorithm name), helped by earlier detectors for Ford, F and ulk. Silent on other names like Vygotsky. Weak on a few odd tokens.
result.label: Fulkerson 'erson' piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' art' / ' Art', mainly when it begins "artistic" (split as Art+istic) or precedes an "-istic/-work" continuation, as in lists of "Artistic ..." headings. It stays quiet on 'art' as a plain noun after modifiers like digital, geometric or abstract.
result.label: ' art' as start of artistic

result.description: Fires on the word " share" (also " Share", weaker on " sharing"), mostly as a noun at the start of a text about shares or shareholders. Driven mainly by a layer-0 attention head detecting the same token.
result.label: Token ' share'

result.description: Fires on the piece "ought" inside "drought" (mostly in drought monitoring/control titles) and, more weakly, on " contrast"/"contrasting". Members detect "ought", "contrast" and "dr" prefixes.
result.label: "ought" in drought; "contrast"

result.description: Fires on a few scattered tokens, mainly ' support'/' supports' and ' patron', also ' Exit' (in "Late Exit") and word pieces like 'evangel'. Peaks are mixed, and the contrast does not show what else is needed.
result.label: support / patron / Exit mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on word pieces in real-time/computing text, mainly " dead" (deadline), " interrupt" (interrupt service routine), and "start". Early layer, so it mostly detects these tokens; weaker on "delay" and "lay".
result.label: dead(line) / interrupt in computing

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ros' in "neuroscience" (split as neu|ros|cience), after the ' neu' piece. It also weakly fires on 'chem' in "neurochemical". The members detect 'ros' and 'neu' pieces.
result.label: 'ros' in neuroscience

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' sequ', 'continu', 'isson', ' scal', ' avail', where a longer word is being spelled out. Likely predicts suffix pieces such as 'ance', 'ential'. Members mostly detect these same fragments.
result.label: Word-start fragments (sequ, continu, avail)

result.description: Fires on the adverb ' fully' (e.g. "engage fully", "fully appreciate"), especially when it follows a verb or repeats in a passage. Predicts participles like appreciated, understood, addressed. Members include attention detectors of ' fully' and ' truly'.
result.label: adverb ' fully'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in expository text (e.g. 'ctions' in reproductions, ' interactive', ' govern', ' injured', ' Aud', ' George'). Peaks are heterogeneous; likely predicts nouns like plans, schema, documents. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and noun-modifier tokens

result.description: Fires on digits and word pieces inside hyphen-or-dash separated lists of affixes or numbers, like "-2 -3 -4 -5 -6" or "-s, -ed". Members detect the hyphen/dash and preceding list digits.
result.label: Hyphenated affix/number list items

result.description: Fires on the token ' down', strongest in the phrasal verb "breaking/breaks down" (e.g. breaking down complex tasks). Weaker for "slowing down" and the "breakdown" piece. Members detect ' down', ' breaking' and ' break'.
result.label: ' down' after break

result.description: Fires on the word piece "circ" (also " circuit", "uits") as in circuits, circadian, and circuitry. Its members include several detectors of "circ" and "circuit" tokens. Contrast text has no such token.
result.label: circ / circuit word piece

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces that begin or continue words like "Sc"-ore/Scandinavian/Scrubric, "custom", and "fine". Early-layer token detectors (Sc, custom, fine) feed it; no single shared meaning.
result.label: Sc-/custom/fine word-piece mix

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Dar' (as in Darwin) at the start of a document or a title-like context, plus 'GT' and 'perimental'. It stays silent on ' Dar' after 'Charles' or mid-sentence, so it seems to need an early or heading position.
result.label: ' Dar' at document start

result.description: Fires on the word " phase" and its variants (" phases", " stages", " Stage"), including repeated "phase" lists and "phase of development" text. Members are mostly detectors of earlier "phase" tokens.
result.label: phase token detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of rare capitalized words that continue into a longer word, mainly ' Rod', ' Prop' (Propulsion, Propellant), ' Font', and 'ri'. The member latents are mostly detectors of these fragments themselves.
result.label: Word-start fragments: Rod, Prop, Font

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' activ' (activist, activate, activism), and more weakly on ' initi' (initiate, initiatives) and ' concentr'. It is a token-level detector of these word-start pieces, driven mainly by an ' activ' attention member.
result.label: ' activ' word-start piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' robust', most strongly at the start of 'robustness' and in other uses. Layer-0 members mostly detect ' robust' itself. It pushes the next token towards 'ness' and ' against'.
result.label: ' robust' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces right after the prefix "co" inside words like cooperative, coevolution, coexistence, coadaptation, coercion (oper, e, ex, ada, erst). Members detect " co" and "ating" tokens preceding it.
result.label: Word piece after "co-" prefix

result.description: Fires mostly on ' $' opening inline LaTeX math (variables like $P$, $T$), and also on ' looks', ' someone', '£'. Mixed token set; the math-dollar case dominates.
result.label: Inline math dollar sign, plus looks/someone

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "catal" (mostly "yz" in "catalyzed/catalyzing", also "yt" in "catalytic"). Members detect "catal", "yz", "yt" and "yst" pieces, so it needs the token to sit inside a catal- word.
result.label: catal-yz piece in "catalyzed"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' math' (before -ematician/-ématicians), 'SN', 'indu', and ' #', mostly early in a document or at an incomplete word piece. Predicts continuation pieces. Members detect math/science topic words.
result.label: ' math' and other word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on a mid-word piece ('us', 'm', 'ach', 'ou') inside a rare surname split into pieces, mainly Br-us-ilov and Kol-m-ogorov. Silent on 'us' ending Latinized names like Claus-ius, Linus, Malthus.
result.label: Mid-word piece in rare surnames

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'els' completing the word "fuels" (e.g. fossil fuels, alternative fuels). It stays silent on 'els' in "panels". Members detect the preceding 'fu', 'fuel', 'foss', 'comb' pieces and energy context.
result.label: 'els' ending "fuels"

result.description: Fires on a verb-start piece such as ' enh' (also ' impact', ' stream') right after the adverb "significantly". It is silent on ' enh' after "can" or "and". Members detect "significantly" and "greatly" earlier in the text.
result.label: Verb after 'significantly' (enh-ance)

result.description: Fires on ' evol' (as in "evolves") and on ' society' or the word right after it, such as "society evolves" or "society's". It stays quiet on "evol" after other subjects like science or philosophy. Members are mostly detectors of the word 'society'.
result.label: 'evolves' after 'society'

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "strong" (e.g. "strong acids", "strong and", "strong interaction", "strong-"), with "est" and "force" also peaking. Members mostly detect "strong" in the preceding context.
result.label: Token following "strong"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'onomy' (also 'ic', 'onom') completing "gastronomy"/"gastronomic" after "gastr". It is silent in unrelated cooking text, so it needs the word-start "gastr" piece.
result.label: gastr-onomy word completion

result.description: Fires on the period in the abbreviation "vs." (after " vs"), as in "character vs." or "Sequential vs." It stays silent on ordinary sentence-ending periods.
result.label: Period after "vs"

result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Active', mostly at the start of a document or title (e.g. "Active Listening"). It is weaker on sentence-initial "Active voice". Members include ' Active' and ' active' token detectors plus document-start attention heads.
result.label: ' Active' at text start

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and suffixes like 'able' in "predictable", 'reg' in "segregation", ' stable', across science-text passages. Peaks are scattered, and the same 'able' stays silent in other words (formable, unattainable, sustainable). Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word pieces in science text

result.description: Fires on the token ' entity' (as in database or abstract entities), including at document start. The strongest member is an ' entity' token detector; the rest is mostly diffuse context.
result.label: ' entity' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'unk' (as in 'chunking'-style splits, e.g. 'unking'), and more weakly on name-final 'sky' (Mussorgsky, Chomsky). Driven mainly by an 'unk' token detector.
result.label: 'unk' word piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word " from" when it begins a phrase (often at the start of a clause or document, or after a noun like "arise"), not after motion or transition verbs like "came from" or "transitioning from".
result.label: ' from' starting a phrase

result.description: Fires on the middle word pieces of the name "Brahmagupta" (mainly 'agu', also 'as' in "Brahmasphuta"), after "Brahm"/"hm". It also fires weakly on a few other name fragments, such as the "ach" in Banach.
result.label: Brahmagupta name fragment 'agu'

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like 'es' (also 'ing', 'er', 'en') ending a word, strongest on the plural 'es' of "dashes" in punctuation text. Silent on 'es' in other words like themes or climaxes. Members detect the preceding word piece 'dash'.
result.label: plural 'es' after 'dash'

result.description: Fires on items in comma-separated lists of abstract nouns or fields (e.g. "coord", "etc", "literature", "strateg", " in", " non") following a comma. Silent on ' in' used as a preposition in ordinary clauses.
result.label: Items in comma-separated topic lists

result.description: Fires on abstract mental or social nouns such as "feelings", "perception", "belief" and "power", mostly in social-science style text before "of". Members are diffuse layer-0 attention latents with no sharp discriminators. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Abstract mental/social nouns (feelings, perception)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " administr" (and the following "ators") in "administrators", especially as sentence subject ("administrators can/need to..."). Weak activation on "soci-" word pieces like sociolinguistic.
result.label: administrators word piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of proper names or compound words, mostly 'undred' in "Hundred Years' War", and also on odd pieces like 'EL', 'tern', ' brother'. Peaks are mixed; the circuit is mostly diffuse layer-0 attention members, with the ' Years' member the strongest.
result.label: Hundred (Years' War) and name fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' scal' (scalability, scalloped, scalene), ' equ' (equity) and ' ded' (deductive) when they appear mid-text. It stays silent when the fragment is the first token of the document.
result.label: scal/equ/ded word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of specific words, mainly 'si' in "Celsius" and 'olation' in "Violation". Members detect the preceding piece (' Cel', ' Vi'), so it needs that earlier piece.
result.label: 'si' in Celsius, 'olation' in Violation

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "car" (car|ving, car|b|ohydrate, car|ved, car|bo), i.e. continuation tokens of words beginning with "car". Silent on -ving after other stems like del-, deser-, obser-.
result.label: word pieces after "car"
Mixed word pieces in legal/civic names
result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word pieces and name tokens (Luther in Martin Luther, constitution-al, Esp-ion-age, 'of' in Act of), often in civil-rights or legal/historical text. Peaks are inconsistent; evidence is mixed.
Fires on word pieces like 'ag', 'ak', 'ask', 'av' inside transliterated Indian names after 'Bh' (Bhagavad, Bhakti, Bhaskara). Silent on 'ag' in Greek-derived words like Pythagoras or pedagogy.
result.label: Syllable after Bh- in Indian names

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ingu" (and weakly " lingu") in words like sociolinguistic, psycholinguistic and Linguistic, right before "istic". Members are detectors of "ingu", " lingu" and " L" pieces.
result.label: "ingu" in linguistic words

result.description: Fires on emphasis adverbs like " particularly", " specifically" and " especially" that introduce a focused or highlighted item, mostly in academic or technical prose. Members include detectors of these adverbs; contrast text without them is silent.
result.label: Particularly/specifically emphasis adverbs

result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' (also 'oration', 'ores', 'ored') inside forms of "explore" (explorers, explorations, explores). Silent on 'or' in unrelated words such as "sonorities".
result.label: 'or' inside "explor-" words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ify' (amplify, magnify, -ify verbs) and on 'core' (hard-core, -core), mainly as a suffix-like piece in words. Supported by token detectors for 'ify' and 'core'. Predicts 's' or 'the' next.
result.label: 'ify' and 'core' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " ready" (e.g. "get ready", "be ready", "ready-made"), weakly on " prepared". Members are token detectors for ready/prepared, plus "-for/to" and "-iness" pieces.
result.label: ' ready' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' el' and following pieces ('astic', 'ution', 'uc') in words like elasticity, elution, elucidation. It needs the el- word-start context; members detect ' el'/'astic' tokens.
result.label: el- word pieces (elasticity, elution)

result.description: Fires on ' possible' or ' up' (also ' of', ' from') right after a form of "made"/"make", as in "made possible by" and "made up of". Silent on "up" after other verbs like tidy, toast or led.
result.label: "made" + up/possible

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on scattered tokens: ' Level', 'AS', ' two', ' (', and mid-word pieces in technical or acronym-heavy text. Peaks are inconsistent, and members are mostly token-specific attention detectors, so no single trigger emerges.
result.label: Scattered technical tokens, acronyms and levels

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " static", also " Democratic", " Dynamic", " dynamic" and " regime". Several members are static/dynamic token detectors, so it is mostly a lexical detector for these adjectives, often in static-vs-dynamic contrasts.
result.label: static / dynamic / Democratic token

result.description: Fires on the "t" of "doesn't" and on "notation" (as in "connotation"), plus scattered tokens like "reads". Silent on "'t" after don't/can't, so it seems tied to "doesn't"-type contexts and the word piece "notation".
result.label: doesn't 't and connotation

result.description: Fires on tokens of organization/institution names and acronyms (NE in NEC, PA in NEPA, EU, Union), mostly the end of a regulatory or political body name. Weak firing on some other nouns. Members are mostly token detectors.
result.label: Organization and acronym name tokens

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ries' ending plural nouns, such as strawber-ries, past-ries, indust-ries. Supported by members detecting 'ries' and ' indust' tokens. Silent on unrelated text without it.
result.label: 'ries' plural word ending

result.description: Fires on the word piece "que" (Romanesque, aqueous) and on " pivot" (pivot row/element in linear algebra). Mostly layer-0 attention members detecting those tokens; the contrast text without them is silent.
result.label: 'que' piece and 'pivot'

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word fragments, odd pieces and garbled characters (' dell', ' SY', ' IN', apostrophes, 'ry' in polyacrylamide). Peaks are inconsistent, and the members are mostly generic attention latents, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word-fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside multi-piece words, mainly 'lic' (bib-lic-al), 'pos' (Pre-pos-itions), and 'r'/'es', after an earlier word piece. Members are detectors of the preceding piece and the fragment itself.
result.label: Mid-word fragments lic/pos

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces, such as 'LETE' in DELETE, 'malloc', ' grant', and Cyrillic fragments like 'ну'. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. Members are mostly generic layer-0 token detectors.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments, mixed

result.description: Fires on a hyphen (or word like "management") directly after the word "water", as in "water-wise", "water-based", "water-saving". Stays silent on hyphens after other words like "decision-" or "time-".
result.label: Hyphen after "water"

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also ' or', ' upon', ' and') directly after large-number words like "millions" or "billions", as in "millions of years". It stays silent on ' of' after ordinary nouns such as "distribution of" or "process of".
result.label: 'of' after millions/billions

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ic'/'istic' right after 'Art' or 'art' (Artistic, articulate), with weaker firing on ' of' and ' and' in title-like lists. Silent on 'ic' in other words (proficiency, strategic, elicit).
result.label: 'ic'/'istic' after 'art' stem

result.description: Fires on the word " every" (peaking at the start of a phrase or repeated parallel clauses like "every cut, every..."). Members are mostly detectors of "every"/"each". Weak activation on other tokens.
result.label: ' every' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' density' (also weakly on 'dens-' pieces), mostly at the start of a text about physical density. Upstream members are mainly ' density' token detectors in layer-0 attention.
result.label: ' density' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ron', 'ut', 'rom' inside "macronutrients"/"micronutrients" (mic-ron-utrients), after the mac/mic prefix. Members detect mic/mac/ron/ut pieces. Silent in other food text.
result.label: micro/macronutrient word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' virtue', both in 'virtue ethics' and in 'by virtue of'. Driven mainly by an attention member that detects an earlier ' virtue' token. Predicts ' of' next. The contrast text has no ' virtue'.
result.label: ' virtue' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' Writing' when it follows 'Creative' (the phrase "Creative Writing"). It stays silent on ' Writing' at the start of a sentence. Members include a 'Creative' detector and a 'Writing' attention member.
result.label: Writing after Creative

result.description: Fires on the plural agent-noun suffix pieces 'ors' and 'ators' (communicators, orators, estimators), but stays silent on 'ors' in "compressors" (a different word). Members detect these suffix tokens.
result.label: Plural -ors / -ators suffix

result.description: Fires on the token "for" in many uses (duration, purpose, cause, "for example", and the "for" piece of "forcement"). Layer-0 attention members detecting "for" and "rein" drive it. The contrast text lacks "for" entirely.
result.label: Token "for" detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' mascul' (masculinity/masculine), and also on a few other word-start fragments such as ' Mont', ' bon' and ' marry'. Several fragments are split mid-word, so it looks like a word-start piece detector with mixed peaks.
result.label: ' mascul' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the 'om'/'m'/'oms' piece inside words like sympt-om-atic, blo-om-ery, blooms, and snow-m-elt. It is quiet on 'm' in other words like dis-m-antling. Members detect 'sympt', 'snow' and 'oms' tokens.
result.label: om/m piece in symptom, bloom words
Apostrophe after "today"
result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in "today's" (e.g. "in today's world"). Silent on apostrophes after other words such as era's, 1970's or names. Members detect the preceding "today" or "modern".

Fires on the ordinal word " third" (occasionally " fourth" or " second") across music intervals, lists and laws. Members are mostly detectors of ' third', ' second', ' fourth' and ' Third'. The contrast shows no ordinal.
result.label: Ordinal 'third' detector

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'edge' (as in hedge, cutting-edge) and 'ator'/'ators' (creator, narrator, estimators), plus occasionally ' lie'. Members are token detectors for these endings and for cre- word starts.
result.label: -edge and -ator word endings

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ols' ending words like soil orders (Gelisols, Histosols), alcohols (isopropanols) and 'pools'. Weakly fires on 'acter' in bacterium/bacteria. Members detect prior word fragments such as 'alco', 'chem' and 'eth'.
result.label: 'ols' word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the word right after "more" (and, than, or, effectively), as in "more and more" or "more than". Silent on "and" elsewhere. Members are mostly detectors of the preceding " more".
result.label: Word following "more" (more and/than)

result.description: Fires on the token ' device' (occasionally ' setup' or ' chamber'), as in "device drivers" or "each device". Early-layer members mostly detect ' device'/' devices' directly. The contrast text has no such word, so nothing else is clearly required.
result.label: ' device' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " demand" (and " demanded"), most strongly in the economics sense, e.g. "demand is elastic" or "demand curve". It is weaker for "consumer demand". Driven mainly by attention latents that detect the token " demand" itself.
result.label: ' demand' token detector

result.description: Fires on the "uling" piece of "scheduling" and on " sched" (also "Round Robin", "task") in computing/OS scheduling text. Boosts next-token predictions like sched, schedule, tasks, queue.
result.label: scheduling word pieces (sched/uling)

result.description: Fires on gerunds of achieving/building/creating (mostly "ieving" in "achieving") after "in" or "for", in abstract teamwork or communication text about goals and relationships.
result.label: achieving/building gerund after "in"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'as'/'ases' completing "phr-" in "phrase(s)" and "phrasal", mostly in grammar text. Upstream members detect the " phr" piece and "ases" tokens.
result.label: phr-ases word completion

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "frame" (hyphen, " narr", "of", "defines", "during"), as in frame-of-reference or frame-based. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like multi-, well-, non-.
result.label: Token following "frame"

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "Hammurabi" (Hamm, ur, abi), especially 'ur' and 'abi' after "Hamm". Silent on 'ur' in Ashur or Babur, so it needs the Hammurabi word context.
result.label: Hammurabi name pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' completing the word "tangent" (also tangents, tangency-related pieces), in geometry text. It stays silent on 'ent' in other words such as congruent or inherent.
result.label: 'ent' in "tangent"

result.description: Fires on the word "prompt" and its pieces (prompt, prompts, prompting, promptness), mostly in writing-prompt contexts. Weaker on "promptly" or "prompt action". Silent on related creative-writing text without the word.
result.label: the word "prompt"
improve/enhance verb suffix endings
result.description: Fires on the ending pieces (-ves, -ving, -ance, -ances) of the verbs "improve" and "enhance" after the stem piece (impro-, enh-). Members detect those stems. It nudges toward words like "understanding" or "academic".

Fires on the 'ver' piece in "nonverbal" (after "non"), with weaker hits on similar mid-word pieces like 'ter' in "subterranean". Members detect 'non', '-', 'linear' and 'ver' tokens earlier in the word.
result.label: 'ver' in nonverbal

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " historic" (and its variants), with scattered weak firing on Arabic or Japanese word pieces. Members are detectors of historic/historical and related word pieces such as -ism and -istic.
result.label: " historic" token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ier', mostly in the surname Navier (Navier-Stokes), and more weakly on ' systems' and the 'z' of 'freezers'. Members detect ' Nav' and 'ier' pieces.
result.label: 'ier' in Navier

result.description: Fires on the token 'ber', strongest when it starts a word as in "cyberpunk" or "cybersecurity" (likely "cyber" split). Weaker in "fiber". Boosts next tokens like 'security', 'attack', 'punk'-style continuations.
result.label: 'ber' token, cyber- prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lear" in "Nuclear" (split as Nuc|lear), always at that token. Members detect "lear", "uc" and "nuclear" earlier in the context. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "lear" in Nuclear

result.description: Fires on the final 'M' of the acronym "SCM" (supply chain / software configuration management), after "SC". It stays silent on 'M' in other acronyms such as SPM or CM, so it depends on the preceding SC.
result.label: 'M' in SCM acronym

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens inside longer words: gerund 'ing' endings (multitasking, whisking, plumbing) and the 'Mic'/'Micro' start of microscopy/microscope. Silent on many other 'ing' endings, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ing, Micro-

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on mixed word pieces that start or sit inside longer words (' future', ' det', 'outer', 'oting', ' Equ', 'oder'). No single token dominates; ' future' is the most common peak, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed word pieces, often ' future'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ix' (also ' suffix', 'fix') in linguistics text about affixes, such as aff-ix-es and inf-ix-es. Members detect 'ix' pieces and morphology words like morph, prefix and consonants.
result.label: 'ix' in affix/infix words

result.description: Fires on ' use' as a noun right after "the" (e.g. "the use of ..."), predicting " of". Stays silent on ' use' as a verb or after adjectives like "practical" or "masterful".
result.label: noun "use" after "the"

result.description: Fires on the token ' version', mostly in software version control and versioning text. Members detect ' version'/' Version' and related words like copies, branch, and cluster. The contrast text has no ' version' token.
result.label: ' version' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix or fragment tokens (eness, ing, ic, ically, ist) in the middle of multi-piece words, especially after "polit" and "refr"; the word is still unfinished. Weak on rhetor-/framing pieces.
result.label: Mid-word suffix pieces after polit-/refr-

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'del' in "Gödel" (surname after "Gö"), plus occasional ' Step'/' step' and odd byte tokens. Silent on a standalone 'del' without the "Gö" prefix. Early-layer circuit with many name-fragment detectors.
result.label: 'del' in Gödel

result.description: Fires on the token " measure" (also " gauge") as a noun, especially in mathematical contexts such as angle measure, Lebesgue measure, and measure theory. It is silent on nearby geometry text that lacks the word.
result.label: measure / gauge token detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' rather' when it introduces a contrast, as in "X rather than Y". Members detect ' rather', ' instead', ' versus' and similar contrastive words. Silent on text lacking that word.
result.label: ' rather' in contrast phrases

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' e' when it starts "ecology/ecological" and is followed by 'colog'/'cos' continuations. It is a layer-0 token detector for this fragment, with weak activation on 'e' in 'eating'.
result.label: ' e' start of ecology words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ility" completing a word, most strongly in "mobility" after " mob". Members detect "ility" and " mob" tokens. It is weaker on "ity" in "ethnicity".
result.label: "ility" suffix in mobility

result.description: Fires on the token " identity" (national, cultural, brand, sexual identity), with a few weak hits on other tokens. Members are mostly detectors of identity, Identity and ident. The contrast text, which lacks the word, stays silent.
result.label: identity token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' consider' and its variants (consideration, considerations, Consider), mostly as the piece before '-ations' or in 'careful consideration'. Silent on related text without the word. Pushes toward 'ations' and 'consideration'.
result.label: consider / consideration token detector

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' constitu', ' pill' (pillow/pillars), ' hub', and 'corner' (cornerstone), where the word continues with a suffix. Layer-0 token-piece detectors dominate the circuit.
result.label: Word-start pieces: constitu, pill, hub

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ater', 'ang', 'ine' directly after 'bil' in words such as bilateral, bilinear, bilingual. It stays silent on 'ater' after 'il' or 'multil', so it needs the 'bil' prefix.
result.label: Word piece after 'bil' (bilateral)

result.description: Fires on the 'ment' piece in "Augment" (as in Augmented Reality), at the start of the word. It stays silent on 'ment' in words like assessment and investment. It fires weakly on 'ed' after "augment".
result.label: 'ment' in Augment(ed)

result.description: Fires on the token 'W' completing the acronym DAW (Digital Audio Workstation), right after 'DA'. It stays silent on 'W' in 'DW', where the 'DA' prefix is missing.
result.label: W in DAW acronym

result.description: Fires on the token 'ical' when it stands as its own word piece, usually at the start of a text or after a break, as in "ical praktisity". It stays silent when 'ical' ends a longer word such as "critical", "ethical" or "fantastical".
result.label: Standalone 'ical' token, not word-final

result.description: Fires on the word " physical" (also "Phys-") when it begins a sentence or phrase or follows "The" or "In". It stays quiet on "physical" after "include", "other" or "of" in material/forces text.
result.label: ' physical' at phrase start

result.description: Fires on the word " literally" (also weakly on similar adverbs like " essentially"), including when it is mentioned as a word. Members are detectors of "literally"/"literal" plus other adverb-like pieces.
result.label: ' literally' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " net" as an adjective meaning after deductions, mostly in trade and economics text (net trade, net exports, net lender/seller). Weak on "net" as a physical object or in "Networks".
result.label: " net" in economic usage

result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' inside words, especially in "rhetoric/rhetorical", and at the start of text. It stays silent on 'or' in names like "Shor" and "investor".
result.label: 'or' piece in rhetoric
' e' starting "ecolog-/ecosystem" words
result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' e' when it begins words like ecologist, ecology, ecosystem, ecological. It predicts continuations such as 'cos' and 'colog'. It stays silent on other tokens, including later pieces of the word.

Fires on the word ' feedback' (occasionally ' tone' or ' voice') in text about communication and feedback types, usually after an adjective like positive or delayed. Members are mostly detectors of 'feedback'.
result.label: 'feedback' (and tone) word

result.description: Fires on word pieces that continue a split word, mostly after "hist" (hist-og-ram, hist-ot-opic), and sometimes on other mid-word fragments such as Edmond-s or Kur-at-owski. Silent on a bare "og" at the start of a document.
result.label: Mid-word piece after "hist"

result.description: Fires on the 'es' piece completing the plural "genes" (after "gen") in genetics text. It stays silent on 'es' in other words like "bioinformatics" or "lifespan". Members are gen-prefix and genetics detectors.
result.label: 'es' in "genes"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that often start or join compounds, mainly ' side', also ' front', ' box', ' neck', 'western'. Likely predicts a joining suffix or '-'. Peaks are mixed, and members are mostly single-token detectors.
result.label: Compound-forming side/front/box tokens

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ating, -ations, -at, -ative) when they continue the word "alloc-" (allocating, allocations, allocative). Silent on the same -ating suffix in other words like overstating or mitigating.
result.label: Suffix after "alloc" (allocating/allocations)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ised' (British -ise past tense), most strongly in "poised" and also in "praised" and "revolutionised". Members are 'ised' detectors plus the ' po' piece.
result.label: 'ised' suffix token (poised)

result.description: Fires on the token ' Dr' (title) at the start of a line in a list of names, e.g. repeated "Dr. Johnson. Dr. Williams." lines. Members are mostly ' Dr' detectors. Silent on lists of names without the title.
result.label: ' Dr' title in name lists

result.description: Fires on the word "service" (also Service, delivery, services) mostly in lists of service-management terms like service design, service transition, service operation. Silent on unrelated kitchen/staff text.
result.label: "service" word in service-management terms

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes 'ic' (and 'ational', 'ial') at the start of a word or after a word break, where a longer word like "-icians/-ologists" is continuing. It stays silent when 'ic' ends an adjective like "strategic" or "Arabic".
result.label: 'ic' / 'ational' word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on " resources"/" resource" when it follows "natural" (natural resources). It stays quiet on the same word after other words such as "vital", "managing", "and" or "of".
result.label: "resources" after "natural"

result.description: Fires on the token ' open', most strongly in topology text about open sets, and more weakly in 'openness'. Members are mostly detectors of ' open' itself. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' open' token detector

result.description: Fires on the ' C' piece right after "James" in the name "James Clerk Maxwell" (physics context). It also fires weakly on other name-piece continuations like James-Stein or Mc-Keon. It stays silent on ' C' in other contexts such as Cotton or Clavier.
result.label: C in James Clerk Maxwell

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' constit', 'iat', ' irre', ' instit' (constitute, institution, irrelevant), where the word is still incomplete. Predicts continuation pieces such as 'itut'. Weak firing on ' purposes'. Members are diffuse early-layer token detectors.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (constit-, instit-)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Hels" at the start of "Helsinki" (Helsinki Accords), with weaker firing on "ente" and "throughout". Mostly a token detector for Hels- in the Helsinki context.
result.label: Hels- of Helsinki

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "Babylonian" (' Bab', 'yl', 'onian'), strongest on ' Bab' at the start of the word. It is weaker on later pieces, and it stays silent on other ancient-civilization text such as Egyptians. Next-token logits favor 'onian'.
result.label: Babylonian word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ount' in "discounting" (hyperbolic discounting), also ' grat' in "gratification" and some other mid-word fragments. It seems to need the word-start context, such as "disc" before 'ount'.
result.label: 'ount' in discounting, mid-word pieces
' Cy' as start of 'cycle'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Cy' that begins a split word, mostly 'Cycle' as in 'Life Cycle' or 'Krebs Cycle'. It predicts 'cle' next. Members are mainly detectors of Cy/cy tokens.

Fires on a word piece right after the word-start fragment "Sh" (Sh|a, Sh|el, Sh|ap, Sh|u), i.e. the second piece of a split word beginning with Sh. Silent on the same pieces in other words like "ling|u|istic".
result.label: Second piece after "Sh"

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "process" (or "processes"), as in "the process of X". It stays silent on " of" after other nouns such as example, terms or aspect. Logits favor production and manufacturing words.
result.label: " of" after "process"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "much" (of, as, more, about, was, part), as in "much of Europe", "much as", "much more than". Silent on "of" after other words. Members detect "much" in previous positions.
result.label: Word following "much"

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffixes ('ness', 'ization', 'ized') right after the word 'random', as in randomness and randomization. It stays silent on 'ness' after other stems like 'robust'.
result.label: random + suffix (randomness/randomization)

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also '-' or suffixes) directly after the word "form"/"forms", as in "form of" or "form-". The same ' of' after other nouns like "means" or "exploration" stays silent.
result.label: ' of' or '-' after "form"

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside grammar terminology, like "ad-ject-ives", "ad-verb-s", "ext-rem-ely", "pro-bably", in text about adverbs and parts of speech. Silent on logic or quantification text.
result.label: Grammar terms: adverb/adjective pieces

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces, mainly " absolute", " Princi" (of Principle), and " truth", often at the start of a multi-token term or phrase. Members are detectors of these tokens. It has no clear single trigger.
result.label: absolute / Princi / truth tokens
Net suffix in model names
result.description: Fires on the piece "Net" at the end of neural network model names such as GoogLeNet, VGGNet, ResNet and ImageNet. It is mostly silent on ordinary text, and weakly active on a few other tokens such as " Jones".

Fires on the word " integer" in mathematical text about number theory, polynomials and modular arithmetic. It also fires weakly on nearby math tokens such as " Q" or " mod" after "integer". It is mostly driven by the layer-0 MLP latent for the same token.
result.label: ' integer' in math text

result.description: Fires on the slash '/' in long strings of slash-separated digits (e.g. 7/5/6/7, score-like lists). It is weaker for '/' between words such as quality/opportunity.
result.label: Slash in numeric slash sequences

result.description: Fires on correlative/quantifier words "either", "neither", "both" (also "merely"), especially when listing conjunctions or in either/neither...nor and both...and constructions. Members detect each of these words separately.
result.label: either/neither/both correlatives

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Elect' at the start of electro- words (Electrode, Electrochemical, Electrolytes), mostly in title-like or heading text. Weakly on other word-start pieces like ' Met' or ' Elect' in Electrical.
result.label: Elect- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in rare technical words, mainly 'ige' in "pigeonhole/pigeons" and 'agnet' in "diamagnetism/ferrimagnetic", plus a few others like 'é'. Members are mostly detectors of the 'ige' piece.
result.label: Rare word pieces: ige, agnet

result.description: Fires on the word "machine" (and "mach-", "Machine", "machines"), mostly in "machine learning", "machine vision" or "machine translation" after a preceding word. It stayed silent when "machine learning" began the text, with no word before it.
result.label: "machine" token detector

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe (or hyphen) right after the word "speaker" (speaker's, speaker-speaking). It stays silent on apostrophes after other nouns like practitioner or audience.
result.label: Apostrophe after "speaker"

result.description: Fires on a bare space token that precedes a digit string in a year or decade, as in "the early 1980s" or "the 1930s". It stays silent on some similar cases such as "between the 193…" and "the 195…".
result.label: Space before year digits

result.description: Fires on the token ' professional' in mid-text, mostly before nouns like settings, communication, or relationship. It stays silent when the word is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' professional' mid-text

result.description: Fires on the adverb " truly" (occasionally "stand", "amaz"), mostly before a verb like collaborate, engage, connect or appreciate. Members detect "truly"/"really"/"genuinely" and similar intensifiers; logits favour verbs such as appreciate and exist.
result.label: Adverb "truly" before verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece "endency", most strongly in "Central Tendency" (t|endency) and also in "Dependency". It predicts "endency/endencies" continuations. The contrast "pre…" context stays silent.
result.label: "endency" in Tendency

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens in technical text, most often " Linux", " LI", "Order" and " Bash". The peaks are scattered, and the logits favour word-ending suffixes. The evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered technical tokens (Linux, Order)
